| Peter, I know I’ve been sharing a lot of old photos recently, but I just had to send this to you.

Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95101801/505590282/-1242516620?amount=10&refcode=RTFC_20241015_EMSPL_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzNlOWY5Ni01MThiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=S3QJwzs9SqgQk5kHTTg4m7fDdbnwDDgleAj367sWMcg=) I’ll admit, it’s easy to chuckle at this photo — the classic 1970s bow tie, the braces, the yarmulke, the looks — but it is also an opportunity to tell you a little about how I approach my faith.

Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause.

Before I go any further, and while I still have your attention, I have to ask — [will you click this link and pitch in a few dollars to split between Ritchie Torres and my campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95101804/505590288/-1242516620?amount=10&refcode=RTFC_20241015_EMSPL_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzNlOWY5Ni01MThiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=S3QJwzs9SqgQk5kHTTg4m7fDdbnwDDgleAj367sWMcg=) If you are not ready yet or need more convincing, please read on. I have lots to share and more to say. I think you’ll like it.

I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman, and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company.

We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.

This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all.)

While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day.

**In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: What is required of us, but to do justice, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.**

These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office.

And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours.

That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day.

[If these priorities resonate with you, I’m asking for your help to continue that work by chipping in $10 to split between Ritchie Torres and my campaign before tonight's mid-month deadline.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95101810/505590289/-1242516620?amount=10&refcode=RTFC_20241015_EMSPL_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzNlOWY5Ni01MThiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=S3QJwzs9SqgQk5kHTTg4m7fDdbnwDDgleAj367sWMcg=) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Adam Schiff and Ritchie Torres will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95101817/505590329/-1242516620?amount=10&amounts=10,15,20&express_lane=true&refcode=RTFC_20241015_EMSPL_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzNlOWY5Ni01MThiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=S3QJwzs9SqgQk5kHTTg4m7fDdbnwDDgleAj367sWMcg=)

clean_body: | Peter, I know I’ve been sharing a lot of old photos recently, but I just had to send this to you. Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah: = I’ll admit, it’s easy to chuckle at this photo — the classic 1970s bow tie, the braces, the yarmulke, the looks — but it is also an opportunity to tell you a little about how I approach my faith. Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause. Before I go any further, and while I still have your attention, I have to ask — = If you are not ready yet or need more convincing, please read on. I have lots to share and more to say. I think you’ll like it. I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman, and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company. We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school. This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all.) While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day. In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: What is required of us, but to do justice, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God. These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office. And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours. That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Adam Schiff and Ritchie Torres will go through immediately: | = = = Hopefully, this photo helped brighten your day and gave you a bit more insight into why I have dedicated my life to this cause. Tonight, I laid out what I’m doing to take on corporate greed, build an economy that works for everyone, and protect Pennsylvanians’ fundamental freedoms, like voting rights, workers’ rights, and women’s rights.
Meanwhile, David McCormick spent his time misleading Pennsylvanians and lying about his record. It’s clear that McCormick will do and say anything to help his own bottom line. We must hold him accountable, and that takes resources, Peter.
I know my team and I have reached out a lot, but the stakes of this race couldn’t be higher. The polls are tied, and the fate of our Senate majority rests on what we do in Pennsylvania.
With just three weeks until Election Day and Pennsylvanians casting their ballots already, our window to reach the voters we need is quickly closing.

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2073%2E135344%2EpeBcNO)

Friend --
If you were not able to catch my final debate with my opponent last night, there is one moment in particular that stuck out to me.
In an exchange on public education, my opponent, Mike Rogers, said he’s “not sure” how Betsy DeVos “has anything to do with us trying to improve education for our kids.”
As Michiganders know, for decades the DeVos family’s #1 issue has been weakening Michigan's, and the country's, public education system. Betsy DeVos used Michigan as her petri dish before becoming Trump’s Secretary of Education — and she is rumored to be Trump’s likely pick if he wins again.
So yes, Betsy DeVos has *everything* to do with public education.
And DeVos’s connections with our opponent run deep. Rogers' first FEC report of his Senate campaign was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family — contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day. DeVos has even campaigned with our opponent.
They are certainly not done with their support of my opponent. If all goes in their favor, Rogers and DeVos will return to DC hand in hand.
[**Can you contribute $3 directly to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan before our FEC deadline tomorrow at midnight? I will put your donation made today in Betsy’s name right to work persuading the voters we need to win in Michigan in just 21 days.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241015-4-900&t=2&akid=2073%2E135344%2EpeBcNO)

body:
This is incredibly urgent, and I need your support:
#
We’re so close to making history, hopefully the first of many future trans members of Congress to serve this incredible country.
But the only way that I can guarantee that I’m not the last is to quite simply be the best member of Congress that I can be. To continue to fight for what’s right and for who needs it the most — and that’s exactly what I plan to do if I win.
But it’s not a given: This race is far from over, and our first (and only) televised debate of the general election is tomorrow. **Our mid-month fundraising goal ends TONIGHT at midnight, and it’s our last one before early voting begins:[Can I ask you for a donation of $5 right now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241015-1?refcode=em20241015-1-1400&amount=5&refcode2=1400_21716_wV9cUg&akid=1400%2E21716%2EwV9cUg)**

We can’t take anything for granted.
Our opponents want to take us back, but we know there’s simply no other way: We’re never going back.
But it’s going to take grassroots support to finish this fight, and every penny of our $15,000 goal will go towards winning this race. And I have to be honest: It might just take every penny to do that.

body:
We can’t depend on a special interest-backed Republican from out of state to hold the line for Democrats in the Senate

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2373%2E4032634%2EYu4CE-)
---
The future of the Senate could be decided by a single Senate seat. And crypto interests and billionaires are trying to buy this one in Massachusetts by propping up my Republican opponent. With extremists trying to ban abortion nationwide, we can’t take any chances. We need Senators we can 100% trust to protect abortion rights. That’s not my opponent. He said he would have voted for Neil Gorsuch, one of Trump’s Supreme Court justices who overturned _Roe v. Wade_. And he bragged about raising money for Republicans who support a national abortion ban. With the future of Senate Control at stake, we can’t afford to take anything for granted — not even one vote from Massachusetts. [**So will you make a donation of $28 or anything you can tonight to ensure we can fight back against the crypto interests supporting my opponent and national Republicans who want to take back the Senate?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2774?amount=28&t=8&akid=2373%2E4032634%2EYu4CE-)

If the Republicans have control of the Senate, there will be zero opportunity to vote on a law for national abortion protections. Also, our education policy will be controlled by people who don't believe in public education. Our climate policy will be controlled by people who are climate deniers. Our judges will be carefully screened by people who will make sure that they are anti-abortion. And our gun policy will be set by people who think thoughts and prayers are all that we need. We can’t depend on a special interest-backed Republican from out of state to hold the line for Democrats in the Senate when these issues are put up to a vote. That’s why this race is incredibly important, and why I’m taking this seriously. And look, it’s not just about being on defense. We need to go on offense for working people — to pass policies that will make positive, transformative changes. So I’m fighting to bring down the cost of housing. Put child care within reach for all working parents. Protect our country from the climate crisis. Make the Supreme Court follow a standard code of ethics. Take power away from powerful interests like Big Pharma, Big Oil, and big banks and put it in the hands of working people — which means passing my set of anti-corruption plans. We can get all this done — and more — as long as we keep fighting side by side. [**If it makes sense for you right now, please pitch in any amount to help win our re-election campaign, preserve our Democratic majority in the Senate, and make real change for the American people.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2774?amount=28&t=14&akid=2373%2E4032634%2EYu4CE-) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

Friends,
When I’m talking about supporting causes and organizations, I often say that I would never ask anyone else to invest in something that I’m not investing in myself.
The same is true for my own re-election campaign.
I’m incredibly fortunate to be able to provide support to my own campaign. I’m grateful for that because it allows me to focus on the work that really matters – on legislating and building relationships in my community – instead of just trying to keep our budget afloat.
And there’s plenty of work to be done – I have an amazing staff on the ground that organizes volunteers and activists to get involved in the election; I work hard to be as involved in my community as I possibly can, even when commuting to D.C. for votes and legislative work; and I’m passionate about supporting my fellow Democrats up and down the ballot in California and running in competitive House races around the country.
But the reality is that I can’t do 100% of it on my own. I’m grateful to be able to invest in my own work, and I’m so proud of what we’ve accomplished this election cycle. And in this final stretch, I’m asking you to join me and help push us through the finish line to a strong victory.

name: Marjorie Taylor Greene
subject: Mike Johnson is conspiring against us
body:
As I write this, Mike Johnson is lying and selling out our country

| | | | [](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9d0S/?__vbtrk=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Friend,
As I write this, Mike Johnson and his Deepstate cronies are getting ready to stuff another spending bill down Americans’ throats.
**Mike Johnson is _lying_ to the American people, he is _colluding_ with Chuck Schumer, and he is _selling_ our country out.**
[FIGHT FOR OUR COUNTRY](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9d0S/?__vbtrk=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
I have been asking Republicans to answer the same question for almost an entire year of Mike Johnson making a mess as Speaker of the House:
** Can you name _one single victory_ that Mike Johnson has gotten for Conservatives?**
**I SURE CAN’T!**
Despite what the Media and Talking Heads say, this is NOT about ‘Republicans’ vs. ‘Democrats’.
This is about the basic principles that real Americans care about...
The principles that motivated Americans to give the GOP the House Majority. A majority they are wasting.
**This is about Mike Johnson _backing down_ to Chuck Schumer and Joe Biden _every single time_ _._**
[STAND FOR WHAT'S RIGHT](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9d0S/?__vbtrk=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
This is about Mike Johnson _breaking promises_ to stop the sale of our children’s future with outrageous spending as soon as he meets with his first lobbyist.
This is about him _immediately breaking his promise to stop the endless foreign wars, pointless carnage, and death_ as soon as the first Democrat called him a nasty name on Fake News CNN.
This is about Mike Johnson _forcing you to continue funding the war_ in Ukraine while the border is open, and Americans can’t afford their mortgage payments or groceries.
This is about Mike Johnson _surrendering on securing our Elections_ through the SAVE Act so he can get a pat on the head by Hakeem Jeffries, Chuck Schumer and Kamala Harris.
**On the eve of an election, Mike Johnson is betraying you, me, and President Trump.**
[STAND FOR AMERICA](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9d0S/?__vbtrk=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
**While Americans struggle, Mike Johnson is setting up fake fights, working with Democrats, and hiding from journalists.**
This isn’t about “party”: This is about the Deepstate wanting to capture every member of Congress, regardless of party affiliation, and get them in line, stepping on your rights, trampling your savings, and intimidating you if you ask ‘why?’
I think it’s pretty obvious they got Mike Johnson...
I think it’s pretty obvious they’ve got most of Congress...
**And I think the American people know they're not going to get me.**
[DEFEND MTG](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9d0S/?__vbtrk=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
I am fighting like Hell against the Deepstate, against a rogue government trying to bankrupt its own citizens, and against meaningless, endless foreign conflicts.
And believe me: __**They are fighting back.**__
We are just weeks away from the most important election in the history of our country and there is not a single Member of Congress doing more to fight against the Deep State’s games than I am.
**That’s why they’ve made me their #1 target to get out of the way.**
_**[Friend, from the bottom of my heart, I would not be reaching out to you again if the situation wasn’t dire. I’ve been fighting for you for years. After having your back, can I count on you to have mine and help me resist their attacks](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9d0S/?__vbtrk=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**_**?**
Everyday, I wake up and go to the Capitol, and I fight for Americans just like you...
I fight against RINOs and Democrats trying to destroy President Trump, and take away your children’s future.
**The only way they can get me to stop is if they run me out of office and they’re doing everything they can to drive me out in November.**
_**[Can I count on you](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9d0S/?__vbtrk=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**_**?**
[DEFEND MTG](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9d0S/?__vbtrk=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9d0S/?__vbtrk=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Marjorie Taylor Greene
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9d0S/?__vbtrk=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjUyODMyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zt55voeqm5i4a6jv01agkg234ep01h9lgti8jc10_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1jm6ob2c9h2bs) [NO](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zsrq3noh7qutinaq3r61rpqhd31j9ob268l8h59o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1jm6ob2c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zmujoqojj63cfl2hddoth0n42q4t7jq9u62oj030_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1jm6ob2c9h2bs)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Hey - this is Steve Scalise.

I've written A LOT of important memos over the years... But I can honestly say this is the most important one I've written to date. Please read it as soon as you get this email:
---
| | | [READ MY MEMO HERE](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z47hemulk47l0das8mp4kuji8a07kn554t33s2d0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1jm6ob2c9h2bs "READ MY MEMO HERE")
---
**FROM:** Steve Scalise, House Majority Leader
**TO:** Conservatives Everywhere
**RE:** The Final Sprint
* * *

Hello,

With the General Election LESS than 3 weeks away - _and the Democrat Machine firing on all cylinders_ -- our already-fragile Conservative House Majority hangs by a thread.

Below is our plan to save it.

**THE BOTTOM LINE**

_Republicans are at a serious disadvantage in the final sprint of the election._

Democrats have a **2-POINT EDGE** over Republicans in the latest Generic Ballot. And they are currently out raising us by $30 million in toss-up races.

Fundraising is where close elections are won and lost. And right now, Democrats have the upper hand. They're using their multi-million dollar lead to flood the airwaves with vicious and dishonest ads against our Conservative candidates

At this point, control of Congress is anyone's game.

**IMPORTANT CONTEXT**

House Republicans are the **ONLY FIREWALL** right now standing in the way of Chuck Schumer, Joe Biden, and Kamala Harris ramming through whatever they want. That includes gutting voter ID, packing the Supreme Court, eviscerating our God-given rights, and making Washington DC a state.

As of right now, our House Majority is extremely fragile - if we lose even a few seats, the Democrats will immediately take control.

**THE PROBLEM**

We are losing the fundraising battle. Our budgets for recruiting volunteers, knocking on doors in swing states, keeping our ads on the airwaves, and turning out GOP voters are running **DANGEROUSLY LOW.**

Meanwhile, House Democrats are swimming in cash and Kamala Harris is cutting down-ballot Liberals huge checks.

**OUR SOLUTION**

Unless we can ignite a **MASSIVE** fundraising surge in these final days, our chances of taking it all will drop like a lead balloon.

I am personally asking you to make a donation today. It does not matter to me if it's $10 or $100 - every penny counts. Each donation brings us closer to sealing this election for Republicans up and down the ballot.

_**[So will you step up and make a donation right now? The future of our country depends on it.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zvp7d2c024coenv27q3f7rhne7ga0dsco61eqt08_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1jm6ob2c9h2bs "So will you step up and make a donation right now? The future of our country depends on it.")**_

Thank you,
Steve Scalise
---

Before I go, just remember this:

The future of our country is resting on our shoulders right now and what you do today could be the final push we need in our last days before the election. _So what do you say, will you step up and make a donation today?_

[YES](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9rtgorp1ekomnqne0630j3raebptqd2frlp7818_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1jm6ob2c3h2bs) [NO](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zigahr4l7cv1nfg647hbkhg091f9u6v240es9buo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1jm6ob2c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. subject: Attaching My Final 2024 Election Memo
disclaimer_text: Paid for by TEAM SCALISE, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and to benefit SCALISE FOR CONGRESS and EYE OF THE TIGER PAC
body:
Thank the Lord this reached you in time...

| |

---
| | | _Thank the Lord this reached you in time ..._

Hey - this is Steve Scalise.

I've written A LOT of important memos over the years... But I can honestly say this is the most important one I've written to date. Please read it as soon as you get this email:
---
| | | [READ MY MEMO HERE](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zn1sjpimegblicquqkh4t7c28nc5po2aabpahoto_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1jm1oj2c5h2bs "READ MY MEMO HERE")
---
**FROM:** Steve Scalise, House Majority Leader
**TO:** Conservatives Everywhere
**RE:** The Final Sprint
* * *

Hello,

With the General Election LESS than 3 weeks away - _and the Democrat Machine firing on all cylinders_ -- our already-fragile Conservative House Majority hangs by a thread.

Below is our plan to save it.

**THE BOTTOM LINE**

_Republicans are at a serious disadvantage in the final sprint of the election._

Democrats have a **2-POINT EDGE** over Republicans in the latest Generic Ballot. And they are currently out raising us by $30 million in toss-up races.

Fundraising is where close elections are won and lost. And right now, Democrats have the upper hand. They're using their multi-million dollar lead to flood the airwaves with vicious and dishonest ads against our Conservative candidates

At this point, control of Congress is anyone's game.

**IMPORTANT CONTEXT**

House Republicans are the **ONLY FIREWALL** right now standing in the way of Chuck Schumer, Joe Biden, and Kamala Harris ramming through whatever they want. That includes gutting voter ID, packing the Supreme Court, eviscerating our God-given rights, and making Washington DC a state.

As of right now, our House Majority is extremely fragile - if we lose even a few seats, the Democrats will immediately take control.

**THE PROBLEM**

We are losing the fundraising battle. Our budgets for recruiting volunteers, knocking on doors in swing states, keeping our ads on the airwaves, and turning out GOP voters are running **DANGEROUSLY LOW.**

Meanwhile, House Democrats are swimming in cash and Kamala Harris is cutting down-ballot Liberals huge checks.

**OUR SOLUTION**

Unless we can ignite a **MASSIVE** fundraising surge in these final days, our chances of taking it all will drop like a lead balloon.

I am personally asking you to make a donation today. It does not matter to me if it's $10 or $100 - every penny counts. Each donation brings us closer to sealing this election for Republicans up and down the ballot.

_**[So will you step up and make a donation right now? The future of our country depends on it.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z88giqk1262d3icnfr1apa5093gtne1ghb849vno_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1jm1oj2c5h2bs "So will you step up and make a donation right now? The future of our country depends on it.")**_

Thank you,
Steve Scalise
---

Before I go, just remember this:

The future of our country is resting on our shoulders right now and what you do today could be the final push we need in our last days before the election. _So what do you say, will you step up and make a donation today?_

---

For America,

**Steve Scalise**
House Majority Leader

Friend, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Friend, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

name: Huffines Liberty Foundation
subject: Forced Medicalization Is the Apex of Tyranny
body:
State and local leaders should save taxpayer money by eliminating this archaic practice that unquestionably poisons children.
No images? [Click here](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-e-sjymud-yuddtktydi-b/) [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sjymud-yuddtktydi-r/) **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Press Manager
Contact: [Press@HuffinesLiberty.com](mailto:Press@HuffinesLiberty.com)
## **Forced Medicalization Is the Apex of Tyranny**
[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sjymud-yuddtktydi-y/) DALLAS, TX, October 14, 2024 -- Today, the Huffines Liberty Foundation is releasing our latest solutions paper, [_Texas Should End Forced Medicalization with Fluoride_](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sjymud-yuddtktydi-j/).**The Problem **
The issue of forced medicalization--using government power to enforce medical interventions on the public--has long been a contentious topic in the United States. This debate reemerged during the COVID-19 pandemic, with mandates on vaccines and other medical measures stirring strong opposition. However, the problem of coercive medicalization extends beyond COVID-19 and encompasses practices like the fluoridation of drinking water, which impacts millions of Americans daily. While some health officials and organizations continue to support fluoridation, growing evidence and public skepticism are raising serious questions about its safety, effectiveness, and necessity.Economist and philosopher Murray Rothbard explained in 1992 that the deployment of government power to force medication on citizens resulted from "an alliance of three major forces: ideological Social Democrats, ambitious technocratic bureaucrats, and Big Businessmen seeking privileges from the State." He continued:_" It has always been a bit of a mystery to me why left-environmentalists... who hate every chemical additive known to man, still cast their benign approval upon fluoride, a highly toxic and probably carcinogenic substance."_Fluoridation, initially introduced in the mid-20th century, is defended as a low-cost method to reduce dental cavities, particularly in children. However, fluoride is a highly toxic substance that can cause adverse health effects at elevated levels. As public awareness of these risks grows, many Americans, including citizens of Texas, are asking whether the benefits of fluoridation truly outweigh its risks.**The Science**
In August 2024, the National Toxicology Program (NTP), a division of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, released a comprehensive peer-reviewed study on the effects of fluoride exposure. The study reviewed decades of scientific literature and found that most high-quality research showed a significant association between fluoride exposure and lower IQ, ADHD, and other cognitive or neurodevelopmental outcomes in children.Another study found that "excess fluoride exposures can have deleterious effects on the expecting mother and fetus and is associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes," including "anemia, miscarriage, abortion, and still birth."Concerns about fluoridation increased when, on September 24th, 2024, U.S. Federal Judge Edward Chen ruled that the risk posed by fluoride in drinking water is high enough to warrant a regulatory response from the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). Judge Chen stated that there is little disagreement on whether fluoride can be hazardous, and noted "scientific evidence has increasingly identified a link between fluoride exposure and adverse cognitive effects in children (reduced IQ)." EPA experts conceded that fluoride exposure poses health risks at certain levels.In his decision, Chen also noted that "evidence [has] increasingly established fluoride's connection to adverse effects, including severe enamel fluorosis, risk of bone fracture, and potential skeletal fluorosis." And he emphasized the need for federal regulatory agencies to reassess their stance on fluoridation in light of these findings.**The Costs of Fluoridation**
Proponents often argue that fluoridation is a low-cost public health measure, estimating that it costs approximately $1.32 per person annually. With 214 million Americans consuming fluoridated water, this translates into more than $282 million each year.**The Solution**
Fluoridating drinking water is a dangerous, slippery slope to medical tyranny. The City of Dallas and many other cities in Texas are adding thousands of pounds of fluoride to the drinking water. As of 2012, only 6% of the world's population lived in countries that fluoridated water; almost half of those were in the United States. For decades, the rest of the world has understood the toxicity of fluoride in water and banned the practice--including 97% of the countries in Europe. With recent scientific evidence suggesting that fluoridation may be less effective in reducing cavities than originally thought and that fluoride can affect the health of children and pregnant women, Texas must act. State and local leaders should save taxpayer money by eliminating this archaic practice that unquestionably poisons children. We must create safeguards against any form of coerced medical treatment being pushed by lobbyists who don't have the public's interest at heart. It's time for officials to prioritize the health, welfare, and liberty of Texans by rejecting outdated policies that are poisoning citizens. Texans deserve nothing less. [Read / Share Solutions Paper](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sjymud-yuddtktydi-t/) The Huffines Liberty Foundation is a 501(c)(3) non-profit, non-partisan research institute. Our mission is to advance the cause of **liberty** , **prosperity** , and **virtue** in the State of Texas by educating and equipping citizens so they may hold their elected officials accountable and better informed to tackle the toughest challenges.### [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sjymud-yuddtktydi-i/)[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sjymud-yuddtktydi-h/)[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sjymud-yuddtktydi-k/) | [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sjymud-yuddtktydi-u/) | [ Share ](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-fb-sjymud-yuddtktydi-n/) | [ Tweet ](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-tw-sjymud-yuddtktydi-p/) | [ Forward ](https://huffineslibertyfoundation.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-yuddtktydi-17329976-sjymud-l-f)

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2fh4m73eeit02gjltmd11488bqa8ag0mk7er720_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1ge0o32cth2bs) [NO](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6ii7ecudrrg0im4oj25k3ddh6vc054pinvhi8mg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4s1ge0o32cth2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. **TO:** Conservatives Everywhere
**RE:** The Final Sprint
* * *

Hello,

With the General Election LESS than 3 weeks away - _and the Democrat Machine firing on all cylinders_ -- our already-fragile Conservative House Majority hangs by a thread.

Below is our plan to save it.

**THE BOTTOM LINE**

_Republicans are at a serious disadvantage in the final sprint of the election._

Democrats have a **2-POINT EDGE** over Republicans in the latest Generic Ballot. And they are currently out raising us by $30 million in toss-up races.

Fundraising is where close elections are won and lost. And right now, Democrats have the upper hand. They're using their multi-million dollar lead to flood the airwaves with vicious and dishonest ads against our Conservative candidates

House Republicans are the **ONLY FIREWALL** right now standing in the way of Chuck Schumer, Joe Biden, and Kamala Harris ramming through whatever they want. That includes gutting voter ID, packing the Supreme Court, eviscerating our God-given rights, and making Washington DC a state.

As of right now, our House Majority is extremely fragile - if we lose even a few seats, the Democrats will immediately take control.

**THE PROBLEM**

We are losing the fundraising battle. Our budgets for recruiting volunteers, knocking on doors in swing states, keeping our ads on the airwaves, and turning out GOP voters are running **DANGEROUSLY LOW.**

Meanwhile, House Democrats are swimming in cash and Kamala Harris is cutting down-ballot Liberals huge checks.

**OUR SOLUTION**

Unless we can ignite a **MASSIVE** fundraising surge in these final days, our chances of taking it all will drop like a lead balloon.

I am personally asking you to make a donation today. It does not matter to me if it's $10 or $100 - every penny counts. Each donation brings us closer to sealing this election for Republicans up and down the ballot.

_**[So will you step up and make a donation right now? * We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

## Google Goes Nuclear for Data Power
Google announced a deal with nuclear reactor developer Kairos Power [to purchase energy](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvhSAUhX8Nbhgu8lAHhi5ur2tHc4Wr0iIY5Gnev2_s3uXkJCc5-fJ9Pccn-uDj8okbmTKnEW3xJ40gOGgu1agqZ2YiSU1FBlrZi7ZTra5Wg-oxw6QmrR9uFp1QTk7YUO8ApwdgU3kjhVQgQIMQvVB172DudNuCaDpwhEwJcr6kXH8nH8tKc3ink3Jt01YFs5ayH6z5YHJgcriuq7ZxsvfI5HBfMzmAuONuS0pLIO7jz8EdYeCXLyuPLxsIM7dp2zG-OR7cYUFuKRbKfE8XZe5ow-j48coLHfVatlBl4_bLh-AP3TIllg19-MMq_1g6jfwNAAD___gQahI) to power its AI data centers, following a similar move by Microsoft to restart Pennsylvania's Three Mile Island nuclear plant for the same purpose. Kairos Power, [a startup that develops small reactors](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j7Fu7CAQAL8GurOW9R6YguI17u61KS0OFpsEm5ONbOXvo0ufbqSRRpqPx_TwueRt_u9Xdi3VyYeWT54U3JS-IU0ko0vMyL1kpwxaMAMZLReXKOpwxxCSHXobwZMiA0hJe069fcrsEJAUKK0ALFBno0qDNkZBP6jIXhBwzK3u3WfNW1s4le968t6FusriltZeh-j_CRwFjtd1dc9neDuB48bXIXD0e8uh8BuDoWHeLH3Ze5W7i68rl5IPbQTBvPpcfqvtj8nT4U8AAAD__8-EUrM) with molten salt coolant, received federal approval last year to build a new nuclear reactor. It's the first such permit granted in 50 years.Google described [the next-gen reactors](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGO3CAQgOGnwR0WjAnYBUUad5s2pTW2BzwJhhVmd7Vvf7q7-h7glz79f2_LDTlxjn_wJN9CWXBr_KRFK6mtBLOYbveBCGjoyGsHk3KjcbY7vLXbZgKMv3B1owlBBzB2GiZlwhq00R17UGC00lYrNSnTT7sOo3VOq2HUO6EwinZupfb_Cud2UEjv8qTab-Xskj9au19i-C1gFjCvqcQ-lhITCZjLo1XC7ZCcuTF-mi8B8_W4GnLGlRO3t4D5O5D_kWu55L28qMr82BJhlZSpxrfEWIlOyk3A3FW_31-cEl_WCaPiiZy-OO2HO08PHwEAAP__-hFp3w) as robust, safe, and designed with a modular approach to reduce construction timelines and facilitate easier placement.The first reactor is expected to come online this decade, with additional reactors projected by 2035. No financial details were disclosed.
## Kamala Harris Facing Plagiarism Allegations
Vice President Kamala Harris [faces plagiarism allegations](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FugzAQgOGngc3o7uxiGDx0yZauHdEFH-EaO0TGAvXtq3bv_ku_vs_rdGVN-rx_cJZQl23iueohE4LB3pCbXBvDIkJiWwnoaQQ_ON-3ayAHFtzo3Hi7EQv5tyGiRLQUkbzlVgMBOQTsEWAE140Rl6H3HsEOGIUbBxK1bqX72vRZV1nS93ZI6eYttymstb72xr43dGnocp5n95RzP0Uev0FDlwdnTmxWLkV380p8Vy66ZzMn1mz2zKWauWgWg2M_DBbbEuLr1JR0733j4J5Z09-u_qM_Av0EAAD__2HRXBY) over her 2009 book _Smart on Crime_ , with claims it lifted passages from sources such as a Bureau of Justice Assistance report, an Associated Press article, and even Wikipedia.Conservative activist Christopher Rufo, who exposed the alleged copying, provided a full analysis showing [18 instances of plagiarism](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DGP3CAUBOBfgztWgDmzFBTbuLtIqaJU1gM_2y-HwQJ2reyvj5z-qhnpa0bz63P6BIqU1h-wo2tLniA0euEkBZcDV3rS3ewWRIV9h04aZYW5azN0mwtWiGDuGu2H7D-s8WB9v3ir0Ac9LL4jp4TSUshBCmGFvtlZLvfBGCn6u5wRmBY4U8vl9idTahsu8W9-YbmFvHfRba0dlfUPpkamxvM8b3tNlzE1YuLPytSY8LziyJEahat-wQ4R-AalUOUQwrPizPPCjwgrQaE3pZVT4koIy33OXxx8fjbu8YK6Q2k8Jx4K7cjUCIU_HrKu798_u-Lm46QYqQ6GabHuQPH_2PbNdy-n_gUAAP__Wp5ybg). Harris' publisher, Chronicle Books, is treating the matter as "very sensitive," while her campaign dismisses the accusations, stating that sources were properly cited.Rufo shared a post on X revealing that Kamala Harris's publisher, Chronicle Books, is in "damage control" after accidentally sending [his team an internal email](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD-PnDAUxD8NdEb2wwG2cLFF6C5NipTogZ_h5fwH2b5F--0j0l81I41-Gs38-Vg-kD3H_RcGMtWlBbfKL1qUFGoQoBfdWuOIgPqWjBrhIcdJj0N7mM0ROAcrYL86UFb-mOSgN4tkN4UKWjYgQSupBiXlQ-ruYZWbhnFUsp-UJWy0JMs15e5v4lgPcv6dXpS7LYXWm6PWszT9s4G5gfm6ri6UeGcNzBTFV2lgjnTdcibPlbfbHpgzF7Gm9CnOr9XzDdKK75s8KAs8T8JcRE0ikycsJDhWyhG9CBSSCFwqflL0b4GuUhanx50xcwkCvacdK6d4d2EWz6cq--_pZ5uNPS_2nsswNlruAdn_H1K_-fVl4F8AAAD__4llf18) outlining how to handle inquiries about the plagiarism claims.In response, JD Vance [posted on X](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z71OKzEQQOGnsbtEM2OPfwoXV7raAimUUK6seJwYOdlo1yzw9gh62lMc6Xs9zafcertfnvNN0qjLnM-j7TIjHNAdyM5Wl1RFSIyWhJ4i-GC909dETBY452KYq0NmwyBsiIOvESLqlgjIIqBDgAj2GAvW4LxHMAGLZGVBShvLenxb2n1cpfavZZf1eF5uuqfrGI9NmX-KJkXT509VND39f8n3syiatpHH-6ZowmA5sDM-BGBv0EfQayqPj9Z725xXFi633Prvd_zB3BN9BwAA___DDk-D): _" Hi, I'm JD Vance. I wrote my own book, unlike Kamala Harris, who copied hers from Wikipedia."_

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs8jvlPWJN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os8jvlPWJN

Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans, I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation,
second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.

I would like to send you my brand-new book Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times' as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the
ministry of Pathway to Victory.

Make your generous gift here: https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress

Pathway to Victory is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts
fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word,

Dr. Robert Jeffress
Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

Brandon has been a warrior on the frontlines of the culture war since the beginning. Known for his ability to dismantle leftist narratives with sharp logic and undeniable authority, he blends gritty, boots-on-the-ground experience with an unapologetic defense of America’s traditional values and Constitutional principles. Brandon’s unique law enforcement background and ability to be relatable make him a trusted voice for Generation Z on topics like personal responsibility and criminal justice reform. With a combined social media following of 7 million, he speaks directly to what matters most - cutting through the noise to connect with a generation that needs it! As a TPUSA Contributor, Brandon will engage with students on campus during the spring and fall semesters, speak at our national events, and conduct live interviews on media row at AmericaFest. | | Hi everyone,
I'd like to share a screenshot that one of our readers took today of the front page of our site (see below). THIS is Jared Polis' Colorado, folks. This is our reality. Crime, gangs, drugs... not to mention inflation and taxes, the list goes on. THIS is what we're up against. With only 20 days until Election Day, please let this serve as a brutal reminder of what happens if we don't vote out the people destroying our state. It's time to act.
---
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, October 16, 2024.

– Heidi Ganahl
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[‘This was a takeover’: CBZ Management no longer silent on violent TdA activity in Aurora](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-n6g/sejfe195fe2)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-n6g/sdvda5186ca)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-n6g/s5kc127081f)
_A property management company, which has been vilified in Aurora as a slumlord, has begun to speak out through a new social media account._
_They are providing, in the words of Paul Harvey, the rest of the story._
_In 2019, CBZ Management was hired to manage Aurora apartment properties by the new owners. The properties were in poor condition and CBZ Management was assigned renovation to increase the rent value, the company’s first posting on Oct. 11 reads._
_“We understood this project would take years to yield results and would be both time-consuming and costly, involving comprehensive upgrades to every unit and the overall structure,” the Twitter/X post from @CbzManagement reads. “To manage the project effectively, given our New York-based operations, our representative moved to Colorado with his family.”_

* CWEPA, founded in 1947, consists of 200 wildlife professionals committed to safeguarding Colorado’s wildlife resources. CWEPA President Casey Westbrook emphasized that science-driven wildlife management is key to protecting the state’s wildlife for future generations.

Hunting, fishing, and sustainable practices are recognized as important contributors to Colorado’s wildlife conservation efforts.

* Delta County reported 7,000 pills seized last month, with fentanyl connected to 64 out of 83 drug cases and linked to property crimes and mental health issues.

_As Colorado grapples with increasing energy demands and the urgent need to move away from coal to meet environmental and health goals, the question arises: how can we ensure that this transition provides economic opportunities and stability for coal-dependent communities?_
_For decades, the American working class has borne the brunt of energy transitions. From coal miners to oil rig workers, shifts in energy policy have often led to job losses and economic instability. As we move toward a cleaner future, it is imperative that we avoid repeating these mistakes._
_Nuclear energy, particularly advanced small modular reactors (SMRs), presents a viable solution that can facilitate a just transition away from coal, ensuring energy reliability, economic growth, and environmental stewardship. One might wonder why Colorado, despite its strong commitment to clean energy, is not taking advantage of nuclear power._ __[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-n6g/s2l1300a66f)
|

_We have all seen an increase in tension between people of different political beliefs over the last few years. We believe there are some common-sense solutions to help increase trust and tone down the rhetoric that comes out of the election process. The good news is that these improvements do not require a change in the statute to do so. The solutions being proposed here require added transparency and a willingness to follow current law._
_In Colorado, the elections conducted by each county are initially certified by entities called “canvass boards.” Those county-level certifications are then provided to the Secretary of State who relies on them to certify the election results for the entire state. The Colorado legislature in C.R.S. 1-10-101 created the role of the canvass boards and C.R.S. 1-10-101.5 clearly defines their three duties. The canvass boards are comprised of an equal number of members from each of the two major political parties and the county clerk and recorder. Members of the canvass boards are required to pledge an oath confirming their qualifications and stating they will “faithfully perform the duties required.”_

We wanted to remind you that early voting is a convenient way to cast your vote before the crowds on Election Day November 5th. If you live in and around the College Park, here are a few early voting location options.
**Early Voting Locations:**
1. **College Park Auditorium**
* Address: 3631 Main St, College Park, GA 30337
* Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
2. **South Fulton Service Center**
* Address: 5600 Stonewall Tell Rd, College Park, GA 30349
* Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
3. **East Point Library**
* Address: 2757 Main St, East Point, GA 30344
* Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

**Important Dates:**
* Early voting runs from Tuesday, October 15 to Friday, November 1, 2024.
* Weekend voting is available on October 19th, 20th, 26th and 27th.

**What to Bring:**
* A valid photo ID (such as a driver’s license or state-issued ID card).
* Optional: Your sample ballot to review candidates and questions before arriving.

Make sure your voice is heard by voting early. Avoid long lines and ensure your vote counts in this critical election!

1\. **Amendment 1: Property Tax Exemption for Senior Citizens**

* **What it does** : This amendment proposes a property tax exemption for homeowners aged 65 and older. It aims to provide financial relief by reducing the property tax burden for seniors living on fixed incomes.

* **Impact** : If passed, seniors in our area will see reduced property taxes, potentially increasing affordability and allowing many to remain in their homes longer.

2\. **Amendment 2: Allocation of Funds for Public School Improvements**
* **What it does** : This amendment will allow for a portion of the state budget to be reallocated to improve public school infrastructure, focusing on repairs and technology upgrades.

* **Impact** : Passing this amendment could lead to significant improvements in our local schools, ensuring students in College Park have access to better facilities and technology.

3\. **Resolution 1: Expansion of Public Transit Funding**
* **What it does** : The resolution proposes expanding funding for public transportation, including bus routes and rail systems, particularly in under-served areas like parts of our district.

* **Impact** : Approval would mean increased public transportation options, reducing traffic congestion and making commuting more accessible for many residents.

**Why Your Vote Matters:** These measures will directly impact property taxes, education, and transportation services in College Park. Your voice in deciding on these amendments and resolution can shape the future of our community.

clean_body: It’s been 5 years since Trump made the corrupt phone call that forever altered the lives of me and my twin brother. Hello, It’s been 5 years since Trump made the corrupt phone call that forever altered the lives of me and my twin brother. On July 25, 2019, my brother Alexander Vindman listened as President Trump attempted to extort our ally Ukraine, a country at war, by withholding military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated Joe Biden. At the time, I was serving as the senior ethics official at the National Security Council in the White House. After Alex reported the call to me, my brother and I made the fateful decision to do our patriotic duty and stand up to Donald Trump at the risk of our decades-long military careers. We blew the whistle on him and reported his corrupt phone call with Ukraine up the chain of command. Our actions eventually led to his impeachment, and Trump retaliated by firing us from our posts. The decision to blow the whistle on Donald Trump cost my brother and me our military careers. But over two decades ago, I swore an oath to protect our country and our Constitution from threats, foreign and domestic, and I would not let Trump deter me from that duty. So I decided to run for Congress in Virginia to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy. But this race is one of the most competitive in the country, and my MAGA opponent has the backing of Trump and his millions of dollars. It’s not going to be easy to win. subject: I am FIRED UP after last night's debate against Ted Cruz
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
Hey, Peter, after I stepped off the debate stage with Ted Cruz last night, I’m feeling FIRED UP!
**[If you are too, chip in a split donation of $10 or more between my campaign and Lucas Kunce to help me finally beat Ted and protect our Senate majority!](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/77565?refcode=em20241016-8090&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8090%2E614464%2Elyw63D)**
Last night, I was able to reach millions of Texans and share my vision for a future where every Texas family has a chance at their version of the American Dream.
Ted Cruz ... was Ted Cruz.
He spewed lies and hate-filled rhetoric. Talked about what Texans can’t do, not what we can do. Put himself first in every sentence that came out of his mouth. And admitted he's going to do everything he can to ban abortion nationwide.
**
But here’s some real talk: Even though I know in my bones Texans are ready for change and we can beat Ted Cruz, I need _YOUR_ help to make sure we don’t waste our best chance to finally send him packing.
[So I’m personally asking: If you're as FIRED UP as I am right now, will you please chip in a split donation between my campaign and Lucas Kunce before tonight's final FEC deadline of this campaign at midnight to help me fire Ted Cruz and bring real leadership to Texas?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/77565?refcode=em20241016-8090&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8090%2E614464%2Elyw63D)

It took long hours, hard work, and a whole lot of hope, but we were able to win our American Dream. **That's why I made the decision to spend my career giving back to this incredible country and the state that gave me so much.**
I worked at several nonprofit organizations across Florida, helping to protect our wildlife and preserve our coral reefs. During my time working at Florida International University, I helped lead a new **program to** **improve access to affordable health care** for more Floridians.
In 2018, I decided to take these fights to Washington. I ran for Congress in a tough battleground district — and I won. In the House, **I wrote the bill to expand seniors’ Medicare Advantage coverage,** to ensure that more Americans could get the vital care they deserve. I also worked with Republicans to provide **economic relief to families and small businesses** and secured $200 million for **Everglades restoration. **
Throughout my time in Congress, **I fought tirelessly for commonsense gun safety reforms** , serving as the vice chair of the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force. This issue is deeply personal to me: When I was 24, my father was killed by a criminal with a gun. After leaving Congress, I joined Gabby Giffords' advocacy group as a senior advisor and continued to fight for safer communities and an end to the gun lobby's grip on Washington.
I'm incredibly proud of the work that I've done to uplift and protect my community. I'll never hide from my record. But I don't think that my opponent can say the same. **Rick Scott has spent his time in power writing the plan to cut Social Security and Medicare, attempting to undermine our elections, attacking our rights, and making it harder for working families to get ahead**. It's no wonder his approval ratings are tanking.

clean_body: Hi team, I just wanted to get a quick note out during this crazy time to say how thankful I am for you | | | = Hi, friend, thank you for being a part of this grassroots team to flip Florida blue. Your support truly means so much to me. I want to take a moment to tell you a bit about my record and why I'm in this race.= My mother brought my sisters and me to America when I was 14 to give us a chance at a better life. It took long hours, hard work, and a whole lot of hope, but we were able to win our American Dream. That's why I made the decision to spend my career giving back to this incredible country and the state that gave me so much. I worked at several nonprofit organizations across Florida, helping to protect our wildlife and preserve our coral reefs. During my time working at Florida International University, I helped lead a new program to improve access to affordable health care for more Floridians. In 2018, I decided to take these fights to Washington. I ran for Congress in a tough battleground district — and I won. In the House, I wrote the bill to expand seniors’ Medicare Advantage coverage, to ensure that more Americans could get the vital care they deserve. I also worked with Republicans to provide economic relief to families and small businesses and secured $200 million for Everglades restoration. Throughout my time in Congress, I fought tirelessly for commonsense gun safety reforms , serving as the vice chair of the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force. This issue is deeply personal to me: When I was 24, my father was killed by a criminal with a gun. After leaving Congress, I joined Gabby Giffords' advocacy group as a senior advisor and continued to fight for safer communities and an end to the gun lobby's grip on Washington. I'm incredibly proud of the work that I've done to uplift and protect my community. I'll never hide from my record. But I don't think that my opponent can say the same. Rick Scott has spent his time in power writing the plan to cut Social Security and Medicare, attempting to undermine our elections, attacking our rights, and making it harder for working families to get ahead. It's no wonder his approval ratings are tanking. My opponent is ranked as one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot this year, but I can only defeat him with strong grassroots support.= Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue. | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you, Debbie Mucarsel-Powell | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. The United States of America was built upon foundational beliefs, one of which was a profound reverence for God. While the U.S. is a secular nation by constitutional design, its roots are undeniably intertwined with religious convictions, particularly those stemming from the Judeo-Christian tradition. This connection to a belief in God can be traced back to the early settlers, the founding documents, and the values that shaped the nation's identity.
### The Pilgrims and Early Settlers
The story of America's founding begins with religious freedom seekers. The Pilgrims, who arrived on the Mayflower in 1620, were devout Christians fleeing religious persecution in England. They sought a new world where they could freely worship God according to their conscience. The Mayflower Compact, one of the earliest governing documents in American history, explicitly refers to undertaking their journey "for the Glory of God and advancement of the Christian faith."
The colonies that followed, including Puritan Massachusetts, Quaker Pennsylvania, and Catholic Maryland, were often founded with religious intentions. The emphasis on building communities centered around faith in God was a driving force in the creation of these early settlements. It provided a moral framework and a sense of purpose for the people seeking a new life in the Americas.
### The Founding Fathers and Religious Belief
When the Founding Fathers set out to create a new nation, they did so with a firm acknowledgment of a higher power. The Declaration of Independence, penned by Thomas Jefferson in 1776, is a striking example of this. It proclaims that all men are "endowed by their Creator with certain unalienable Rights." The use of the word "Creator" reflects the widespread belief in a divine being responsible for human dignity and the rights to life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.
While the Founding Fathers came from different religious backgrounds and held varying degrees of personal faith, most shared a belief in some form of divine providence guiding the nation. George Washington, in his Farewell Address, warned against the dangers of abandoning religion and morality, stating that "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of political prosperity.
### In God We Trust
This sentiment carried into the national values. The phrase "In God We Trust" was first introduced on U.S. coins in 1864 during the Civil War, reflecting the belief that the nation's survival and unity were dependent on divine guidance. It was later adopted as the official national motto in 1956, cementing the belief in God as a core aspect of American identity.
Throughout American history, moments of crisis and triumph have often been accompanied by appeals to God. Presidents regularly invoke God in their speeches, whether calling for unity, expressing gratitude, or offering hope in times of despair. From Abraham Lincoln's Second Inaugural Address, which referenced divine justice during the Civil War, to Ronald Reagan's frequent references to America as a "shining city on a hill," the belief in God has remained a powerful force in American political and cultural life.
### A Moral Foundation
The influence of religious belief in shaping American values cannot be overstated. The idea that human rights are God-given, and therefore inalienable, has been central to the nation's understanding of freedom and justice. The U.S. Constitution protects the free exercise of religion, allowing for a diversity of faiths to flourish while acknowledging the moral foundation that belief in God has provided.
As we approach the polls this November, it is crucial that we remember the importance of God in the fabric of our nation. Our country cannot endure if we stray from the foundational principles that have guided us. The Republican Party understands that faith in God must be central to our values and policies. When comparing the platforms of the Mississippi Republican Party and the Mississippi Democrat Party, it becomes clear that the Democrats fail to mention God, reflecting a stark contrast in priorities. The Republican Party recognizes that God must be at the heart of our lives, our state, and our nation, ensuring we remain strong and united.

# ▶️: Money in Politics: My Opponent’s Ties

Peter- the impact of money in politics is a major issue affecting us all.
[**I urge you to watch the video below to see how my opponent's corporate ties are impacting everyday Americans like you and me:**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=c51c187483&e=a2a46ff12c)

body:
We have less than four weeks until Election Day.

We must send President Trump back to the White House -- and we must ensure he has a Republican Senate majority to pass his agenda.

**[With less than four weeks to go, I'm asking you to split a donation between four campaigns that could decide who wins the Senate.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SHVfeQH56-6m6PPJE03BMQ~~/AARclAA~~)**

_**[Tim Sheehy](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SHVfeQH56-6m6PPJE03BMQ~~/AARclAA~~)**_ in Montana

_**[Mike Rogers](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SHVfeQH56-6m6PPJE03BMQ~~/AARclAA~~)**_ in Michigan

_**[Bernie Moreno](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SHVfeQH56-6m6PPJE03BMQ~~/AARclAA~~)**_ in Ohio

_**[Eric Hovde](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SHVfeQH56-6m6PPJE03BMQ~~/AARclAA~~)**_ in Wisconsin

**[Tim and Mike are fellow veterans. Bernie and Eric are proven business leaders. All four are tough conservatives.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SHVfeQH56-6m6PPJE03BMQ~~/AARclAA~~)**

_And all four are facing an onslaught of liberal attack ads in the last four weeks of this campaign. _

**[Each of these Senate races could come down to a handful of votes, so your support is especially important.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SHVfeQH56-6m6PPJE03BMQ~~/AARclAA~~)**

Tim, Mike, Bernie, and Eric are _counting on us to ensure they have the means_ to _answer the attacks_ , _contact voters_ with phone calls and door knocks, and _hold events_ over the next four weeks.

_Every single dollar will count, and while their opponents have millions from rich elites, they have you._

The road to the White House runs through these states, and so does the road to a Senate majority. **[Let's win, and let's make America strong again.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SHVfeQH56-6m6PPJE03BMQ~~/AARclAA~~)**

In Service,

**The moment we have been waiting for is here._Right now_ , voters are casting their ballots in swing states to decide the direction of our country.**
In 20 days, we must elect Democrats up and down the ballot nationwide who will fight for an America where women can make decisions about their own bodies, where everyone is free to love who they love openly and with pride, where communities have the freedom to be safe from gun violence, where people can afford everyday needs like health care and groceries, and where no child has to grow up in poverty.

Kamala

Peter, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Peter, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=8a8d1899d80046f1b9332504ff273093&_e=DKeLvX65tsbmiWQ294nbo4SmjmdTaAKTgZOzHNZPr3CwlxO-PIyFliCXweAZKAZgZPJsuZlTpUEGkzTAsCKyPfz6oEnfhXifngG1AvbEJetRVoC3PQro41s2QKVztFFKgqmeXZca6TPhTyqEjszMqqrDSjNAClAIysBZKQ24F0NN5ytizAgJj5EsgHaQNxKe52QjiPicdMTqPhBPz2XiDERcySqWXVK3uYU_xl5gRxN9Sn9ln6DikCfUAeekngODiU4LX-wTKfDBKvw98MnUnb6dP12S7aHBZdBZuLNb-UAdu-dQdZKDxS2Zx9hXr73u)_

* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

| **WI-08 Republican Nominee Tony Wied Releases First TV Ad: “Problem Solver”**
De Pere, WI – Republican nominee for Wisconsin’s 8th Congressional District Tony Wied today [released his first TV ad for the general election](https://tonywiedforcongress.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a68febad510b01304885a47be&id=01067d5e03&e=4c76b0e36b) highlighting his background as a small business owner and problem solver.
---
[](https://tonywiedforcongress.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a68febad510b01304885a47be&id=008dab85bd&e=4c76b0e36b)
| “I spent decades creating jobs right here in Northeast Wisconsin, and one thing I learned is real success doesn’t come from winning arguments, it comes from solving problems,” said Wied.
Wied’s ad goes on to focus on his commitment to securing our southern border, protecting senior’s Social Security and Medicare benefits, and ensuring Wisconsin farmers continue to thrive.
“WI-08 voters deserve to be represented by someone with real-world experience and a history of solving problems. Unlike his opponent, who would rather spend her time attacking people, Tony is focused on getting to work for the people of Northeast Wisconsin,” said Wied Campaign Manager Aidan Strongreen.

**Knock, knock, knock.**

_It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country._

_It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away._

_It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story._

We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth.

**America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back.**

I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world.

I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn.

Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election.

_And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets._

We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it.

I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go.

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: This genocide must end.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
Israel’s continued bombing and assault of the occupied Gaza strip under the leadership of Benjamin Netanyahu has been one of the most devastating and staggering conflicts in modern history.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1368%2E791427%2E85x6Ki)

[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-oct24-gaza-petition/?source=em241016-1-f&refcode2=1368.791427.85x6Ki&akid=1368%2E791427%2E85x6Ki)
Friend — It’s Ilhan.
You may have seen some of the images coming out of Gaza over the last few days.
They are more haunting and more terrifying than perhaps anything we have seen over the last year of destruction. And it comes at a time when Israel isn’t allowing humanitarian aid to get to people in Northern Gaza who face famine conditions.
Israel’s continued bombing and assault of the occupied Gaza strip under the leadership of Benjamin Netanyahu has been one of the most devastating and staggering conflicts in modern history.
International law has been thrown out the window. War crimes and human rights abuses are committed without consequence. Children and babies are killed at a rate never before seen. For Palestinians in Gaza there is no safety, no rest, no way to avoid the wanton violence of the Israeli military.
**Friend, I have been clear in my conviction that this is a genocide. One enabled by US bombs and ammunition.**
We’ve fought for months for a ceasefire, and we will continue that fight. But Netanyahu just isn’t interested. He doesn’t care how many innocent lives are taken. He wants to “finish the job.”
That’s why it’s past time to cut off Netanyahu and use our leverage to end his assault on Gaza. We have a moral imperative to end US complicity in war crimes, stop the bombing, reach a lasting ceasefire, and commit to an end to the Israeli occupation of Gaza and the West Bank.
**[If you agree, I’m asking you today to add your name to our petition. Help us call on the Biden administration to cut off military aid to Netanyahu’s war on Palestinians. Every day that we delay this necessary step is another day of danger for those in Gaza.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-oct24-gaza-petition/?source=em241016-1-f&refcode2=1368.791427.85x6Ki&akid=1368%2E791427%2E85x6Ki)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-oct24-gaza-petition/?source=em241016-1-f&refcode2=1368.791427.85x6Ki&akid=1368%2E791427%2E85x6Ki)**
This is heart wrenching. The last year has left many hopeless. But we can’t give up. We have no choice but to stand together, organize, and do everything we can for the Palestinian people.
In solidarity with you, Gaza, and oppressed people around the world,
— Ilhan Omar

PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
