subject: Reminder: Rural Evangelicals for Harris Call Tue. Oct. 22
body:
Join Call With Rural Believers | |
---
| | | As a reminder, you are warmly invited to join us for a [Rural Evangelicals for Harris supporter zoom call](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=bba9d4ab44&e=43463f1dee) Tuesday October 22 from 8 – 9 pm ET.

Developed by and for rural and agricultural families and those who support them, **please **[**join us**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=50e1556c1f&e=43463f1dee)** and other rural believers for prayer, encouragement, and discussion of Harris/Walz administration policies that will benefit rural and agricultural families and communities. **We’ll also discuss ways **Evangelicals for Harris supporters can do more to elect Harris and Walz in these final weeks before the election.**

This is an off the record conversation.

Please register [here](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=482b78d61e&e=43463f1dee). We look forward to seeing you Tuesday October 22 from 8-9 pm ET.

_**"Do not be confirmed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what the will of God is, that which is good and acceptable and perfect."**_(Romans 12:2)

This is one of our favorite Bible verses because it reminds us that we are to love God with our mind. We hope this call provides you with prayer, encouragement, and engagement as you discern the best ways you can support Harris and Walz.

Please pray for those in rural and agricultural communities who are supporting Harris and Walz. Thank you for all you’re doing. We’re praying for you.

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

| Peter,

I had my debate with Anthony D’Esposito last night – I’m glad that I had the opportunity to talk about my plan for making progress for Long Island families in Congress.

While Anthony D’Esposito was dodging responsibility, I held him accountable for wasting taxpayer dollars to give a no-show job to his mistress. He’s shown he serves his own self-interests and not Long Island families.

Reproductive rights are personal to women across the country. I shared a personal story about receiving abortion care and reaffirmed my commitment to protecting reproductive freedom for every woman across Long Island. But Anthony D’Esposito has time and time again voted to restrict reproductive rights, specifically voted to take away the right to abortion for women in the military.

Anthony D’Esposito held zero town halls in the district, but in my time as a Town Supervisor, I held more than a dozen town halls to directly hear from voters on issues that matter most and get things done for families.

It's clear that there’s only one candidate in this race who is ready to defend reproductive rights, protect our democracy and lower costs for working families across Long Island. _**I’m proud to be that candidate and you can count on me to deliver progress and be a champion for our district in Congress.**_

But polls show this toss-up race is close and it will take significant resources to defeat Anthony D’Esposito this November.

This is one of the biggest and most personally meaningful moments in our race for Florida's Senate seat. **Former President Barack Obama just endorsed me!** To have the support from President Obama is a humbling moment. I was proud to volunteer for his campaign in 2008 and 2012, and I’m so proud to have his support in mine. He is a true public servant and a determined campaigner who has fought hard to better our nation. He believes in the grassroots movement we've built, Peter — a movement that includes you. Together, with Barack Obama fighting alongside us, we will defeat Rick Scott and protect our Democratic Senate majority! And today, my campaign is proud to launch an ad featuring President Obama speaking to the importance of our race. [**You can watch that ad here I hope you love it as much as I do.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95129526/505691746/1556523653?refcode=urd-em-241016-dmpobama&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU3MjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2I4YWQ0ZWItYzY4Yi1lZjExLTg0NzMtMDAyMjQ4MzAyOWZhIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=S_7TZGiaYoqz87yFizFsuOdK66cGHZhYb5ZEVuks5ts=&emci=ff842f1a-458a-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=cb8ad4eb-c68b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&ceid=12041085) **** This endorsement will fuel a huge amount of momentum, but we cannot rest on our laurels for a second. In fact, President Obama's endorsement and belief in this race is a signal for us to work even harder. # Hello !
---
| As we move into the final stretch of this campaign, I want to invite you to a special event to celebrate all the hard work we’ve put into making this race a success: "Honk and Oink" at the Green Pig Pub! This will be our final fundraiser, and it’s going to be a fun evening of food, music, and community. We’ll have shirts for sale, a raffle with great prizes, and of course, the bar will be open. Let’s gather to toast this incredible journey together!
---
| | | | | | | [](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=a72add5dc2&e=830e7edf7b)
---
|
# Honk & Oink!
October 21st 6PMThe Green Pig Pub: 31 E 400 S, Salt Lake City
---
---
[RSVP](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=038daa3c2a&e=830e7edf7b)
| | | | | | | |
## We Won’t Go Back
I’m also excited to share that I’ll be attending the **National Women's March** on **November 2nd.** This year’s march is more critical than ever as we continue to fight for reproductive freedom and personal autonomy. I hope to see many of you there as we stand up for the rights and futures of all women, here in Utah and across the country.
---
---
[Learn More](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=7e11b572bf&e=830e7edf7b)

| | | | | | | |
## Greenwave Rally
Lastly, I was honored to attend the Greenwave Rally for reproductive freedom, where I shared my commitment to ensuring every person has the right to make personal decisions about their health, identity, and faith without government interference.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Today, I’d like to share my story with you
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Aphasia may make it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.
#

Friends -
On January 8, 2011, a gunman shot me in the head while I was meeting with constituents in front of a grocery store in Tucson.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em241016-1-30&t=1&akid=9207%2E3935704%2EzeRHwU)This is me being medevaced from the scene of the shooting. Six people were killed on this horrific day.
The bullet damaged the left side of my brain, where language is processed, leading to a condition called aphasia. This means that even though the words are in my head, I have a hard time getting them out.
**Aphasia may make it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em241016-1-30&t=2&akid=9207%2E3935704%2EzeRHwU)Doctors didn’t know if I’d ever be able to speak again, but I defied the odds.
The road to recovery hasn’t been easy for me, but I’ve never given up. In addition to speech therapy and physical therapy, I dedicate much of my time to riding my bike, playing my French horn, and practicing yoga. These activities have helped me so much in my recovery journey.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em241016-1-30&t=3&akid=9207%2E3935704%2EzeRHwU)Here’s a picture of me with my speech therapist, Fabi!
Many people may think that I founded GIFFORDS after my own shooting, but that is actually not the case. I founded GIFFORDS in 2013 after the mass shooting at Sandy Hook Elementary School in Newtown, CT, which left 20 young children and six teachers dead. As I watched the headlines unfold on that horrible, horrible day, I knew that I had to do something. And so GIFFORDS, then known as Americans for Responsible Solutions, was born.
Since GIFFORDS’ founding, we have made significant progress in our gun violence prevention movement. We’ve helped pass over 620 gun laws in states nationwide, and in 2022 we helped pass the most significant federal gun safety legislation in 30 years.
But the work is far from over, and we need to continue building our resources if we’re going to continue making progress. Tonight at midnight, we’re up against the most critical fundraising deadline we’ve faced this entire election cycle: the pre-general election FEC fundraising deadline. This is our final FEC deadline before Election Day.
The gun lobby will be scanning our final FEC fundraising report intently, and they’ll be ready to swoop in and make their last spending decisions against our endorsed gun safety champions if we don’t have a strong showing on our final FEC report.
[**So friends, I need to call on you today. Will you make your first online contribution of $3 to GIFFORDS PAC before our final FEC fundraising deadline of the election cycle passes at midnight?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em241016-1-30&t=4&akid=9207%2E3935704%2EzeRHwU)

name: Bob MacGuffie
subject: Breaking Commentary
body:
Chris Murphy - Master of Purposeful Deception
| | | |
---
| \-- Reporting from the Political Front --
---
---
| | October 16, 2024
Since the Democrats are getting yet another free ride from corporate media in general, and Hearst Media in particular, I had to weigh-in on one of the more effectively deceitful of the subversive seven CT federal reps. The below appears as an article in today's [Connecticut Centinal:](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SkfGeh-LgJnhk94Nzo2ff3c_5nYHgNiLilefSepY9T-temtXrZbghbTpPMkGNS9jhMXakO8AIELlDlT3Aeh5BHXpjQ10ItBC0BtT8LuQgW86NFlwhmLAyuHcZUu7D5VLFUwT4_AWrJP26E-J3nO3H1BU6mKO7HLFWg8pZjG4M4iuwOGrR1ZSSgt5zYrXAyogbBh2DNZfYSL0ExdQEUr5bItuJnXN-2qw&c=s1lJN53em79tiIAcupRXvuRTM8cWhhlHpQbiUuguj1i6BJ3qj26fYQ==&ch=7k2j6Ji0IBNi0r9wdQwhw-ffXXRsEsjSphfjOMl-kt3rQn8fRZ3WkQ==)

Chris Murphy - Master of Purposeful Deception By Bob MacGuffie This man, who deigns to represent CT in the U.S. Senate, and has never worked a day in the private sector, is currently up for reelection for a third term. He's 51, has been holding elective offices since age 24, and undoubtedly expects to live off us taxpayers until incapacitated or he expires in office. Murphy's Williams College thesis, "The Second Entry: A reevaluation of Congressional Challengers and Arguments for the Stimulation of Competition in U.S. House Elections," would indicate he favors robust campaign debate. But with $10 million on hand for this race, he finally grudgingly submitted to debate the Republican nominee, Matt Corey - but not until a week before the election. That posture indicates either deep concern for the soft ground under his feet, or straight-up arrogance toward those who would challenge his record. Or - some other of his favorite fork-tongued explanations. In order to keep intact the patina protecting political deception, one must also be a high practitioner of seamless double speak. In that regard, Mr. Murphy was schooled at the feet of the congressional Jedi Master, Chris Van Hollen. Murphy learned well and quickly, during his House years, and has been deploying his high-wire act of successive public deceptions ever since he entered the senate in 2013. It is an 'art' that many try, but few can actually pull off seamlessly. Bill Clinton was a master, doing political calculus right before our eyes without garbling a word. G.W. Bush tried, but earned the 'tongue-tied' moniker. Barack Obama persisted and delivered his famous ah-uhs throughout his responses. Even Mr. Murphy's disciple, Jim Himes regularly talks his way into blind alleys. Whenever Hearst Media gets around to questioning Murphy about his support or justification for the budget-busting deficit spending and accumulated national debt, he deflects with aplomb, responding with the exhausted canard that the Republicans are giving tax breaks to corporations and billionaires. And of course, there's rarely a follow-up. For the record, Mr. Murphy voted for $26T of the $36 trillion current national debt. He is currently voting for $2T of debt annually and the Treasury is allocating $1.2T to pay interest on that ballooning debt, so Murphy has joined the rest of Connecticut's seven federal representatives in literally voting our Republic into bankruptcy - while continually sporting his glib face in all media appearances. On the healthcare front, he voted for ObamaCare, telling us it was the cure the healthcare industry needed, and would drive down costs some $2,500 on average - known lies the moment he uttered them. Ever since, he tells us it's "not perfect" and there's "work to do," all as healthcare and insurance costs cripple the middle class, and as he incessantly e-mails us for just $3 more for his campaign coffers. But, perhaps his most audacious and dangerous gambit is that he fancies himself some kind of foreign policy expert or diplomat. It's actually not much of a reach - the Democrats have not an ambulatory soul with a foreign policy achievement in their portfolio to put forward. The highest visibility foreign policy issue to which Murphy has lashed himself is the Obama-negotiated Iran nuclear deal, the JCPOA (Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action). The enactment of this Agreement was itself a master-class in public deception by the Obama Administration. Because the deal would never pass as a treaty requiring a 2/3 approval vote in the senate, Obama negotiated it as an "agreement" negotiated and signed in the Executive branch. It was concluded without the "advice and consent" of the Senate, as required by the Constitution. This political ju-jitsu was one of the most consequential deceptions of the Obama era, and Chris Murphy was one of the most prominent mouthpieces espousing and defending this deceit upon the American citizenry. Subsequently, President Trump ended the Agreement and imposed the sanctions that financially crippled Iran, causing it to stop funding its Hezbollah and Hamas proxies, and providing Israel a few years of breathing space. Murphy was so incensed at these America First actions that he decided to run a highly controversial interference play, meeting secretly with the Iranian foreign minister in February 2020, just at the start of the presidential campaign. The question of whose foreign policy was being advanced hangs over that off-the-agenda meeting. Don Pesci covered the entire affair in a lengthy [Article](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SkfGeh-LgJnhk94Nzo2ff3c_5nYHgNiLilefSepY9T-temtXrZbghbTpPMkGNS9jWE0OrdmSd8KYSqgbeiQ4a87IqYLfN6ciFGdyHKopw_4u9Jr24O4rTFGwan4Ea5-tlYlHnwdgvkedEwpfwxGnR6SHjxWue4vWR7Y2kqEBpzaim8ObuTZzapL07EErkJ0M1WvmHqcEX-8AjACTOip2MwW_8O3rljUl&c=s1lJN53em79tiIAcupRXvuRTM8cWhhlHpQbiUuguj1i6BJ3qj26fYQ==&ch=7k2j6Ji0IBNi0r9wdQwhw-ffXXRsEsjSphfjOMl-kt3rQn8fRZ3WkQ==) a couple weeks back. Then there's the constant gaslighting of his CT constituents and indeed, the entire nation. A perfect example is his "explanation" surrounding the Chinese spy balloon which wasn't shot down until after it transited over sensitive military locations across the U.S. His comments captured on this [video presser](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SkfGeh-LgJnhk94Nzo2ff3c_5nYHgNiLilefSepY9T-temtXrZbghbTpPMkGNS9j4Q2ca-O4Mn2sxZSGy_v7zSc2l7SyLsu5BHbjo8etAvhB-BeiN_LtkP6-xZaMzZ3BVsgQtS70tI6QBccJqVbJWtMeKaDqDiM5mIDbKlbQ2pZXjYXVbqHdx2gE-dK_-NwACDec5IIDudm56KCK5Ec7LWAcyiR5H0e4aAsG6yxogVxHPawrIRFnEB70U8ZvXoU-&c=s1lJN53em79tiIAcupRXvuRTM8cWhhlHpQbiUuguj1i6BJ3qj26fYQ==&ch=7k2j6Ji0IBNi0r9wdQwhw-ffXXRsEsjSphfjOMl-kt3rQn8fRZ3WkQ==) in the U.S. Capitol are both cynical and insulting to any American with a thinking brain. He made the following comments at the microphone: "it posed no threat to the U.S.... we decided not to shoot it down over the Aleutian Islands because we deemed it valuable to collect intelligence on its operation... the data collected will pay dividends... we restored deterrence - we made it clear we're going to take these balloons down." Indeed - shoot down the balloon AFTER it collects valuable intelligence on our sensitive military installations! Connecticut citizens should be incensed being spoken to like this by a man sworn to represent and protect their interests. Clearly, Chris Murphy does not represent the interests of the average citizens of Connecticut. Instead, he represents the interests of the class in which he is firmly ensconced - the ruling political elite. Which brings us to the motivation for Murphy's perpetual game of public deception. As a bona fide member of our betters in the ruling elite, he believes he carries what's called the "vision of the anointed" and knows what is best for us all. Angelo Codevilla spelled out the dynamics of how elite rule is perpetuated in America in his brilliant book, [The Ruling Class](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SkfGeh-LgJnhk94Nzo2ff3c_5nYHgNiLilefSepY9T-temtXrZbghbTpPMkGNS9jfPOVQVDkYNpq-ZwkjEqJUEAXseLkHFo-tr2HH59OS801-LIRdnIm4hFM-Lo_k_rnYDk7CcIHtjOpyXqaiKeEkcAgedJ7NrG3WJK5B6fHy41typ4wjm_4lyKzczgnQR8j9d5yLUHh1TFfDG_BSY82rFzpri3rpkgEJUXc0XBcbUUYQkOXdEIVSP6Hf2cuy0_HlwAIzMN6ohjC382cx34NLmfcWajzKORYb3a_SUoiCIcO_6W_AfvMt9oQnQXypdwUz2QQ3mRoudlLS4m4Hlw9j3xatsvTwD3sPKy7F3l8NZr9OdmyIHQ0xANeFnbW6SDh9u0_O2XOBSRNq22e2H2xr1PV3FnligS8aV6vuTnf4o5U6HJ0a8I8TdwirIPXAl5sQKH7Zr-58GhQncpA9ckWY8dv0qafCDZBeUO29EHXhHjMyLGr_R8ZqrLmGoFehn2-9Y2LK1BM82v5Y7H8HETy_UzODF25IoLuLy1r0VWtbBapZLnASY_CI5kudxidZ-Y09cOu3TlUxpIUPJxkZw2euT0P7wXfxv4yOXA40MDsfzCL7S2UETcRYsWc4SibkrYmbV6TtpyyuIuzNP36_rJKzhFsX45X-dRZJm1UQE6R4rnkOwxV00_UwMFi00B2g2ZklCcDc7qCTSz7M7muED3WE3P1KIjtiJQRd5zxGOGT_Ssw_E2Bkvq6WQijjQ8QE68Wgm8biHWEFG74VN-PAbbIk8pBLK-Q0wpgd07wCEU0h2NPeSlKPEOyuaCc2Fnt0BKryrG3tJRNOx-JtRkn1EGs4My_R-D_x5ga&c=s1lJN53em79tiIAcupRXvuRTM8cWhhlHpQbiUuguj1i6BJ3qj26fYQ==&ch=7k2j6Ji0IBNi0r9wdQwhw-ffXXRsEsjSphfjOMl-kt3rQn8fRZ3WkQ==). The book plainly exposes how this prestigiously educated group benefit themselves through high taxes, increasing debt, and the ever-expanding reach of government. And in recent years, their self-serving machinations are no longer hidden, but instead have been on display for us all to observe on a weekly basis. At heart Chris Murphy believes America is a declining power, and he has secured for himself a role in managing that decline - for the good of us all of course, but most assuredly for the good of himself. What we see in his public (and secret) acts is his genuflecting to the wannabee hegemon of the Middle East, Iran - but ultimately and more importantly to its benefactor, China, the rising global hegemon. Joined at the political hip with Murphy is fourth district Congressman Jim Himes, who in a congressional hearing last year labored mightily to draw a distinction between "de-coupling" and "de-risking" with China in a carefully crafted minuet with the witness, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen. I covered the revealing testimony in an [Article](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SkfGeh-LgJnhk94Nzo2ff3c_5nYHgNiLilefSepY9T-temtXrZbghX4uE8T7CgXosW8gA_rQSyyb0DdJJTIaGlm7A3c5KaTIOI6lXtIPNqlybgW8Al30z37uvVk0jtXAZk8WmwS5U5UXDWuCmg6Rtw==&c=s1lJN53em79tiIAcupRXvuRTM8cWhhlHpQbiUuguj1i6BJ3qj26fYQ==&ch=7k2j6Ji0IBNi0r9wdQwhw-ffXXRsEsjSphfjOMl-kt3rQn8fRZ3WkQ==) at the time. Mr. Himes' purpose was to make sure the lucrative outsourcing business arrangements of his donors were not disrupted, as the American people were awakening to the danger China poses to America. What's happened to America's ruling political class has been perfectly depicted by the Heritage Foundation in its essay, coining the term [Elite-Capture](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SkfGeh-LgJnhk94Nzo2ff3c_5nYHgNiLilefSepY9T-temtXrZbghbTpPMkGNS9j9fWCUYQMM9QVEp1N80Qunf4Tnfz8ZS2tJXpQOjeUwtAgjIIaV_M4p9dOfGHJNrl6Dz-FUuEjlYOdlrYGUuKenXZwM6ibIhnuNFTwHL05VGGYTkICToHAtUD3NU6GtjfZq3cHZeViINOBfGT6CYWaspcML7Jtnryy8cUOYgsem1OjwnuNqUFmZfCAt1ozmfTAmPqZ_x-McdJh6VuqvRMYlJmZ1TrPEcJB&c=s1lJN53em79tiIAcupRXvuRTM8cWhhlHpQbiUuguj1i6BJ3qj26fYQ==&ch=7k2j6Ji0IBNi0r9wdQwhw-ffXXRsEsjSphfjOMl-kt3rQn8fRZ3WkQ==). Stop wondering how our "representatives" could be taking all the seemingly counter-intuitive actions they do. They clearly believe America is on the arc of decline. They are more interested in preserving themselves a privileged place in the new order, when China ultimately rises, which they believe is inevitable. They haven't the gut for reversing the decline and endeavoring to return America, its citizens, and its exceptional founding principles and traditions, to its leadership position in the modern world which it was instrumental in establishing. Chris Murphy's senate term expires at the end of this year. Today, Republican [Matt Corey](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SkfGeh-LgJnhk94Nzo2ff3c_5nYHgNiLilefSepY9T-temtXrZbghbTpPMkGNS9jyCznYNWmLcW-FQjJlR71MYklf73dUYinT_UwQV6NUt-0rRJw6NJzSeZ0k5maVyCbMT0KWXXP3vF9g8bORxDZjIoLX3agOMFH&c=s1lJN53em79tiIAcupRXvuRTM8cWhhlHpQbiUuguj1i6BJ3qj26fYQ==&ch=7k2j6Ji0IBNi0r9wdQwhw-ffXXRsEsjSphfjOMl-kt3rQn8fRZ3WkQ==) of Manchester, CT is running a campaign making this election a referendum on Mr. Murphy's reign. He's been challenging Murphy on many of these issues and more. Matt is a patriot, a Navy veteran, small businessman, and he's vowed to actually represent the interests of the citizens of Connecticut in the U.S. Senate. I would urge everyone to spread the word on the Corey campaign. We can end the deceptive and corrosive rule of Chris Murphy on Nov. 5th
---

---
---
| In Liberty,
Bob MacGuffie bobmac@rightprinciples.com

clean_body: Chris Murphy - Master of Purposeful Deception | | | | | \-- Reporting from the Political Front -- | | October 16, 2024 Since the Democrats are getting yet another free ride from corporate media in general, and Hearst Media in particular, I had to weigh-in on one of the more effectively deceitful of the subversive seven CT federal reps. The below appears as an article in today's == Chris Murphy - Master of Purposeful Deception By Bob MacGuffie This man, who deigns to represent CT in the U.S. Senate, and has never worked a day in the private sector, is currently up for reelection for a third term. He's 51, has been holding elective offices since age 24, and undoubtedly expects to live off us taxpayers until incapacitated or he expires in office. Murphy's Williams College thesis, "The Second Entry: A reevaluation of Congressional Challengers and Arguments for the Stimulation of Competition in U.S. House Elections," would indicate he favors robust campaign debate. But with $10 million on hand for this race, he finally grudgingly submitted to debate the Republican nominee, Matt Corey - but not until a week before the election. That posture indicates either deep concern for the soft ground under his feet, or straight-up arrogance toward those who would challenge his record. Or - some other of his favorite fork-tongued explanations. In order to keep intact the patina protecting political deception, one must also be a high practitioner of seamless double speak. In that regard, Mr. Murphy was schooled at the feet of the congressional Jedi Master, Chris Van Hollen. Murphy learned well and quickly, during his House years, and has been deploying his high-wire act of successive public deceptions ever since he entered the senate in 2013. It is an 'art' that many try, but few can actually pull off seamlessly. Bill Clinton was a master, doing political calculus right before our eyes without garbling a word. G.W. Bush tried, but earned the 'tongue-tied' moniker. Barack Obama persisted and delivered his famous ah-uhs throughout his responses. Even Mr. Murphy's disciple, Jim Himes regularly talks his way into blind alleys. Whenever Hearst Media gets around to questioning Murphy about his support or justification for the budget-busting deficit spending and accumulated national debt, he deflects with aplomb, responding with the exhausted canard that the Republicans are giving tax breaks to corporations and billionaires. And of course, there's rarely a follow-up. For the record, Mr. Murphy voted for $26T of the $36 trillion current national debt. He is currently voting for $2T of debt annually and the Treasury is allocating $1.2T to pay interest on that ballooning debt, so Murphy has joined the rest of Connecticut's seven federal representatives in literally voting our Republic into bankruptcy - while continually sporting his glib face in all media appearances. On the healthcare front, he voted for ObamaCare, telling us it was the cure the healthcare industry needed, and would drive down costs some $2,500 on average - known lies the moment he uttered them. Ever since, he tells us it's "not perfect" and there's "work to do," all as healthcare and insurance costs cripple the middle class, and as he incessantly e-mails us for just $3 more for his campaign coffers. But, perhaps his most audacious and dangerous gambit is that he fancies himself some kind of foreign policy expert or diplomat. It's actually not much of a reach - the Democrats have not an ambulatory soul with a foreign policy achievement in their portfolio to put forward. The highest visibility foreign policy issue to which Murphy has lashed himself is the Obama-negotiated Iran nuclear deal, the JCPOA (Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action). The enactment of this Agreement was itself a master-class in public deception by the Obama Administration. Because the deal would never pass as a treaty requiring a 2/3 approval vote in the senate, Obama negotiated it as an "agreement" negotiated and signed in the Executive branch. It was concluded without the "advice and consent" of the Senate, as required by the Constitution. This political ju-jitsu was one of the most consequential deceptions of the Obama era, and Chris Murphy was one of the most prominent mouthpieces espousing and defending this deceit upon the American citizenry. Subsequently, President Trump ended the Agreement and imposed the sanctions that financially crippled Iran, causing it to stop funding its Hezbollah and Hamas proxies, and providing Israel a few years of breathing space. Murphy was so incensed at these America First actions that he decided to run a highly controversial interference play, meeting secretly with the Iranian foreign minister in February 2020, just at the start of the presidential campaign. The question of whose foreign policy was being advanced hangs over that off-the-agenda meeting. Don Pesci covered the entire affair in a lengthy == a couple weeks back. Then there's the constant gaslighting of his CT constituents and indeed, the entire nation. A perfect example is his "explanation" surrounding the Chinese spy balloon which wasn't shot down until after it transited over sensitive military locations across the U.S. His comments captured on this == in the U.S. Capitol are both cynical and insulting to any American with a thinking brain. He made the following comments at the microphone: "it posed no threat to the U.S.... we decided not to shoot it down over the Aleutian Islands because we deemed it valuable to collect intelligence on its operation... the data collected will pay dividends... we restored deterrence - we made it clear we're going to take these balloons down." Indeed - shoot down the balloon AFTER it collects valuable intelligence on our sensitive military installations! Connecticut citizens should be incensed being spoken to like this by a man sworn to represent and protect their interests. Clearly, Chris Murphy does not represent the interests of the average citizens of Connecticut. Instead, he represents the interests of the class in which he is firmly ensconced - the ruling political elite. Which brings us to the motivation for Murphy's perpetual game of public deception. As a bona fide member of our betters in the ruling elite, he believes he carries what's called the "vision of the anointed" and knows what is best for us all. Angelo Codevilla spelled out the dynamics of how elite rule is perpetuated in America in his brilliant book, ==. The book plainly exposes how this prestigiously educated group benefit themselves through high taxes, increasing debt, and the ever-expanding reach of government. And in recent years, their self-serving machinations are no longer hidden, but instead have been on display for us all to observe on a weekly basis. At heart Chris Murphy believes America is a declining power, and he has secured for himself a role in managing that decline - for the good of us all of course, but most assuredly for the good of himself. What we see in his public (and secret) acts is his genuflecting to the wannabee hegemon of the Middle East, Iran - but ultimately and more importantly to its benefactor, China, the rising global hegemon. Joined at the political hip with Murphy is fourth district Congressman Jim Himes, who in a congressional hearing last year labored mightily to draw a distinction between "de-coupling" and "de-risking" with China in a carefully crafted minuet with the witness, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen. I covered the revealing testimony in an == at the time. Mr. Himes' purpose was to make sure the lucrative outsourcing business arrangements of his donors were not disrupted, as the American people were awakening to the danger China poses to America. What's happened to America's ruling political class has been perfectly depicted by the Heritage Foundation in its essay, coining the term ==. Stop wondering how our "representatives" could be taking all the seemingly counter-intuitive actions they do. They clearly believe America is on the arc of decline. They are more interested in preserving themselves a privileged place in the new order, when China ultimately rises, which they believe is inevitable. They haven't the gut for reversing the decline and endeavoring to return America, its citizens, and its exceptional founding principles and traditions, to its leadership position in the modern world which it was instrumental in establishing. Chris Murphy's senate term expires at the end of this year. Today, Republican == of Manchester, CT is running a campaign making this election a referendum on Mr. Murphy's reign. He's been challenging Murphy on many of these issues and more. Matt is a patriot, a Navy veteran, small businessman, and he's vowed to actually represent the interests of the citizens of Connecticut in the U.S. Senate. I would urge everyone to spread the word on the Corey campaign. subject: Man… F*** Barack Obama....
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE
body:
He said Black Men supporting Trump is “unacceptable” |
---

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=2df2c3e2229d458fa54027153b2fd979&_e=EXCyUFX12j5vEXClY89oM8uBV5xxEkuWsP8yLBMirUV36I1JshjDPH0JWFsOGsOTj4jMNnezg3Qbj_IQa0STRoTWLtU6oyAqByibkDjI-J19zX5qtbnReayBcvUVpUWuBBYbkOCL0HiVrNZ57I8sUxF4YoYCZtpbS3xWJHHru_LnQ4qV16JkpG_hSUINXOzUFK3YKG2LzouDY100w0OqhR4QhoQ9G0x1Vq9bA_ltV82iFvvyIXOuqqaDDj98z1wSOVRuVGu1X7_FnF5mIIf_r8j6l5embcGBGh7KWtPMex0odRgWjNE-KH-X7U1UivPkjwun9IrWwDW2PpNYd8rccg%3D%3D)
Fellow American,

Barack Obama delivered a message to “the brothers,” AKA Black Men.

He told us, “We have not yet seen the same kinds of energy and turnout in all quarters of our neighborhoods and communities as we saw when I was running,” and to quit making “excuses” and vote for Kamala.

Well, Obama, I have a message for you, “brother.”

[**THE PEOPLE ARE COMING!**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=2df2c3e2229d458fa54027153b2fd979&_e=EXCyUFX12j5vEXClY89oM8uBV5xxEkuWsP8yLBMirUV36I1JshjDPH0JWFsOGsOTj4jMNnezg3Qbj_IQa0STRoTWLtU6oyAqByibkDjI-J19zX5qtbnReayBcvUVpUWuBBYbkOCL0HiVrNZ57I8sUxF4YoYCZtpbS3xWJHHru_LnQ4qV16JkpG_hSUINXOzU8VhRNKk4Oca8IdOOITXihCJdUxd7MXvpIv8iJZAonu8TAC_tqcRhHUYO1zk_3pNlg3eIutK-c53UxE6W_2Q5Sx6BL-0b5XJCeghf5mSotfW5kJ8P6SRFncfD5gfms4dz2O-FM5HQ8ym4kNaixB6DAw%3D%3D)
You’re not seeing the same kinds of energy and enthusiasm for Kamala Harris as when you ran because our community has WOKEN UP to your lies and deceitfulness.

We are not making “excuses.” We are thinking for ourselves. We see what’s happened to not just the Black Community but to the rest of America in the past four years. In fact, it hasn’t even been just the past four years. In the past 16 years, Democrats have controlled the country for 12 of them.

America only thrived during the four years of the Trump Administration.

Black Men are not blind. We’re able to see that the Radical Left’s policies have been crippling America.

It’s not an “excuse,” it’s a REASON!

That’s why I entered politics after a successful career in professional basketball.

I’m sick and tired of Liberals telling me what to think, how to think, and who to vote for.

Now, I’m running against Amy Klobuchar, an Obama-era Radical Leftist who’s done nothing but help the Left to destroy America.

**I need your help if I’m going to win.

The election is less than 25 days away, and I’m tight on cash.**

_I need to place TV ads and knock on doors in Minnesota so I can reach undecided voters with my unfiltered, uncensored message._

[**Can you donate just $25 before midnight to help me win?**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=2df2c3e2229d458fa54027153b2fd979&_e=EXCyUFX12j5vEXClY89oM8uBV5xxEkuWsP8yLBMirUV36I1JshjDPH0JWFsOGsOTj4jMNnezg3Qbj_IQa0STRoTWLtU6oyAqByibkDjI-J19zX5qtbnReayBcvUVpUWuBBYbkOCL0HiVrNZ57I8sUxF4YoYCZtpbS3xWJHHru_LnQ4qV16JkpG_hSUINXOzUQPJrG9v_690iYnfWWYBGkdUtWvbsDDLCs7wybk0O2Jh6KpRS2rJMAaLggjvaxIPMBKDv2WIC_heZ-6xdHd3-Q3XFtYvVUY1Aqnlu8PZ5kH2tFcHbPhD51xN2hFJD-ajoUROLR7xUd_n0AN0ofql49A%3D%3D)

The People Are Coming,

Royce White

_Republicans are at a serious disadvantage in the final sprint of the election._

Meanwhile, House Democrats are swimming in cash and Kamala Harris is cutting down-ballot Liberals huge checks.

Unless we can ignite a **MASSIVE** fundraising surge in these final days, our chances of taking it all will drop like a lead balloon.

body:
We know a lot of folks are probably asking for your help today
#
Friend — Mandela Barnes here.
I wanted to send a note and remind you that **the final FEC deadline for our Long Run candidates across the country is tonight at midnight.**
This is a make or break moment for these candidates — candidates whose races for the House and Senate will not only decide who controls Congress for the next two years, but will help decide who wins the White House too.
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-oct24.GI1eop&refcode=em241016-1-c&t=1&akid=5421%2E196590%2ETH0kPz)

Throughout this election cycle, The Long Run has helped raise hundreds of thousands of dollars for changemaking candidates who are committed to running grassroots campaigns.
And we’ve also put the resources we’ve raised to work to boost progressive turnout in crucial swing states like my home state of Wisconsin, where recent polls show Donald Trump ahead by at least 1%.

Moms: Consider Now Before Voting in the 2024 Presidential Election

Election season can be a jumble of soundbites and spin. Last week, we considered Harris' and Trump's background – their past. It's
time to look at what Americans are facing right now. We are considering several top issues, including the economy, abortion,
hurricane relief, education, and tensions threatening to boil on the world stage.

[] [] [] October 15, 2024 • Newsletter [] [] A Conservative's Survival Guide Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] [] Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] [] Election season is heating up. Amy Travis, Executive Director of the Stand Coalition, has strategies for quieting the noise and making a difference. Her latest book is "A Conservative’s Survival Guide to Election Season and Beyond." It's a resource for moms in need of encouragement and practical tips for explaining the source of our conservative values and communicating them to friends and family. Through the Stand Coalition, Amy has united Bible-believing conservatives in the mission of standing for God and country in the public square. Like, Subscribe and Share! View the Podcast [] Listen to the Podcast [] Listen to the Podcast on Spotify [] [] [] Moms: Consider Now Before Voting in the 2024 Presidential Election Election season can be a jumble of soundbites and spin. Last week, we considered Harris' and Trump's background – their past. It's time to look at what Americans are facing right now. We are considering several top issues, including the economy, abortion, hurricane relief, education, and tensions threatening to boil on the world stage. What are the candidates' current responses to these crucial issues? What should you consider as you vote early or head to the poll in a few weeks? | | **For Immediate Release:** October 16, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**MIN DOUBLES UP BAUGH IN FUNDRAISING IN CA-47**
_Min raises $2.08 million to Baugh’s $1.02 million in Key Congressional Race _
**IRVINE, CA** — Now that Scott Baugh’s fundraising numbers have been reported, it has become clear that the Dave Min for Congress campaign has once again beaten Scott Baugh and his MAGA cronies, making Min’s campaign 3 for 3 in the post-primary fundraising race in California’s 47th Congressional District, one of the most competitive races in the country. Min’s fundraising dominance was particularly notable given that he is not taking corporate PAC money, and that he raised over $1.8 million from individual donors, with more than 17,000 unique donors—**including more than 14,000 new donors** —pitching in. This was nearly three times the amount that Baugh raised from individual contributions.

As we head into the final three weeks of the campaign, Min’s momentum continues to grow and Baugh’s campaign continues to sputter as voters become more aware of his record of extremism and corruption.

**“With 14,000 new donors and a $2 million quarter, Dave Min continues to gain strength and support as voters really get to know both candidates. The more people get to know Scott Baugh, the worse he does. Meanwhile, Min continues to crush Baugh in fundraising and on the ground, ” said Dan Driscoll, Campaign Manager at Dave Min for Congress. “While Scott Baugh and his MAGA allies will continue to try and prop up Baugh’s fledgling campaign, grassroots supporters–including 14,000 new donors–will propel the Min campaign to victory.” ** ###

_California’s 47th is an open_[ _DCCC Red To Blue_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=3f947a5a1f&e=7017cc100e) _Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44%. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

# We Can’t Let Bigotry & Hate Win!

As a proud Muslim American, I cherish the religious freedom that is a founding principle of our nation. America has allowed me to live a life of opportunity and service to others, alongside countless millions—Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Jews, Hindus, and others—who have sought refuge here, fleeing persecution and discrimination. I often quote my good friend, **California Governor Gavin Newsom** : "_**We don’t tolerate diversity; we celebrate it, because it is the backbone of democracy and what makes America so great."**_ This celebration of diversity is what sets us apart, and it's why we must reject leaders who promote hate and division.
The election is just three weeks away, and polls show an incredibly close race that could come down to a few thousand votes in a handful of states. Every vote matters. Now, more than ever, we must do whatever we can to reach out to our family, friends, neighbors, and colleagues to make sure they are informed about Donald Trump’s racist views and destructive policies. We need to ensure they’re ready to vote for Kamala Harris and Democrats on November 5th, to protect the values that make our country strong.
If you're able to give, please click the link below to help the campaign finish strong and prevent another four years of Trump in the White House.Please share this video with your network and help spread the truth. Together, we can make a difference.
Sincerely,
Asif

Good morning,
Peter. [ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-oct24.yPYsfQ&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_MMG_AC_20241016_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=4139%2E35263%2EuKDEiN ]In a moment, I’ll ask
you to chip in before tonight’s final FEC public fundraising deadline
before Election Day. But first, I want to explain why your support is so
important.

I’ll be honest,
Peter, I’m concerned. Every bit
of news coming out of our Senate race has been about my opponent picking
up momentum.

First it was the polling — consecutive polls have indicated this race is
statistically tied, and a recent memo leaked by Senate Republicans
revealed that Eric Hovde has taken a one-point lead.

Then it was the race rating shifts. Two election experts recently
downgraded Wisconsin’s Senate race from “Leans Democrat” to “Toss Up.”

And now, it’s the ongoing flood of Republican spending. $71 million has
already been spent against me by Eric Hovde and his GOP allies, and Mitch
McConnell’s super PAC just greenlit a $24 million ad buy to finish the
job.

We’re sounding the alarm bells about this race because we’re running out
of time to reverse these concerning trends.

Turning the tides starts tonight. When we submit our last fundraising
report to the FEC after tonight’s deadline, we have an opportunity to show
that our grassroots campaign to keep this seat blue is thriving and up for
the challenge — anything less will invite even more Republican spending
and attack ads.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-oct24.yPYsfQ&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_MMG_AC_20241016_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=4139%2E35263%2EuKDEiN ]Peter,
will you help us reach our goal before tonight’s midnight deadline? We
need everyone off the sideline in order to defend this seat from my
right-wing opponent.

Friend, _“What was a calm and respectful protest was quickly escalated by police officers dressed in riot gear. They surrounded us at a moment when we were supporting students who were conducting prayer,”_ explained Ohio State Rep. Munira Abdullahi, who went to support students protesting genocide this past spring. Speaking out against the police violence she experienced, Munira wrote: _“_** _I was grabbed by my headscarf._**_I was pushed toward the ground onto students. Ultimately, I sustained painful bruising around my ribs and midsection.”_ The first Muslim woman and first Somali American to serve in Ohio’s State Legislature, Munira is also the youngest serving member of the Legislature where she isn’t backing down in the face of Republican control. She’s fighting for our fundamental rights, including the right to free speech and the right to reproductive care. Munira is also pushing for the rights of hijab-wearers who are experiencing increased harassment due to Islamophobic and anti-Arab hate—like the 7-year-old Yemeni child who experienced a horrific attack in my district last week. **Too many lawmakers have spread racism and dehumanization this past year. We need more representatives in public office, like Ohio State Rep. Munira Abdullahi, who see the humanity of all of their constituents.** State Rep. Abdullahi is committed to saving lives at home and abroad.**** As a type-1 diabetic, she is deeply passionate about ensuring healthcare and medications are affordable so others don’t have to endure the same struggles she faced with overwhelming medical bills. In her first term in office, she introduced legislation to cap the price of insulin, as well as policies for gun safety, workers’ rights, and affordable housing. Unlike so many lawmakers who are putting our tax dollars toward war, Munira is investing in life. [**Will you chip into Ohio State Rep. Munira Abdullahi’s re-election campaign so she can keep advocating for the rights and dignity we all deserve? Friend,
This spring, State Rep. Munira Abdullahi was supporting Ohio State University students protesting genocide when police officers grabbed her hijab (headscarf) and pushed her to the ground, arresting peaceful students nearby.
She condemned the police violence and the violations of our rights, explaining: _“The freedom of speech and the right to peacefully assemble are the basic fundamental freedoms guaranteed to us in the 1st amendment.”_
**The first Muslim woman and first Somali American to serve in Ohio’s State Legislature, Munira is standing up for our rights and pushing back against rising bigotry** —including the targeting of women and girls who wear hijabs. Last week in my city of Detroit, a 7 year-old Yemeni girl who wears a hijab experienced a horrific attack when a man slit her throat. She is alive but traumatized, and so many of our neighbors are living in fear because lawmakers and media outlets keep spreading racist, Islamophobic hate.
**In this time of increasing dehumanization, we need more people in public office who respect the shared humanity of all of their constituents, and who champion policies to save lives at home and abroad.**
Ohio State Rep. Munira Abdullahi understands that we all deserve safety and human dignity. **A Type-1 diabetic who’s experienced overwhelming medical costs, Munira has introduced legislation to cap the price of insulin** —as well as gun safety policies and bills to protect workers’ rights. She helped secure wins like $30 million for affordable housing, despite serving in a Republican-controlled state government. This is what valuing life looks like.

body:
https://www.jazzlewis.com/ [https://www.jazzlewis.com/]
Friend- We’re just a week from my Reception at Copper Canyon-Glenarden in Lanham on Tuesday, October 22nd from 6:00-8:00 PM [http://bit.ly/JazzOct22] and 3 weeks from one of the most important elections in my lifetime. Between preparing for session and getting out the vote for Angela Alsobrooks in her Senate race (click HERE [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSduhPktmsU2E8gS5m-tBTTpuO_bLOqCV4wfRdi6mfY5fAaCgA/viewform] for a lawn sign), it’s been a busy Fall.
If you’d like to join me at Copper Canyon or would support my campaign with a contribution, you can purchase tickets here [http://bit.ly/JazzOct22] . If you prefer you can can send a check to: Friends of Jazz Lewis, c/o Rice Consulting, 17 W. Courtland Street, Suite 210,Bel Air, MD 21014. Walk-ups and payment at the door are always welcome!
Your support has helped me make progress on issues important to Prince George’s County residents: meaningful criminal justice reform focusing on rehabilitation, growing the innovation economy while providing small business support, and taking essential steps toward healthcare equity.
If you need more information, please contact Meaghan Elsner at 410-838-6355 or meaghanelsner@riceconsultingllc.com [meaghanelsner@riceconsultingllc.com] .
I hope to see you at Copper Canyon!
Jazz

body:
Nate Silver said that we have a 93% chance at holding onto the White House if we defeat Donald Trump in Arizona.
#

Peter -
Here’s Trump at one of his rallies In Arizona, pointing directly at our opponent, Kari Lake:
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241016-2-160&t=1&akid=3370%2E734936%2Eim-l3E)
And here’s Kari Lake, looking right back at him.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241016-2-160&t=2&akid=3370%2E734936%2Eim-l3E)
At that rally, Trump said: “We’re going to work together and we’re going to make sure we win this state... **Presidentially, if we win this state... we win the presidency,** and we have to take Kari Lake with us.”
The pollsters are starting to realize this, too. Just this week, **Nate Silver said that we have a 93% chance at holding onto the White House if we defeat Donald Trump in Arizona.** That’s why Trump’s coming here so often, and that’s why he’s attacking Ruben Gallego every time he comes.
Trump knows that if Ruben can pull more swing voters to our side, it’s all the more likely that we can turn those voters against him. That makes Arizona not only our best chance at holding the line in the U.S. Senate, but at keeping Donald Trump out of the White House, too.
So, here’s the deal: Ruben’s final, pre-general election FEC deadline of the election hits at midnight tonight. We have to do everything we can to hit our goals by then. That’s how we’ll raise the resources we need to defeat both Lake and Trump.
Are you with us?

And this one really pains me to say... even irreplaceable gifts I gave to my only son. This is nothing but a humiliation ritual designed to send a message to any and all who dare to challenge the corrupt ruling class. But let’s not forget that America itself was founded by PATRIOTS who had the moral courage to challenge the ruling class and form a nation enshrined in liberty, truth, and justice. That’s why, when I look at my Inmate Number of P01135780 , to me, the “P” does not stand for “prisoner.” Rather, it stands for “PATRIOT.” Rudy Giuliani / “Inmate No P01135780 ” Now, Friend – from one patriot to another – I’m humbly asking you to help me reach my goal for myLegal Defense Trust so that I can keep fighting for my freedom – and the freedom of all patriots. subject: We Might Lose Texas
body:
| | | | [](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gxZ/?__vbtrk=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Friend --

Senator Ted Cruz here.
Desperate times call for desperate measures, and I'm afraid **we're in some desperate times.**
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gxZ/?__vbtrk=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_Texas is in danger of flipping blue for the first time in generations!_

We are in danger of losing the great state of Texas...

_**If that happens, even if President Trump wins the election, he won't be able to push his agenda through Congress...**_
_****_
_**And if we lose Texas as a Republican stronghold, regardless of who wins in 2024, we might never had another Republican President again...**_

| | [KEEP TEXAS RED](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gxZ/?__vbtrk=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Today, I am reaching out to you, about an _**extremely important issue...**_****

Not on my own behalf, but on behalf of a good friend of mine,**Brandon Gill** , who is running for Congress to represent __**YOU**__ _****_****in D.C., and help**me** in stopping the Left from taking control of the Lone Star State.

Brandon Gill is a proud husband, a proud father, a long-time **supporter** and **fighter** for President Trump, and a _**warrior**_****for our Conservative causes!

[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gxZ/?__vbtrk=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_My friend, Brandon Gill, and his wife._
Brandon Gill has **my personal endorsement**... He has **President Trump's personal endorsement**...
_**[And now, I'm asking for YOU to join me and join President Trump in supporting Brandon Gill's fight to KEEP TEXAS RED, and HELP SAVE AMERICA](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gxZ/?__vbtrk=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**_**[!!](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gy0/?__vbtrk=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**

I've been in Congress for a while now-- I know what it means to fight against the left, to face their relentless attacks, **and _I know what it takes to win..._**
I can tell you, _without a shadow of a doubt_ , _**Brandon Gill is a killer who will take the fight to them, and _never back down_.**_
Listen-- Politicians come and go, and believe me, I know how it feels to be disappointed by people who campaign on _one thing_ , and then once they get to D.C., _they do another_...
_**But there is not a doubt in my mind about Brandon Gill...**_
_**HE WILL NOT LET YOU DOWN!**_
[JOIN TED CRUZ & PRESIDENT TRUMP IN SUPPORTING BRANDON GILL](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gxZ/?__vbtrk=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Believe me, _**keeping Texas red might be one of the most consequential fights the Republican Party will face for decades to come.**_
_**We can't afford to let a Democrat take TX-26:
WE NEED BRANDON GILL!**_

There is so much to do...
**We must secure our Southern Border!**
Brandon Gill and I have talked about how we've seen Texas transform as its become infested with illegals, and _**he is ready to fight for deportation!**_
**We must defend the 1st Amendment!**
Brandon Gill is ready to join me in Congress and take the fight to the _bureaucrats_ , and _tyrants_ who think they can _**curtail your God-given rights!**_
**We must protect women's bathrooms, locker rooms, and sports!**
Brandon Gill is a proud husband and father to a beautiful daughter, and I know _**he won't put up with men invading women's spaces!**_
**We must secure our elections, and DEMAND Voter ID nationwide!**
Brandon Gill knows how important this issue is, and I know _**he will never back down on keeping illegals OFF our voter rolls, and OUT of our voting booths.**_
**We need the largest deportation force in the history of the world!**
I know Brandon Gill is especially passionate about this issue... _**And I can't wait to see him fight alongside me and President Trump _to get it done_.**_
[JOIN TED CRUZ & PRESIDENT TRUMP IN SUPPORTING BRANDON GILL](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gxZ/?__vbtrk=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
If these are **ideas you can get behind...**
If you think Congress needs a family man, a member of the younger generation, who will _**bring the fight to Capitol Hill...**_
If you know _(like I do)_ that _**keeping Texas red**_ is one of the most important fights of this election...
**_[Then join the fight, and help me get Brandon Gill to Congress to help me fight, to support President Trump,a nd to stop the violent and radical left!](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gxZ/?__vbtrk=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_**
When President Trump and I come together to endorse a candidate, I know you know-- _**That's a candidate that's going to go far!**_
If we don't get Brandon Gill across the finishing line, _**Texas will be in a _very, very bad position and 2024 and beyond..._**_
_**_[It's all hands on deck... We need YOU NOW! ARE YOU WITH ME?](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gxZ/?__vbtrk=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_**_

[JOIN TED CRUZ & PRESIDENT TRUMP IN SUPPORTING BRANDON GILL](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gxZ/?__vbtrk=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
I wouldn't be asking if it wasn't serious... But when President Trump and I both rally behind a candidate, you can bet _**that's a candidate that deserves your support!**_
_****_
_****_**__**_Yours Sincerely,_
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gxZ/?__vbtrk=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MDUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)

They want me to lose all my property, all my belongings, even all of the personal mementos and nostalgic keepsakes that I’ve collected throughout my 80 years of life. And this one really pains me to say... even irreplaceable gifts I gave to my only son. This is nothing but a humiliation ritual designed to send a message to any and all who dare to challenge the corrupt ruling class. But let’s not forget that America itself was founded by PATRIOTS who had the moral courage to challenge the ruling class and form a nation enshrined in liberty, truth, and justice. That’s why, when I look at my Inmate Number of P01135780 , to me, the “P” does not stand for “prisoner.” Rather, it stands for “PATRIOT.” Rudy Giuliani / “Inmate No P01135780 ” Now, Friend – from one patriot to another – I’m humbly asking you to help me reach my goal for myLegal Defense Trust so that I can keep fighting for my freedom – and the freedom of all patriots. Folks,
We are less than three weeks away from Election Day (just 20 days!), which means that not only does every day matter, but every single hour within each day matters — a lot.
I know it can feel like these election cycles are never-ending. You start hearing about elections more than a year before they even happen, and you get asked for support every day in between. So you’d be forgiven for tuning it all out until it’s crunch time!
Well, crunch time has arrived — so we need everyone paying close attention.
Just last week, Donald Trump doubled down on his promise to make a play for Virginia this year, and JD Vance called Virginia “winnable.” On top of that, my opponent just reported massive fundraising numbers that we know he’s going to put directly into attack ads.
If you’ve been waiting for the right time to get involved and make a donation, that time is right now. Our final FEC filing deadline of this entire election cycle is tonight at midnight, so this is our last big opportunity to show the strength of our grassroots Democratic movement in Virginia.
Will you make a donation of whatever you can to my campaign before the midnight deadline? Our average donation so far this month is $29. Some folks give more, and plenty of folks give less — but whatever amount you can give will have an impact.
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

clean_body: We need to build the preparations now before the Fifth Circuit’s ruling. | | | Peter, The Fifth Circuit Court held its hearing on the future of DACA almost one week ago — and a decision can come down any day now. Every day that passes is another day that DACA recipients live in limbo, unable to plan for the future. Our team will have little warning when the decision comes out. We’ll have to be ready to spring into action at a moment’s notice. | | We don’t know what the decision will be, but we do know that the Fifth Circuit has ruled against DACA in the past. That’s why we’re preparing for all possible scenarios, and even a potential appeal to the Supreme Court. To prepare for the DACA fights ahead, I’ll be honest with you — we will need more grassroots support on our side. We need to be prepared for the aftermath of the Court’s decision and quickly ramp up our advocacy efforts to secure permanent protections before it’s too late. To do all this, and do it well, we need resources. We need YOUR support, Peter. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. Ryan sees the same thing happening to Montana: wealthy extremist Greg Gianforte bought his seat with his own millions, and now he’s raising our taxes in order to give tax breaks to corporations, making Montana unaffordable, defunding our public schools, locking up our public lands, hijacking our freedoms, and rigging the system for the rich.

Ryan chose Raph Graybill as his running mate because no Montanan has done more to protect constitutional rights and freedoms from Greg Gianforte. Since Gianforte became governor, Raph has blocked more than a dozen different unconstitutional laws that invaded Montanans’ constitutional rights.

**Ryan and Raph are running as champions for ALL Montanans and to Get Our Montana Back!**

Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=101624_2&amount=25]
Team,
Some days the reasons we fight for voting rights and our democracy are self-evident and directly in front of us in the news. Other days we are reminded why we work so hard by a kind word or a shared moment. It's in that spirit that we share this quote from Martin Sheen:
"We are rightly challenged to find something in our lives worth fighting for. Something deeply personal and uncompromising. Something that can unite the will of the spirit with the work of the flesh. And when we find that we will discover fire for the second time. And then we will be able to help lift up this nation and all its people to that place where the heart is without fear and the head is held high.
Where knowledge is free, where the world has not been broken up into fragments by narrow, domestic walls. Where words come out from the depths of truth and tireless, striving, stretch our arms towards perfection. Where the clear stream of reason has not lost its way into the dreary desert sands of dead habit. Where the mind is led forward by thee into ever-widening thought and action.
Into that heaven of freedom, dear father, let our country awake."
Mr. Sheen was channeling President Bartlet, speaking at an event honoring the TV show The West Wing , but that shouldn't take anything away from his words. All our work to defend voting rights, to register new or lapsed voters, all the work to turn out voters in this crucial elections -- it's all because we've found this work defending democracy something deeply personal and uncompromising.
Team: You're standing with us because you agree. Please, we know we ask a lot, but if you can, chip in $25 or whatever you can to protect the right to vote and support our work to register and turn out voters across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=101624_2&amount=25]

Our democracy is worth fighting for. Our right to vote is sacred, fundamental, and the reason our country exists. The promise of America is the promise that we all matter, we all count, and all our voices are heard.
Help us make that promise a reality . The billionaires, the Super PACs, the lobbyists, the monied interests, none of them are making this work happen. You are, one donation at a time.

name: Sarah McBride
subject: No matter what happens tonight
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
This is the future I’m fighting for.
#
I'll make this quick:
I just ducked out of debate prep ahead of tonight’s televised debate to give you a preview of what’s to come.
My opponent? Not entirely sure if he’ll show up. If he does? He’ll likely take time to promote conspiracy theories, right-wing talking points, and endorse Project 2025 (again).
But whether my opponent is there or not, I’m excited to take the stage to talk about the issues we face in Delaware and around the country — and why I’m the right candidate to get big things done in Congress and keep us moving forward.
**This is a big night, with plenty at stake, so I’m hoping I can ask you this, personally:[Will you chip in $5 or more right now to have my back ahead of tonight’s debate?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241016-1?refcode=em20241016-1402&amount=5&refcode2=1402_21716_50r0-p&akid=1402%2E21716%2E50r0-p)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241016-1?amount=5&refcode=em20241016-1402&refcode2=1402_21716_50r0-p&akid=1402%2E21716%2E50r0-p)**
I’ve traveled up and down Delaware since launching my campaign more than a year ago, listening to neighbors stories and needs. None of those needs include the divisive, violent agenda put forth by the MAGA right.
Our friends and neighbors want stable, hopeful leadership that addresses their real needs: putting affordable and nutritious food on the table, the safety of our kids and their futures, strengthening our public schools, and more of the issues that bring us together — not the rhetoric that looks to tear us apart.
**That’s the kind of leadership I’ll lay out in tonight’s debate, and I hope that’s the kind of leadership you’ll invest in right now:[Donate $5 or more to fund the final days of the fight ahead.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241016-1?refcode=em20241016-1402&amount=5&refcode2=1402_21716_50r0-p&akid=1402%2E21716%2E50r0-p)**
Thanks,
Sarah

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: Here are updated polls in the most pivotal states
body:
NDLB is doing extensive research on the country's most important races at every level of government. Here are some of the most important races to keep an eye on.
| | | | | |
---
# **Here is an update on the 2024 election!**
---
|
---
As the 2024 election approaches, key battleground states are once again at the forefront of deciding the future of our nation. From the Midwest to the Sun Belt, these states hold the power to shape the outcome of not only the presidential race but also control of the U.S. Senate. Pennsylvania, Arizona, Michigan, Georgia, and Wisconsin will play pivotal roles, with narrow polling margins showing just how critical every vote will be. Here is your breakdown from our research team:
**_Pennsylvania_** Once a reliable Democratic stronghold, Pennsylvania took a surprising turn in 2016 by supporting Donald Trump, only to swing back in 2020 with a narrow 2.2% margin for Biden. Polls today suggest a similarly close race, with Kamala Harris holding less than a 1-point lead over Trump. Pennsylvania’s importance cannot be overstated, with its 19 electoral votes making it the largest battleground state. Nate Silver highlights its significance: "No Democrat has won the White House without Pennsylvania since 1948." The Senate race mirrors this tight contest, as Democrat Bob Casey maintains a lead over David McCormick, setting the stage for a fierce fight in both the presidential and Senate races.
**_Arizona_** Arizona’s recent political transformation from a deep-red state to a battleground is a story of shifting demographics and voter sentiment. In 2020, Joe Biden won by a razor-thin margin of 0.3%, marking the first time a Democrat won Arizona since Bill Clinton in 1996. Polls show Trump holding a slight edge in 2024, a significant change from the typical 8-10% Republican leads of past elections. Meanwhile, the Senate race sees Democrat Ruben Gallego maintaining a strong lead over Republican Kari Lake, with his margin growing in recent weeks. Arizona’s evolving political landscape makes it a state to watch.
**_Michigan_** Michigan is part of the famed "blue wall" alongside Pennsylvania and Wisconsin, states that historically support Democrats but surprised the nation when Trump won in 2016 by just 0.2%. Biden reclaimed it in 2020, winning by 2.8%, and Harris now holds a narrow lead in current polls. The Senate race features Democratic candidate Elissa Slotkin leading Republican Tom Rodgers by 4.8%, positioning Michigan as a critical state for both the presidency and the Senate in 2024.
**_Georgia_** Georgia’s political identity has transformed in recent years. Traditionally a Republican stronghold, Biden flipped the state in 2020 with a margin of just 0.2%, a monumental win for Democrats. In 2024, the race is once again razor-thin, with Trump holding a slight 1-point lead over Harris. Georgia’s diverse electorate and shifting political landscape will require Democrats to reenergize the coalition that led to their historic 2020 victory.
**_Wisconsin_** Wisconsin’s political history tells a tale of unpredictability. It consistently backed Democrats from 1988 to 2012, but Trump flipped the state in 2016 by 1%, only for Biden to win it back in 2020 by 0.7%. The current polling indicates another close contest, with Harris hoping to maintain the Democratic streak. In the Senate race, Democrat Tammy Baldwin holds a 5% lead over Republican Eric Hovde, positioning Wisconsin as a key battleground for both races.
**_Iowa_** Once a competitive "purple" state, Iowa has trended Republican in recent elections. Trump won by 8 points in 2020, and recent polls show him leading Harris by 5-6%. Despite its lean, Iowa remains a critical battleground due to its importance in shaping national trends. Trump dominates rural areas, while Harris performs well in urban centers like Des Moines. The Senate race leans Republican, with incumbent Senator Chuck Grassley firmly in place, though the down-ballot races remain competitive as Democrats look to regain ground in a shifting state.
**_Nevada_** As a perennial swing state, Nevada is crucial to the 2024 election. While no Republican has won Nevada since 2004, current polls show Harris with a narrow lead over Trump, mirroring past close races. Nevada’s importance lies in its diverse electorate and its urban centers, where Democrats typically perform well, counterbalanced by Trump’s strong support in rural areas. In the Senate race, Democratic Senator Jacky Rosen holds a comfortable lead over Republican Sam Brown, further solidifying Nevada as a key state for Democrats.
**_North Carolina_** North Carolina’s tight race between Harris and Trump highlights its importance as a battleground state. Polls show Trump with a slim lead, but Harris is performing well with key demographics, particularly women and Black voters. The state remains competitive, with both candidates targeting independent voters, who slightly lean toward Trump. In the Senate race, incumbent Republican Ted Budd maintains a strong position, emphasizing the state’s Republican trend in recent years, but Democrats are hopeful for down-ballot success.
**_Montana_** Montana is solidly in Trump’s column for 2024, with polls showing him leading Harris by double digits. This aligns with the state’s history of supporting Republican candidates. The Senate race, however, is drawing national attention. Democratic incumbent Jon Tester faces a tough challenge from Republican Tim Sheehy, who currently leads by 6-7 points. Montana’s Senate race is pivotal for control of the U.S. Senate, with Tester needing to outperform the top of the ticket in a state strongly backing Trump.

Hi Peter, it’s
Scott, Tammy Baldwin’s Campaign Manager. We made a risky decision, and I
thought you should hear about it from me.

Our right-wing opponent has been surging in the polls, to the point where
he’s now taken the lead in this race for the very first time. Pundits have
downgraded our race to a “Toss Up,” and even The Hill published that “the
closest Senate race is in Wisconsin.”

The $71 million that Republicans have spent on ads in Wisconsin is what
has made this race close. So when I learned Mitch McConnell’s super PAC
launched a last-minute $24 million ad blitz to flip this seat red, I
sounded the alarm.

Hovde and his allies left us no choice but to fight back. We couldn’t let
them outspend us through Election Day. So after a lot of discussion with
Tammy and the rest of the team, we decided to put even more money behind
our campaign ads to counter these brutal attacks and set the record
straight as voters across Wisconsin start to cast their ballots.

This was a tough call because there’s one problem: we didn’t have the
funds in our October budget.

I know that this is a big risk,
Peter. But we’re not going to win
this race by playing it safe — not as Republicans continue to pummel us
with attack ads against Tammy.

I've been on Facebook since ~2006 and have amassed a following of more than 130,000 people. From 2006-2024 I received zero content warnings. And now, I've received three such warnings in just the last four months--and all without explanation--indicating Meta knows its censorship justifications lack factual basis. My alleged violations? Posting content critical of Republicans or related to Israel and Palestine--which they claim is against their anti-hate conduct.
This censorship, particularly when it targets content condemning genocide or promoting human rights, is devastating to global justice efforts, and it cannot be ignored. **Let 's Address This.**

### Censored for Demanding Justice on Israel and Palestine
You aren't imagining the censorship. It is well documented. Just this week AccountableTech published a detailed report on [Meta's censorship of political content](https://substack.com/redirect/620d4b0e-6671-4467-b996-966992163d29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Last December, [Human Rights Watch](https://substack.com/redirect/ff133ccc-977c-4b21-8f43-5709b93c4129?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) criticized Meta for biased censorship when it comes to content addressing Palestinian rights. And way back in 2017, a detailed analysis by ProPublica of Facebook's censorship rules [found that](https://substack.com/redirect/a33b1e3a-3dac-45d8-92da-d5a63af07f4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The company's hate-speech rules tend to favor elites and governments over grassroots activists and racial minorities. In so doing, they serve the business interests of the global company, which relies on national governments not to block its service to their citizens.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/45cf4719-d93d-4e23-a320-3a28b2a118e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The first article of mine that Meta removed was my viral piece titled "[Debunking Four Myths About Israel's Siege on Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/c801d6b0-5c99-4994-bfeb-a3f9584b3054?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." This article had garnered significant attention, with over 50,000 readers. In it, I debunked four propaganda claims often used to justify what the UN describes as the "extermination" of Palestinians in Gaza.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fe49812a-262f-4872-86b2-2d222e65af57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Despite the factual foundation of this article, Meta flagged it as a violation, claiming it violated rules against praising terrorist attacks or supporting violence. Yet, nothing in my piece came remotely close to doing either. _I even explicitly condemn the attacks by Hamas_. So, why was this content removed, and to this day without explanation? Perhaps because I dare criticize the Israeli government? If so, a reminder that people have rights, governments do not have rights--and we need to be free to criticize all governments and condemn unjust actions of governments without censorship.

### Meta's History of Censorship: Stifling Voices for Justice
Just as Meta stifled my article on Israel and Palestine, they have also censored my anti-racist content. Recently, [they began removing my posts addressing white supremacy and systemic racism](https://substack.com/redirect/62c5de7f-bb11-4309-86a9-d7a49b661797?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--again without explanation. And just this week Meta removed a Facebook post I made _eight years ago_ that condemned Newt Gingrich's fascist hate against Muslims. When I reposted the post on Threads, it was _again_ removed. This is the post both Facebook and Threads removed:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5d140d38-e5cc-47a5-b494-0430edd458f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If you recall the political landscape in 2016, it was not much different than today in its embrace of anti-Muslim hate. Donald Trump aggressively pushed his Muslim Ban, and the Republican Party fell in line like lemmings. I posted a viral tweet in response to former GOP House Speaker Gingrich's bigotry to illustrate the fascist nature of his plan. My tweet received overwhelming support from Jews, Muslims, and Christians alike, and from people of all faiths and no faith.
The reason is obvious -- we cannot discriminate against people based on their faith. Apparently, Meta deems condemnations of that fascism as a violation of their rules. It's clear that Meta's system is built to silence voices calling out oppression, whether it's against Palestinians or marginalized racial communities in the United States.

### The Path Forward: Why Your Support Matters
When powerful platforms like Meta restrict content that sheds light on genocide, racism, or human rights violations, they don't just hurt individual creators--they harm movements for justice globally. In doing so, Meta is complicit in silencing critical voices that challenge those committing atrocities. This is one major reason I founded _Let 's Address This_--as a platform designed to bypass the censorship of big tech corps like Meta and ensure that human rights advocacy remains visible and strong.
