name: Carmen Goers
subject: We are just weeks away from the general election
body:
| | | | | | | |
---
| | | |
---
| | | **We are just weeks away from the general election****!**
---

Dear Peter,

---
| | | In a matter of weeks the general election will be here and there is no slowing down. Team Goers has been on the move the last couple of weeks! Carmen has attended a few events including the **Salmon Days Parade** and **Candidate Meet and Greet** out in Enumclaw!

Thank you to all that attended our final parade!

---
| |
---
| | | As we are coming to the final weeks of the campaign. We wanted to share with you a few opportunities for you to come out and support Team Goers, along with a few other events that we want to share with you!

**_Doorbelling Opportunities_** :

We would love to have you join us this next week out knocking on doors!

**What to Expect** : We’ll provide you with all the materials you need and a brief training session to ensure you feel confident and prepared. Just make sure to bring your phone and some water!
**Why**** It**** Matters**:
1. **Personal Connection** : Door-to-door outreach allows us to engage directly with community members, answer their questions, and build personal connections.
2. **Raise Awareness** : It’s a chance to spread the word about Carmen and educate others about how they can get involved.
3. **Make an Impact** : Your efforts can lead to increased support and involvement, helping us all to win in November!

This next week we will be at:
**_
_****_Friday, Oct. 18 in Wenatchee!_**
* Meeting at Walla Walla Point Park
* 1351 Walla Walla Ave, Wenatchee, WA 98801
* 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM
* Email [Goerscampaign@gmail.com](mailto:Goerscampaign@gmail.com) for more information

**_Super Sat_**** _urday Oct. 19 Part 1 in Wenatchee!_**
* Meeting at Lewis and Clark Park
* 9:00 AM - 11:00 AM
* Email [goerscampaign@gmail.com](mailto:goerscampaign@gmail.com) for more information

**_Super Saturday Oct. 19 Part 2 in Ellensburg _**
* Meeting at Memorial Park
* 700 N Poplar St Ellensburg, WA 98926
* 1:00 PM - 3:00 PM
* Email [goerscampaign@gmail.com](mailto:goerscampaign@gmail.com) for more information

**_Monday, Oct. 21 in Auburn!_**
* Meet at Game Farm Park
* 3030 R St SE Auburn, WA 98002
* 12:00 PM - 2:00 PM
* Email [goerscampaign@gmail.com](mailto:goerscampaign@gmail.com) for more information

**_Wednesday, Oct. 23 in Enumclaw! _**
* Meet at the Enumclaw Library
* 1700 1st St Enumclaw, WA 98022
* 3:00 PM - 5:00 PM
* Email [goerscampaign@gmail.com](mailto:goerscampaign@gmail.com) for more information **_**_
_**_**

**_Our only chance to talk to Kim Schrier one-on-one: _**

On Monday, Oct. 21st Carmen and Kim Schrier will participate in a Zoom Candidate Forum put on by the Snohomish County League of Woman Voters. Kim Schrier has refused to debate Carmen in person so this is our only opportunity for the two candidates to discuss the issues. To view the Forum please go [here](https://vgq.soundestlink.com/ce/c/652845d9aa222127cf458b43/67100cb4c362da86decfa4c4/67100ccd3a48785046180b39?signature=5208d97fb05b04651801d91c02e62a913992292df88901ecb414e23486ad43ee) or follow [our Facebook page](https://vgq.soundestlink.com/ce/c/652845d9aa222127cf458b43/67100cb4c362da86decfa4c4/67100ccd3a48785046180b3a?signature=5208d97fb05b04651801d91c02e62a913992292df88901ecb414e23486ad43ee) as we will be streaming it there as well.

---
| | | |
---
|
**_We got signs!_**

Want your very own Carmen Goers for Congress sign? Well we’ve got them! Email us today and we will get a sign delivered right to your door!

We can’t do this without your support. Carmen is knocking on doors and talking to voters as we are fast approaching the end of the election. Please consider donating or volunteering to help get her message out there.

---
| [ DONATE TODAY ! ](https://vgq.soundestlink.com/ce/c/652845d9aa222127cf458b43/67100cb4c362da86decfa4c4/67100ccd3a48785046180b3b?signature=5208d97fb05b04651801d91c02e62a913992292df88901ecb414e23486ad43ee)

| | |
Thank you,
Team Goers

| Dear Friend,
In October of 1964, Ronald Reagan delivered what is now known as ‘The Speech’.
The Speech marked a monumental change not only in Reagan’s political life, wherein he distanced himself once-and-for-all from the Democratic Party, but also for the future direction of the Republican Party. In that speech, Reagan stated that the people of the United States had a rendezvous with destiny, a destiny guided by the small government principles of the Republican Party to make the world a better place for all. Voting in Montana is now underway. When you receive your ballot, I encourage you to both remember Reagan’s plea for all of us to determine this country’s destiny and to cast your vote so that those, which Reagan referred to as the honored American dead, who gave their lives to stop the advance of darkness in this world in the 20th century did not die in vain.
---
[CLICK HERE TO DONATE TODAY! ](https://gmail.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e42c6bb78e8b53de5ee6ec610&id=33b02ddac4&e=80cd3574a3)
| As a young man growing up in the 1980s, I became a Republican because I identified with Reagan’s belief that “if we make up our mind what we are going to make of our lives, then work hard toward that goal, we never lose. Somehow we win out." It is now the time for choosing in the Treasure State. I encourage your choice to be for those candidates, like me, who believe in advancing and protecting the Montanan Way of Life, and the freedoms that come along with it.
I would be honored to receive your vote to serve as Montana’s next State Auditor.
Sincerely,
James Brown, EsqRepublican for Auditor
P.S. If you would like to read Reagan’s ‘A time for choosing’ speech, you can find it online here: [https://www.reaganlibrary.gov/reagans/ronald-reagan/time-choosing-speech-october-27-1964](https://gmail.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e42c6bb78e8b53de5ee6ec610&id=6e5b506505&e=80cd3574a3)

clean_body: Behind the Veil, OUT NOW!| | | | | | | | SPECIAL BOOK SIGNING EVENT Wednesday, October 23, 2024 5:30 PM – 8:00 PMRadisson Hotel - St. Paul Downtown 161 St Anthony Ave, St Paul, MN 55103 (parking gate code: 876#) | | | A personal message from author Paul Gazelka The Response to my new book, Behind the Veil , has been humbling. Sure, it’s great to have people like Newt Gingrich, Vin Weber, and Tim Pawlenty compliment the book. And it’s a thrill to have it be Amazon’s #1 new release in Political Leadership. It’s even more heartening, however, to have everyday citizens thank me for writing the book. For having the courage to speak the truth. For being the job referral who says, “Don’t hire Tim Walz.” For demanding leadership that champions respect, empathy, and dedication to the common good. It is with the encouragement of these citizens that I am hosting a book signing. And I’d like you to be there. Join us for a lively Q & A session, followed by the book signing. We are meeting in the Committee Room at the Radisson Hotel St. Paul Downtown (right by the Capitol). There will be books for sale or better yet, read it now and bring your copy of the book for signing. I look forward to seeing you on the 23rd! May God bless America, Paul Gazelka P.S., I know not all of you can make it to the book signing. If you on Amazon, I’ll sign it for you, whenever we get a chance to see each other again. | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|---

the enemy from within

Here’s Republican Byron Donalds, who objected to the certification of the
2020 election and said he “personally” did not believe Joe Biden was the
“legitimate” president. He did not have the courage to oppose Trump
either.

You might not know these Republicans, but that’s the point.

You could practically pick ANY Republican elected leader out of a hat, and
you would find an election-denying MAGA Trump supporter.

Trump’s cult of personality has run the principled, constitutional
conservatives like Liz Cheney and Adam Kinzinger out of office. MAGA
sycophants are all that are left.

California congressional districts, his MAGA candidates must be stopped so

Peter,

**We’ve heard the whispers and the rumors.** Across Mississippi, folks were saying _they can’t do it_ and _we couldn’t win_. Or, _why even bother?_

**For our team, it’s simple: when people need a helping hand and someone to listen, we’re ready to act.**

That simple premise has guided our work in all 82 counties. From knocking on doors to sharing a meal with folks down in the Delta, we’re determined to make sure everyone feels seen and heard, because Mississippi deserves leadership that puts people over politics.

And, our simple premise has also attracted the attention of thousands of folks all over the country, and together, we’re building a movement that shows voters they have another option this election.

After all, this election year in Mississippi isn't just another political cycle — it’s a turning point. What’s at stake goes beyond party lines or routine elections. **It’s about defending the future of our democracy, protecting civil rights, and ensuring every Mississippian has access to the opportunities they deserve.**

But what does this really mean? Israel has already blocked US humanitarian aid to Gaza for months, meaning **US military aid to Israel is already illegal.** And this is not simply a “humanitarian crisis” that can be solved with humanitarian aid; this is genocide. **Humanity and US law both demand a weapons embargo now** , not vague statements that Israel “may” face future “implications” for continuing to commit genocide. The Biden-Harris administration’s statements cannot be taken at face value after over a year of zero accountability for the most serious crimes against humanity. Secretary of State Blinken already lied to Congress to cover up previous findings of Israel blocking US humanitarian aid, but he has not been held accountable. President Biden previously said that Israel invading Rafah would be a red line for US support, yet Biden continued his unconditional support for Israel after it invaded Rafah. **Now the 30-day timeline for the Biden-Harris administration’s vague warning of possible implications falls conspicuously after the November election** , denying voters any opportunity to hold the administration accountable for failure to deliver. To put it bluntly: the Biden-Harris administration has repeatedly lied in order to give unconditional support to Israel’s genocidal war. The administration has faced no accountability for its crimes, nor has it held Israel accountable for its crimes. Now they are transparently trying to avoid accountability from the voters while continuing their unconditional support for genocide. **We demand a weapons embargo now - anything else is just empty rhetoric from habitual liars to provide political cover for genocide.** Fool me once, shame on you; fool me twice, shame on me. We can’t let them fool people into thinking the Biden-Harris administration is planning to suddenly change course after the election when our leverage as voters is gone. subject: A tenth of Arizona’s likely voters remain undecided.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
While Kari Lake works on those billionaire donors, the vast majority of our donations are going to come from emails like this to supporters like you. Our success depends on your support.
#

Peter, it’s no secret that we’re up against our final pre-general election FEC deadline of the campaign right now. It hits at midnight tonight.
But it’s worth noting why this deadline is so incredibly important.
Tomorrow, we’ll start preparing our final public fundraising report of this campaign. We’ll need to show everyone, friend and foe alike, whether we’ve got enough in the tank to close out this campaign strong.
When that report becomes public the billionaire funders backing Kari Lake’s campaign are going to take a look.
These GOP funders are looking at roughly the same polling we are right now. They’ve no doubt seen that as many **as 10% of Arizona’s likely voters remain undecided on who they will vote for in this Senate race.** And they’re thinking the same thing we are: How do we turn those voters to our side?
If they see that we’ve put up an absolutely massive amount in this public report, they could walk away and take their buckets of cash to better prospects. We could scare them off.
But if our report is not as strong as we need it to be, they will stack millions more dollars on top of what they have already spent to turn those undecided voters against us. They could double down, and that could sink us.
Those are the stakes here. Victory or defeat. And while Kari Lake works on those billionaire donors, the vast majority of our donations are going to come from emails like this to supporters like you.
Our success depends on your support.

The 1 million Washingtonians under the ACA are counting on us
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95164704/505806654/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzU4MTgxZC1mNzhiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1Epq-izbSoYtfSITMPX0boeJcdp4xGS4AObjLn365KQ=&emci=0182d58a-438b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&emdi=7358181d-f78b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&ceid=9494239)

| | Health care is front of mind for millions of Americans — and up and down the ballot this year. **As I speak with voters, it is clear that too many people are facing rising costs, attacks on programs like the ACA and Medicare, cruel laws hindering reproductive freedom, and in general uncertainty about the future of health care in this country. ** Seeing a doctor and getting the care you need should not be political, but if there is anything we can take from the last few years of hyper-partisanship, it is that we need fierce advocates in Congress to continue expanding access to care, lowering prescription drug prices, and protecting abortion rights. [**With just under three weeks left before Election Day, can l count on you to chip in $6 and help me continue this work in Congress?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95164705/505806655/1596212816?refcode=2024-10-16-3weeks&recurring=&amount=6&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=7358181d-f78b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzU4MTgxZC1mNzhiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1Epq-izbSoYtfSITMPX0boeJcdp4xGS4AObjLn365KQ=) I firmly believe that everyone has a right to universal, affordable health care coverage — whether that is through Medicare, Medicaid, the ACA, or employer-provided insurance. And I have consistently voted and sponsored legislation to advance that goal. **I am steadfast in my support of the ACA.** In 2009, I backed the Affordable Care Act (ACA), and now, almost one million Washingtonians under the age of sixty-five receive health care through the ACA. These statistics demonstrate that Americans want access to quality, affordable health care. Last year, enrollment hit an exciting benchmark: a historic 21.3 million people opted for ACA marketplace coverage during the Open Enrollment Period. This statistic includes more than five million people — about a fourth — who are new to the ACA Marketplace and 16 million people who renewed their existing ACA coverage. In the last 15 years, we have seen the benefits of the ACA and know the importance of protecting health care for _all of us_ – whether it is lowering the cost of prescription drugs, allowing young people to stay insured through their parents until age 26, or helping under- or uninsured folks get the coverage they need to be able to seek medical care. That is why during this Congress, I voted to reduce premiums for 9 million Americans who buy insurance through the Affordable Care Act Marketplace. With enrollment reaching a record high and millions of American families relying on the ACA for coverage, it simply does not make sense that year after year the Chaos Caucus' agenda is to repeal this landmark legislation. [**Your support today will allow me to continue defending and expanding the ACA.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95164707/505806656/1596212816?refcode=2024-10-16-3weeks&recurring=&amount=6&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=7358181d-f78b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzU4MTgxZC1mNzhiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1Epq-izbSoYtfSITMPX0boeJcdp4xGS4AObjLn365KQ=) **We must work to improve Medicare for our seniors.** **As a long-time advocate for strengthening Social Security and Medicare, I worry about what the Chaos Caucus' proposals would do to the millions of Americans who rely on these programs — especially our seniors.** Social Security and Medicare have served as lifelines, providing essential coverage and financial stability to our aging population, folks with disabilities, and lower-income families for decades. These programs demonstrate our shared commitment to ensuring a dignified life for _all_ , regardless of socioeconomic status. For so many of our most vulnerable, seeing a doctor means utilizing Medicare. That is why I voted to:
* * reduce prescription drug costs by letting Medicare negotiate drug prices;
* impose a tax penalty if drug companies increase their prices faster than inflation;
* cap the price of insulin at $35 per month;
* close a longstanding coverage gap in Medicaid that locks 4 million people out nationwide;
* expand Medicare to cover hearing benefits;
* lower out-of-pocket costs for Medicare Part D beneficiaries; and
* prevent the privatization of Medicare and ensure stricter accountability for private Medicare Advantage plans.

These are common-sense solutions that benefit _everyone_. **The attacks on reproductive freedom have had grave consequences.** I am outraged by the Supreme Court's decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ and the cruel, inhumane restrictions that have been imposed in its absence _._ This backward ruling strikes a blow to our basic constitutional rights of liberty, privacy, and equality — which is why the American people overwhelmingly oppose the decision. As a member of Congress with a 100% voting record on choice, I will fight hard to codify abortion rights nationwide in federal law. Last fall, I joined a majority in the House to pass the Women's Health Protection Act, which would codify _Roe_ — but Republicans blocked the bill. When Democrats take back Congress, we will make _Roe_ the law of the land. With the ACA, Medicare, Medicaid, and reproductive freedom under attack by MAGA extremists, we must take back the House to protect vital programs and access to care. [**I am ready to continue the work, but I cannot do it alone. Would you support my reelection campaign with a donation of $6 and help Team Larsen get out the vote in the final few days?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95164708/505806657/1596212816?refcode=2024-10-16-3weeks&recurring=&amount=6&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=7358181d-f78b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzU4MTgxZC1mNzhiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1Epq-izbSoYtfSITMPX0boeJcdp4xGS4AObjLn365KQ=) Together, we can ensure access to high-quality, affordable health care that fits Northwest Washington families' budgets. clean_body: The 1 million Washingtonians under the ACA are counting on us | | | | Health care is front of mind for millions of Americans — and up and down the ballot this year. As I speak with voters, it is clear that too many people are facing rising costs, attacks on programs like the ACA and Medicare, cruel laws hindering reproductive freedom, and in general uncertainty about the future of health care in this country. Seeing a doctor and getting the care you need should not be political, but if there is anything we can take from the last few years of hyper-partisanship, it is that we need fierce advocates in Congress to continue expanding access to care, lowering prescription drug prices, and protecting abortion rights. = I firmly believe that everyone has a right to universal, affordable health care coverage — whether that is through Medicare, Medicaid, the ACA, or employer-provided insurance. And I have consistently voted and sponsored legislation to advance that goal. I am steadfast in my support of the ACA. In 2009, I backed the Affordable Care Act (ACA), and now, almost one million Washingtonians under the age of sixty-five receive health care through the ACA. These statistics demonstrate that Americans want access to quality, affordable health care. Last year, enrollment hit an exciting benchmark: a historic 21.3 million people opted for ACA marketplace coverage during the Open Enrollment Period. This statistic includes more than five million people — about a fourth — who are new to the ACA Marketplace and 16 million people who renewed their existing ACA coverage. In the last 15 years, we have seen the benefits of the ACA and know the importance of protecting health care for all of us – whether it is lowering the cost of prescription drugs, allowing young people to stay insured through their parents until age 26, or helping under- or uninsured folks get the coverage they need to be able to seek medical care. That is why during this Congress, I voted to reduce premiums for 9 million Americans who buy insurance through the Affordable Care Act Marketplace. With enrollment reaching a record high and millions of American families relying on the ACA for coverage, it simply does not make sense that year after year the Chaos Caucus' agenda is to repeal this landmark legislation. = We must work to improve Medicare for our seniors. As a long-time advocate for strengthening Social Security and Medicare, I worry about what the Chaos Caucus' proposals would do to the millions of Americans who rely on these programs — especially our seniors. Social Security and Medicare have served as lifelines, providing essential coverage and financial stability to our aging population, folks with disabilities, and lower-income families for decades. These programs demonstrate our shared commitment to ensuring a dignified life for all , regardless of socioeconomic status. For so many of our most vulnerable, seeing a doctor means utilizing Medicare. That is why I voted to: reduce prescription drug costs by letting Medicare negotiate drug prices; impose a tax penalty if drug companies increase their prices faster than inflation; cap the price of insulin at $35 per month; close a longstanding coverage gap in Medicaid that locks 4 million people out nationwide; expand Medicare to cover hearing benefits; lower out-of-pocket costs for Medicare Part D beneficiaries; and prevent the privatization of Medicare and ensure stricter accountability for private Medicare Advantage plans. These are common-sense solutions that benefit everyone. The attacks on reproductive freedom have had grave consequences. I am outraged by the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade and the cruel, inhumane restrictions that have been imposed in its absence . This backward ruling strikes a blow to our basic constitutional rights of liberty, privacy, and equality — which is why the American people overwhelmingly oppose the decision. As a member of Congress with a 100% voting record on choice, I will fight hard to codify abortion rights nationwide in federal law. Last fall, I joined a majority in the House to pass the Women's Health Protection Act, which would codify Roe — but Republicans blocked the bill. When Democrats take back Congress, we will make Roe the law of the land. With the ACA, Medicare, Medicaid, and reproductive freedom under attack by MAGA extremists, we must take back the House to protect vital programs and access to care. = Together, we can ensure access to high-quality, affordable health care that fits Northwest Washington families' budgets. This is a disgusting attack, and I urge New Jersey Republican leaders to condemn this xenophobia. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95166371/505811556/-1100921962?refcode=2024-10-16-aapi&recurring=&amount=10&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=a30f8738-f98b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzBmODczOC1mOThiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Kj1f0txsZ_iOwJucqr0vrzRZiyaguh-6ha9oMVQG0Ck=) When I first ran for Congress, mailers were sent out with my name in Chinese take-out font. TV ads with the phrase "Andy Kim He's Not One of Us." I tried to ignore it, but I realized that I should have done more to stand up. Unfortunately, we see hate growing in our country. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95166372/505811557/-1100921962?refcode=2024-10-16-aapi&recurring=&amount=10&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=a30f8738-f98b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzBmODczOC1mOThiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Kj1f0txsZ_iOwJucqr0vrzRZiyaguh-6ha9oMVQG0Ck=) In California, Derek Tran is running against Rep. Michelle Steel. Steel is now using these horrible mailers. Tran is the son of Vietnamese refugees who fled communism. He served in the US Army. Steel is accusing him of supporting communism. Shameful. She should apologize. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95166373/505811558/-1100921962?refcode=2024-10-16-aapi&recurring=&amount=10&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=a30f8738-f98b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzBmODczOC1mOThiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Kj1f0txsZ_iOwJucqr0vrzRZiyaguh-6ha9oMVQG0Ck=) Sadly, Steel did the same against a Taiwanese American candidate two years ago named Jay Chen. Steel accused Chen, a lieutenant commander in our US Naval Reserves, of supporting communism. It's disgusting that she inflames racist tropes. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95166374/505811559/-1100921962?refcode=2024-10-16-aapi&recurring=&amount=10&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=a30f8738-f98b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzBmODczOC1mOThiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Kj1f0txsZ_iOwJucqr0vrzRZiyaguh-6ha9oMVQG0Ck=) Last week, Dave Min, a Korean American running for Congress, had his lawn signs defaced with painfully racist insults. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95166375/505811560/-1100921962?refcode=2024-10-16-aapi&recurring=&amount=10&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=a30f8738-f98b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzBmODczOC1mOThiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Kj1f0txsZ_iOwJucqr0vrzRZiyaguh-6ha9oMVQG0Ck=) These attacks push the "perpetual foreigner" trope that Asians have allegiance to and could be spies for another country like China or North Korea. This is dangerous. An attacker stabbed a woman in Indiana and said that's "one less person to blow up our country." When I worked at the State Department, I found out I was banned from working on the Korean Peninsula because I'm Korean American. I was humiliated. I felt disrespected that my government didn't trust me, even after serving as a civilian advisor in a war zone in Afghanistan. I am as American as anyone else. I have every bit as much right to run for office as anyone else. Derek Tran and Dave Min have as much right to run for Congress as anyone else. The best way to fight against this racism is to win these elections. Show that the American people won't fall for racist attacks. Show that these candidates are undeterred. Show that AAPI candidates can appeal not just to people who look like us. If elected, I'll be the first Korean American senator after 120 years of Koreans in America. I'll be the first AAPI Senator from the East Coast. I'm proud, but I yearn for the day when I don't need to break barriers, and I don't have my love for this country questioned. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95166376/505811561/-1100921962?refcode=2024-10-16-aapi&recurring=&amount=10&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=a30f8738-f98b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzBmODczOC1mOThiLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Kj1f0txsZ_iOwJucqr0vrzRZiyaguh-6ha9oMVQG0Ck=) Our stories are not just Asian American stories, they are American stories. clean_body: This is a disgusting attack, and I urge New Jersey Republican leaders to condemn this xenophobia. | | | | Last night, a Republican delegate from New Jersey accused me of wearing a North Korean flag on my tie and questioned my allegiance to America. This is a disgusting attack, and I urge New Jersey Republican leaders to condemn this xenophobia. = When I first ran for Congress, mailers were sent out with my name in Chinese take-out font. TV ads with the phrase "Andy Kim He's Not One of Us." I tried to ignore it, but I realized that I should have done more to stand up. Unfortunately, we see hate growing in our country. = In California, Derek Tran is running against Rep. Michelle Steel. Steel is now using these horrible mailers. Tran is the son of Vietnamese refugees who fled communism. He served in the US Army. Steel is accusing him of supporting communism. Shameful. She should apologize. = Sadly, Steel did the same against a Taiwanese American candidate two years ago named Jay Chen. Steel accused Chen, a lieutenant commander in our US Naval Reserves, of supporting communism. It's disgusting that she inflames racist tropes. = Last week, Dave Min, a Korean American running for Congress, had his lawn signs defaced with painfully racist insults. = These attacks push the "perpetual foreigner" trope that Asians have allegiance to and could be spies for another country like China or North Korea. This is dangerous. An attacker stabbed a woman in Indiana and said that's "one less person to blow up our country." When I worked at the State Department, I found out I was banned from working on the Korean Peninsula because I'm Korean American. I was humiliated. I felt disrespected that my government didn't trust me, even after serving as a civilian advisor in a war zone in Afghanistan. I am as American as anyone else. I have every bit as much right to run for office as anyone else. Derek Tran and Dave Min have as much right to run for Congress as anyone else. The best way to fight against this racism is to win these elections. Show that the American people won't fall for racist attacks. Show that these candidates are undeterred. Show that AAPI candidates can appeal not just to people who look like us. If elected, I'll be the first Korean American senator after 120 years of Koreans in America. I'll be the first AAPI Senator from the East Coast. I'm proud, but I yearn for the day when I don't need to break barriers, and I don't have my love for this country questioned. = Our stories are not just Asian American stories, they are American stories. Reject racism. Reject those who spread racism. Friend,

I want to tell you why I’m inspired by Dan Osborn, an industrial mechanic running to be Nebraska’s next senator.

But first, I need your help. Dan is under attack from Mitch McConnell and right-wing billionaire-funded super PACs. They know he could be the deciding vote in the US Senate. We can’t let them do it.

A Navy and Nebraska National Guard veteran, he put his college education on hold and took a job as an industrial mechanic at the Kellogg’s plant in Omaha to support his family. He worked 50-, 60-, and sometimes 90-hour weeks. During his last year at the factory, he picked up 33 different 16-hour shifts on Sundays to give his family a better life.

Dan was elected president of his union, BCTGM Local 50G. He successfully led a 77-day strike in 2021 at the Omaha Kellogg’s plant, securing 500 jobs and worker benefits. Kellogg’s retaliated by firing Osborn for leading the strike.

Dan isn’t taking any corporate PAC money because he isn’t in this race to represent corporations or the wealthy. He spent 20 years working for a major corporation, and he knows how important it is for working Americans to have a seat at the table.

The polls are clear: this is a Senate race we can win. But Dan can’t do it alone.

clean_body: [] Friend, I want to tell you why I’m inspired by Dan Osborn, an industrial mechanic running to be Nebraska’s next senator. But first, I need your help. Dan is under attack from Mitch McConnell and right-wing billionaire-funded super PACs. They know he could be the deciding vote in the US Senate. We can’t let them do it. Can you rush a contribution to Dan’s campaign right now? [] [] Dan Osborn knows what it’s like to work for a living. A Navy and Nebraska National Guard veteran, he put his college education on hold and took a job as an industrial mechanic at the Kellogg’s plant in Omaha to support his family. He worked 50-, 60-, and sometimes 90-hour weeks. During his last year at the factory, he picked up 33 different 16-hour shifts on Sundays to give his family a better life. Dan was elected president of his union, BCTGM Local 50G. He successfully led a 77-day strike in 2021 at the Omaha Kellogg’s plant, securing 500 jobs and worker benefits. Kellogg’s retaliated by firing Osborn for leading the strike. [] FiveThirtyEight is calling this the closest Senate race in the country. Five brand-new polls show Dan is narrowly leading his Republican opponent, Deb Fischer, and Republicans are getting scared. Mitch McConnell and his Super PAC billionaire buddies are spending over $8.8 million on new TV ads attacking Dan. They know that if he’s elected, he will hold the 51st vote needed to stop a complete national abortion ban, get money out of politics, and take on the billionaires. Dan isn’t taking any corporate PAC money because he isn’t in this race to represent corporations or the wealthy. He spent 20 years working for a major corporation, and he knows how important it is for working Americans to have a seat at the table. The polls are clear: this is a Senate race we can win. But Dan can’t do it alone. Can you rush a donation today to show Dan the nation has his back? [] DONATE [] Thank you for your support, your activism, and everything you do. Survival Ops here... and I have something exciting to share with you.

I'm really pumped about this because it's been a work in progress for months and I think we've finally nailed it!

So enough giddyness... are you ready to {tackle your next adventure head-on}?

Yea?

Well let me introduce you to the [{Tactical GO Bag}](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18815/6374453/110257a55ab8491d5f17a0060e2a6669e69c25fa/50e300e27c38f140b81129b2015254133cac7da3) \- your new, feature-packed, best friend who is ready to kick it with you on any outdoor escapade.

This isn’t just some run-of-mill backpack; it really is a game changer... because a few recognized survival experts put their minds together and helped develop this {incredible bag}.

They designed it to withstand the rigors of hiking, camping, fishing and traveling.

You can literally kick its ass and it'll never skip a beat.

That alone makes it hella special.

But there's more ... oh man, so much more... [I'll throw you some highlights here.](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18815/6374453/110257a55ab8491d5f17a0060e2a6669e69c25fa/50e300e27c38f140b81129b2015254133cac7da3)

Our Bag has tactical MOLLE straps that you can SECURELY attach all kinds of gear to while still having EASY access when you need it.

And one of my favorite features... the multi-military-style compartments that this bag has that will help you stay organized like a true pro.

All those compartments combined gives you a whopping 42 liters of storage. You can cram it full and still have room for more.

Also, don't forget to look inside... you'll find some interior storage surprises too!

And of course the ventilated mesh padding on the back and shoulder straps means you won’t feel weighted down - ever.

Throw in an adjustable chest strap as well to provide even more support, making long hikes or trips a breeze.

So there you have it...

Whether you need a[ {bug-out bag, a three-day assault pack, or a sleek laptop day pack}](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18815/6374453/110257a55ab8491d5f17a0060e2a6669e69c25fa/50e300e27c38f140b81129b2015254133cac7da3), this bag adapts and conforms to your lifestyle while keeping you COMFORTABLE.

It’s perfect for both urban adventures and off-grid excursions.

And currently there is an unbeatable deal going on.

You can test one out for ZERO cost. You just pay shipping.

But time is ticking.

[{Hurry before the offers ends!}](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18815/6374453/110257a55ab8491d5f17a0060e2a6669e69c25fa/50e300e27c38f140b81129b2015254133cac7da3)

Adventure awaits!

The numbers are staggering - MILLIONS of illegal entries into our country since Biden took office, with that number increasing each and every single day.

Our border patrol agents are overwhelmed, our communities are being overrun, and our national security is at risk.

I'm reaching out to you today because this is an issue we can no longer let Joe Biden and Kamala Harris ignore. I've taken on the Biden Administration and the open-borders crowd in Congress, and I've won some big victories - **[but I need your help to keep on fighting.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.-Vt2XQ "but I need your help to keep on fighting.")**

The Democrats are pumping MILLIONS into Arizona to try and take me down, and that's why I need your support to stay in this fight.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. Team — I’m a little confused.

On September 30th this team came together and helped us put up an incredible day of fundraising. One of the best of the campaign.

It was awesome. It put some wind in my sails, honestly. Gave me hope.

But... since then we’ve had one of the worst fundraising stretches in months. No joke. People just aren’t chipping in, and that is a huge problem.

My team’s getting really worried. I’ve told them to take it day by day, but I promised I’d reach out and ask you — what happened?

Do people really think this race is all wrapped up? Cause I can tell you, personally, that it’s not. This state is going to be decided by less votes than it takes to fill a football stadium, and that is the truth. Arizona isn’t a blue state. Until very recently it was one of the reddest states in the country, and it could very easily go that way again.

But right now, we’re not pacing to our goals. We’re not pacing to stop Trump and Kari Lake from winning this November. And if we don’t pick things back up — FAST — we’re going to be in real trouble. I hope you're having a great day so far. I'm reaching out to share something important with you...something that could expand your horizons. I'm talking about studying American history! As Hillsdale College professor Wilfred McClay explains in our online course ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=44aeec9337054463b1b8703918f0d3d4&_e=Uawbq9ytmRKVFN0C8iE7AI3JFvy7hzbWvRCAB4h4h8UpC-a_Uaj7h-oAsoomQb10H4Ap6qGCX_GqCsybmi_PiOK0wkWErK1OripQc-cyU4PD-wUDgq4xbWFpaF1XZDG8Q3dFISpJl6unaaSsdlgSwrCokpdihXe_jSFECmCM96AI9aCpnn_HKRxZuL720ecGCJfuzCRMvxDWkxwIfCW4y7qgJgarOT6fgNWtYOnwOngDegFo929aVapv_1zYmiBBCPFMUujylF5p47f59jFrgexLrv9cfIahah5hMwgp96dHz1GtV6F_rGYx08UckQfILn6S4hjkz4EoaWkV5LG4UF4gFUx7y-7Zegb1cyt_FwwchkhLNznAU5iiHYAuKoTJLVRyUMJjT_PfY8DBXcTyfr8uFZKwAzqbr_VhSfRHHdY%3D) studying history can broaden your perspective and help you understand different ways of living. Compare that to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," now a multi-part series streaming online. The "1619 Project" locates the founding of America in 1619, the year the first slave arrived on our shores, rather than in 1776, when the **Declaration of Independence declared that all men are created equal with unalienable God-given rights**. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom but slavery--and the project's main goal is to broadcast this false teaching into every home, including yours. We must counter this false and dishonest historical narrative with the truth. **That 's why we've turned our online course, ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=44aeec9337054463b1b8703918f0d3d4&_e=Uawbq9ytmRKVFN0C8iE7AI3JFvy7hzbWvRCAB4h4h8UpC-a_Uaj7h-oAsoomQb10H4Ap6qGCX_GqCsybmi_PiOK0wkWErK1OripQc-cyU4PD-wUDgq4xbWFpaF1XZDG8Q3dFISpJl6unaaSsdlgSwrCokpdihXe_jSFECmCM96AI9aCpnn_HKRxZuL720ecGCJfuzCRMvxDWkxwIfCW4y7qgJgarOT6fgNWtYOnwOngDegFo929aVapv_1zYmiBBCPFMUujylF5p47f59jFrgX5q9Hz0uZqswwAd21o8-_D3PMZhs3Mnz3NDx0dsANKPHx1v0ncCpI2rjzUqfU-D_m_TMgJF3ViWl-5A0HndEb3weD9QqOZBng7I92v_2nhRt2zGqsP5gxW5oXBhs7chwnwJ8zhyv2iKKvxMK7jbK4I%3D) into a DVD set, and I'd like you to have a copy.** **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** presents a full, unbiased account of America's past. We produced this course to restore the kind of intelligent patriotism--especially among our young people--essential to restoring free government. You'll be excited to learn that **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** is a powerful counterweight to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," which tells people, especially children, that America is essentially an unjust nation--the opposite of our nation's unifying principles. | O ver the past hundred years, baby-naming trends have largely been shaped by family traditions and popular culture. Classic names such as Mary, John, Betty, and James often appear repeatedly in family trees, passed down out of respect for previous generations and a desire to keep family legacies alive. By the latter half of the 20th century, pop culture began to leave its mark, too, and names such as Jennifer, Michael, Emily, and Jacob topped the list year after year. Here's a look at the most popular girls’ and boys’ names of the last century.

| | _**Freedom and Opportunity Bus Tour Kicks Off Across Northern Indiana
**_ The Indiana Republican Party, along with multiple Republican candidates, will kick off the first weekend of the 2024 Indiana GOP Freedom and Opportunity bus tour.
---
In attendance will be Republican gubernatorial nominee and Senator Mike Braun, Lieutenant Governor Candidate Micah Beckwith, Attorney General Todd Rokita, State Comptroller Elise Nieshalla, congressional candidate Randy Niemeyer, Congressman Rudy Yakym, and congressional candidate Marlin Stutzman!
Come out to one of our stops near you! Your support for our Republican ticket is vital and will fuel us as we race towards the finish line in November! If you plan to attend, please RSVP to Alex Hickner, Grassroots Director, at [ahickner@indiana.gop](mailto:ahickner@indiana.gop "ahickner@indiana.gop"). _Tentative Schedule - All times are EST unless specified._ _**Saturday, October 19**_
* 10:45 am - 12:00 pm: **Allen County GOP HQ** \- 135 W. Main St. Fort Wayne, IN 46802
* **In Attendance:**
* IN GOP Gubernatorial Nominee **Mike Braun**
* LG Candidate **Micah Beckwith**
* Attorney General **Todd Rokita**
* Congressional candidate **Marlin Stutzman**

* 1:15 pm - 2:30 pm: **Kosciusko County GOP HQ** \- 123 W. Center St. Warsaw, IN 46580
* **In Attendance:**
* IN GOP Gubernatorial Nominee **Mike Braun**
* LG Candidate **Micah Beckwith**
* Attorney General **Todd Rokita**
* Congressional candidate **Marlin Stutzman**
* Congressman **Rudy Yakym**
* State Comptroller **Elise Nieshalla**

* 3:30 pm - 4:45 pm: **St. Joseph County, Hoosier Conservative Voices** \- 2307 Edison Rd. South Bend, IN 46615
* **In Attendance:**
* IN GOP Gubernatorial Nominee **Mike Braun**
* Congressman **Rudy Yakym**
* State Comptroller **Elise Nieshalla**

* 5:00 pm CT - 7:00 pm CT: **Porter County Fairgrounds** \- 215 E. Division Rd. Valparaiso, IN 46383
* **In Attendance:**
* IN GOP Gubernatorial Nominee **Mike Braun**
* Congressional candidate **Randy Niemeyer**
* State Comptroller **Elise Nieshalla**

| | | Dear Fellow Patriot,

Six years ago, Lizzie Fletcher fooled us into believing she was a "moderate." **_She's anything but. _**

Lizzie votes lock-step with her party, putting the left's agenda and the needs of the DC elite above the needs of you and your family.

---
| [Donate Now To STOP Lizzie](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=ce9cf66c13&e=522547b974 "Donate Now To STOP Lizzie")
---
| **HERE'S HOW:** Lizzie [voted](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=bc0354d500&e=522547b974)[ ](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=b7db6bb677&e=522547b974)against the Parental Bill of Rights (H.R. 5), which would have protected parental authority in schools and ensured parents were notified about critical decisions related to their child's health and safety.

Lizzie [voted](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=a67b2647ab&e=522547b974) against Restoring Energy Dominance and [stood](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=af72645dbd&e=522547b974) by Biden's harmful, anti-American energy policies while representing us, the home of Houston's Energy Corridor.

Lizzie[ voted](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=9fe30f0f14&e=522547b974) against the Secure Border Act and [the SAVE Act,](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=99169d63a0&e=522547b974) both of which would have protected our border and prevented illegals from voting in US Elections.

Lizzie [voted](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=0460ac5fb0&e=522547b974) against the POLICE ACT, which would immediately deport illegal immigrants who assault law enforcement officers.

Lizzie [voted](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=71d8dd58ac&e=522547b974) for the Build Back Better Act, which would have raised taxes by $1 trillion on American workers and businesses.

Lizzie [voted](https://carolinekaneforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=717a41e4858de35bfe1b5917d&id=f2ad9cb62c&e=522547b974) for the Inflation Reduction Act (The Green New Deal or Climate Justice Act), which paved the way for $20 billion in tax increases on those making less than $400k and funded 87,000 new IRS agents to target middle-class families. _ _

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Hello Friends,We are thrilled to share some incredible news! [This quarter, our campaign has outraised our opponent, despite his significant fundraising, and we now have more cash on hand.](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6710301f7109780caa481229&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.newsfromthestates.com%2Farticle%2Fdemocrat-gloria-witt-surpasses-5th-district-gop-rival-john-mcguire-latest-fundraising&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_67102b0371336e6fb44d2fb1&l=en-US&s=wUCbeh4E1ODFy1o9n9Ft4Lfuq5k%3D) This victory is not just about the numbers; it’s about the heart and soul of this campaign—and that heart is **YOU**.**We’re incredibly proud of every dollar raised because each one reflects the hard work and dedication of nearly 2,000 supporters across the 5th District.** Your belief in this campaign when many had none has fueled over 150 events in every corner of the district. It’s allowed us to build a robust media presence, purchase thousands of signs, print tens of thousands of literature pieces, and pay a small but talented professional staff to help drive our message of positive change.This campaign is about people, not money. **Together, we will create real change that puts the needs of the 5th District front and center.** Our movement is bigger than partisan politics or any one candidate—it’s about improving the lives of the citizens of Virginia’s 5th. We are fighting for policies that will truly serve the people.[For those who haven’t yet contributed, there’s never been a more critical time to join us.](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6710301f7109780caa481229&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fwitt4congress%3Frefcode%3Dab_qr_code%26utm_source%3Dqr_code&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_67102b0371336e6fb44d2fb1&l=en-US&s=gxWHX1Bmaz02nvpWAThfsw_63jA%3D) Every dollar counts in our fight to ensure we reach every voter and share our vision for a better future.**Thank you for believing in this campaign.** Together, we’re going to make history on Election Day.
---
With determination,Gloria Witt

| | | Peter, This is going to be a longer email than usual, but we believe it’s VERY important that you read all the way through. But we get it, you might not have time.**So if you would instead like to make a 5X matched donation to take down Lauren Boebert right now,** **[please click here.](http://links.defeatboebertpac.com/u/click?_t=c3d87ac674644038b5146447a156028d&_m=5b6090fa2bb044e7b43426ad4d636fb5&_e=BUVWaUTynpBgfx3vpHwv3ii2uWq6cYga7qmq1MzolpFwt8tXIxyaFKFnHQz3fc-q8L9CClBbnHXnRMGRrGNDrei9I9iJudG16oo4R2ZxNMpxojgCX_p82d9MArxRVosjsYNBHl29RcUjHBt6An6MmbKQi-_eMJrQl_XUplQ0m0Y2RmQqjlZPwi3QiYlVlDdkcaom6FByYXPaK3_O0yYJ7c1afEBppTFRCqWfBJ4_2eHpIknbv1_bnW6crcsWLmHhRvigoO-xAxIRzGCQPnlnX6hVU26JIK5oos_wyOCdgyvLhOry6GTr6QRMzzxIRCPZywOwgDaNC-B7e8OqMhJmBmunl-vqqmrfX-mKRJ18Y776VrNBSe9Dx1wx1S3XJabQ9SNZ9dnqORVTYo95Y785pBFrHzcTfIRpfbdEx9Go0S3FHGo7F7QCYnO9hojSgoTT)**
* * *
Last week, Lauren Boebert headlined a Trump rally with this guy: [](http://links.defeatboebertpac.com/u/click?_t=c3d87ac674644038b5146447a156028d&_m=5b6090fa2bb044e7b43426ad4d636fb5&_e=BUVWaUTynpBgfx3vpHwv3ii2uWq6cYga7qmq1MzolpFwt8tXIxyaFKFnHQz3fc-q8L9CClBbnHXnRMGRrGNDrei9I9iJudG16oo4R2ZxNMpxojgCX_p82d9MArxRVosjsYNBHl29RcUjHBt6An6MmbKQi-_eMJrQl_XUplQ0m0Y2RmQqjlZPwi3QiYlVlDdkcaom6FByYXPaK3_O0yYJ7c1afEBppTFRCqWfBJ4_2eHpIknbv1_bnW6crcsWLmHhRvigoO-xAxIRzGCQPnlnXyizTAn5mrWpCkLgjp1dJ41RvZ5Gp18RT301yoq-Gq77uhld7os_2l0V8DZoOXjgEn6T1F2CWa9SSbyiPmfdJVp6S0LLbKnmEpXsn50rvs9Q4cISsb6hxGKfB06SYeBjX0mcPamXUFa6F6I3X3JJSB66z5x7KNc5dhKw60DDsYFS) That’s Stephen Miller. He worked in Trump’s first administration and was the architect behind the Muslim Ban, Child Separation, and putting kids in cages. **Now, he is openly advocating for the implementation of Project 2025 and the mass deportation of not just illegal immigrants, but of the natural-born children of illegal immigrants as well.** His plans are to _use the full force of the United States military to deport tens of millions of people_ he and Trump deem undesirable. And in recent remarks, Trump has made it clear he may use the military against folks in this country and won’t stop at people here illegally—**but he may also call on them to detain Democrats he deems to be his enemies.** Miller openly called for a fascist takeover of this country to kick-off the rally, and Lauren Boebert followed up with even more ugly and racist remarks aimed specifically at anyone in this country of Latino descent. [](http://links.defeatboebertpac.com/u/click?_t=c3d87ac674644038b5146447a156028d&_m=5b6090fa2bb044e7b43426ad4d636fb5&_e=BUVWaUTynpBgfx3vpHwv3ii2uWq6cYga7qmq1MzolpFwt8tXIxyaFKFnHQz3fc-q8L9CClBbnHXnRMGRrGNDrei9I9iJudG16oo4R2ZxNMpxojgCX_p82d9MArxRVosjsYNBHl29RcUjHBt6An6MmbKQi-_eMJrQl_XUplQ0m0Y2RmQqjlZPwi3QiYlVlDdkcaom6FByYXPaK3_O0yYJ7c1afEBppTFRCqWfBJ4_2eHpIknbv1_bnW6crcsWLmHhRvigoO-xAxIRzGCQPnlnX6_GFVgvCBzyM9EscB70Aq92J1fM0UX92DlIssWry6W4u9IDC4qNNOnVsZLC-VolFaT1b9VXAKAsQWPKkujCVR2eB48oNYfJL9wknT5sKEM9eLDpSu7WTE3DzOjxZbqRthFLJNuLBXyIr7YhRqwFar6Mz66ZzkfQjwU-rPUv62ou) Perhaps Boebert doesn’t know, or doesn’t care that _almost 15% of the district she aims to represent is Hispanic_ and 8% are foreign born. She’s a shameless enough politician to demonize the people in her district though—after all, she only decided to run in the 4th when the going got too tough for her in the third. **Donald Trump may be turning into a rambling buffoon before our eyes, but the people around him like Miller, and the people sucking up to him like Boebert are very dangerous. Miller will implement Project 2025 and Boebert will vote to pass a national abortion and IVF ban.** **[That cannot be the future that we live in, Peter. If you’re ready to take Trump down and take down Boebert as well, we implore you to consider chipping in $5 today. | Oct. 16, 2024
Election thoughts It's local officials who impact our lives
Congressman John Carter, a conservative Republican representing Bell and Williamson counties, was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives, District 31, in 2003. He is a conservative Republican who lives in Round Rock. When Donald Trump ran for president in 2015, Carter advised Williamson County Republicans to "hold your nose" and vote for him. On January 6, 2021, after a violent mob attacked Congress and physically threatened Vice President Pence and Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi, Carter voted against certifying the results of the 2020 U.S. presidential election.
Before being elected to the House of Representatives, Carter served as District Judge in Williamson County for four terms. He was generally esteemed for his work on the bench.
Early on, I thought the congressman did a fine job for his district, logically focusing on military matters since Fort Cavazos (formerly Fort Hood) is a big part of his Bell County constituency. Once open and cheerful, in recent years Mr. Carter became harder to reach for those outside an inner circle. I last saw him a few years ago at a Republican women's luncheon at Berry Creek Country Club and came away worried about him. He looked pale and exhausted, though he gave a peppy talk and basked in the ladies' admiration.
This election, Congressman Carter has drawn a challenge from lifelong Democrat Stuart Whitlow of Cedar Park, who grew up in Round Rock and graduated from Round Rock High School and Southwestern University before receiving graduate degrees in divinity (Vanderbilt), law (UTexas), and public service (LBJ School). He practiced law in Austin and Round Rock but pared down to work with Texas Legal Services Center to provide 7,000 people with free legal assistance and to help launch Capital IDEA, an Austin non-profit whose mission is to give qualifying young adults a free college education, setting the stage for a huge boost to their careers and future income. Since 1998, when it started, about 800 adults per year have gotten a college education through Capital IDEA partnering with Austin Community College and Temple College.
If elected, Whitlow would help provide a Democratic majority in the U.S. House. High on his legislative agenda are restoring reproductive rights, expanding Medicaid in Texas, supporting public education and ending gun violence.
I will cast my vote for Stuart Whitlow and recommend him to anyone sharing his moderate-liberal beliefs. He appears to be a serious and kind man with the energy and capability to create legislation favoring his top public issues. I believe he would develop into a fine congressman along the lines of the late Congressman J.J. Jake" Pickle of Austin, in whose office Whitlow worked briefly as a young man, giving him the opportunity to observe and learn from a master.

Above all else, today's recommendation underscores just how much bipartisan support our campaign is generating (it's almost unprecedented). It's one of the clearest indicators yet that voters of TX-31 are ready to replace John Carter and send new, pragmatic leadership in Washington. It's a new day here in Texas 31, and I've never been prouder of what we all stand for. We've also included a copy below. | | | | Oct. 16, 2024 Election thoughts It's local officials who impact our lives Congressman John Carter, a conservative Republican representing Bell and Williamson counties, was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives, District 31, in 2003. He is a conservative Republican who lives in Round Rock. When Donald Trump ran for president in 2015, Carter advised Williamson County Republicans to "hold your nose" and vote for him. On January 6, 2021, after a violent mob attacked Congress and physically threatened Vice President Pence and Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi, Carter voted against certifying the results of the 2020 U.S. presidential election. Before being elected to the House of Representatives, Carter served as District Judge in Williamson County for four terms. He was generally esteemed for his work on the bench. Early on, I thought the congressman did a fine job for his district, logically focusing on military matters since Fort Cavazos (formerly Fort Hood) is a big part of his Bell County constituency. Once open and cheerful, in recent years Mr. Carter became harder to reach for those outside an inner circle. I last saw him a few years ago at a Republican women's luncheon at Berry Creek Country Club and came away worried about him. He looked pale and exhausted, though he gave a peppy talk and basked in the ladies' admiration. This election, Congressman Carter has drawn a challenge from lifelong Democrat Stuart Whitlow of Cedar Park, who grew up in Round Rock and graduated from Round Rock High School and Southwestern University before receiving graduate degrees in divinity (Vanderbilt), law (UTexas), and public service (LBJ School). He practiced law in Austin and Round Rock but pared down to work with Texas Legal Services Center to provide 7,000 people with free legal assistance and to help launch Capital IDEA, an Austin non-profit whose mission is to give qualifying young adults a free college education, setting the stage for a huge boost to their careers and future income. Since 1998, when it started, about 800 adults per year have gotten a college education through Capital IDEA partnering with Austin Community College and Temple College. If elected, Whitlow would help provide a Democratic majority in the U.S. House. High on his legislative agenda are restoring reproductive rights, expanding Medicaid in Texas, supporting public education and ending gun violence. I will cast my vote for Stuart Whitlow and recommend him to anyone sharing his moderate-liberal beliefs. He appears to be a serious and kind man with the energy and capability to create legislation favoring his top public issues. I believe he would develop into a fine congressman along the lines of the late Congressman J.J. Jake" Pickle of Austin, in whose office Whitlow worked briefly as a young man, giving him the opportunity to observe and learn from a master. | | | == | | == | | == | == | == == == | | | PAID FOR BY WHITLOW FOR CONGRESS | | | | Whitlow for Congress | 910 Quest Parkway Suite 6113 | Cedar Park, TX 78613 US | |

Weather the Storm: Hurricanes & The Latino Vote on Climate Change
The Latino Vote Episode 58
| Chuck and Mike dive into the intersection of natural disasters and politics, focusing on the **impact of Hurricane Milton on Florida's communities** and its implications on the Latino community. With a heartfelt discussion on personal connections to the storm and its effects on family, they explore how **climate change is reshaping political conversations among voters, particularly for Latinos**. Yes, you read that right.
Jim Jordan is actually trying to send us back to 1920 – or maybe his ideal world is straight out of The Handmaid’s Tale .
Either way, it’s clear that Jordan is deeply uncomfortable with women having a say in their own lives and the country’s future.
What kind of man votes to strip rights away from women because he’s too insecure to deal with a level playing field?

The SAVE Act would make it harder for women – especially married women – to vote by requiring stricter ID laws that disproportionately affect women who’ve changed their last name.
Jim Jordan sponsored this backwards bill. He voted for it. And he keeps giving speeches promoting it.
It seems like every time we turn around, Jordan is coming up with a new way to make life harder for women.

I mean, let’s just call it what it is: Jordan’s dangerous obsession with stripping women of their rights is his pathetic way of compensating for his own warped insecurities.
He’s clearly too threatened by strong women, so his solution is to make sure we can’t make our voices heard at the ballot box.
What a coward.
But here’s the thing – we’re not going back. Not on our watch. HELL NO!
Jim Jordan might want to drag us back to an era where women had no power, but we’re going to fight him every step of the way - and we’re gonna win.

Apparently, voting rights for women are just a little too modern for him. This time, he’s gone after the very women who’ve had enough of his nonsense by co-sponsoring and voting for the SAVE Act – a law so backward, it would make it nearly impossible for many married women to vote. Yes, you read that right. Jim Jordan is actually trying to send us back to 1920 – or maybe his ideal world is straight out of The Handmaid’s Tale . Either way, it’s clear that Jordan is deeply uncomfortable with women having a say in their own lives and the country’s future. What kind of man votes to strip rights away from women because he’s too insecure to deal with a level playing field? Contribute $25, $50, or even $100 today to help us kick this misogynistic coward out of Congress for good. Jim Jordan sponsored this backwards bill. He voted for it. And he keeps giving speeches promoting it. It seems like every time we turn around, Jordan is coming up with a new way to make life harder for women. Whether it’s attacking our reproductive rights or, now, trying to suppress women’s votes, his creepy fixation on controlling women is becoming more obvious by the day. I mean, let’s just call it what it is: Jordan’s dangerous obsession with stripping women of their rights is his pathetic way of compensating for his own warped insecurities. He’s clearly too threatened by strong women, so his solution is to make sure we can’t make our voices heard at the ballot box. What a coward. But here’s the thing – we’re not going back. body:
This is why we have to beat Ted Cruz on November 5.
#

[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-allred-split.ZUVW7D&refcode=em241016-4-160&t=1&akid=3379%2E734936%2EPu8kH0)
Peter, last night on the debate stage, I told Ted Cruz directly to his face that he was a threat to democracy for inciting the mob that overtook our Capitol on January 6.
And what was his response? _He laughed!!_
There's nothing funny about this, Peter.
I was on the House floor on January 6 when rioters breached the Capitol.
First, I heard the glass break. **Then, as they pounded on the doors, I texted my wife Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second son:_"Whatever happens, I love you."**_
I took off my jacket and got ready to fight anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, it never came to that.
**But while I was barricaded on the House floor with my colleagues with our gas masks in hand,**Ted Cruz – who had cheered on the mob earlier that day – _hid in a supply closet._ **
In just 20 days, we have the chance to replace Ted Cruz and give Texans the Senator we deserve.
But after last night's debate, a fresh wave of GOP spending is pouring into Texas to crush our momentum in this final push. And the latest polling still shows this race locked neck and neck.
**There's no doubt in my mind that we can win this race and finally hold Ted Cruz accountable – but ONLY if we have the resources to do it.[So please, will you split a donation between me and Ruben Gallego now to fuel our grassroots movement to victory and defeat Ted Cruz once and for all? clean_body: This is why we have to beat Ted Cruz on November 5. Peter, last night on the debate stage, I told Ted Cruz directly to his face that he was a threat to democracy for inciting the mob that overtook our Capitol on January 6. And what was his response? He laughed!! There's nothing funny about this, Peter. I was on the House floor on January 6 when rioters breached the Capitol. First, I heard the glass break. Then, as they pounded on the doors, I texted my wife Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second son:"Whatever happens, I love you." I took off my jacket and got ready to fight anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, it never came to that. But while I was barricaded on the House floor with my colleagues with our gas masks in hand,Ted Cruz – who had cheered on the mob earlier that day – hid in a supply closet. In just 20 days, we have the chance to replace Ted Cruz and give Texans the Senator we deserve. But after last night's debate, a fresh wave of GOP spending is pouring into Texas to crush our momentum in this final push. And the latest polling still shows this race locked neck and neck. There's no doubt in my mind that we can win this race and finally hold Ted Cruz accountable – but ONLY if we have the resources to do it. I’m campaigning in Nevada this weekend for Harris-Walz.
I'm headed to Nevada, Peter!
**With less than 20 days until Election Day, I’m heading out on the campaign trail this weekend as a surrogate for the Harris-Walz campaign, rallying voters in the critical swing state of Nevada.**
Like Texas, Nevada is a diverse state, a working-class state, and a state that’s growing rapidly. And also like Texas, Nevada is a state that Democrats can and should win, if we do the hard work in these final days.
That’s why our trip will focus on two key voting groups in 2024:**Latino voters and young men. **
Unfortunately, Donald Trump has made gains with Latino voters and young men, particularly young men of color. But the more these voters learn about his extreme agenda, the less likely they are to support him.

name: Justice Democrats
subject: Cori introduced the ceasefire resolution one year ago today
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, on this day
one year ago, Justice Democrats members Cori Bush, Rashida Tlaib, Summer
Lee, and Delia Ramirez introduced a resolution in Congress calling for an
immediate, lasting ceasefire, the return of Israeli and Palestinian
hostages, and for humanitarian aid to freely enter Gaza.

Fellow Justice Democrats Jamaal Bowman, Ilhan Omar, Ayanna Pressley, AOC,
Greg Casar, and Pramila Jayapal joined them in support of this resolution
for peace, demonstrating the necessity of our progressive bloc’s
leadership in Congress.

Unfortunately, Cori, Rashida, Summer, Delia, and other Justice Democrats
were attacked and vilified by colleagues on both sides of the aisle for
leading the call for a ceasefire, and their resolution never passed. The
war crimes, genocide, and ethnic cleansing carried out by the Netanyahu
Administration were allowed to continue unfettered for the past year, with
the help of billions of dollars in U.S. weapons and bombs.

Now, Gaza has been turned to rubble, more than 41,000 Palestinians have
been massacred by the Israeli military, and millions of Palestinians are
at risk of starvation and death due to ongoing violence and a lack of
food, clean water, and medical supplies being blocked by the IDF.

Meanwhile, the Biden administration wants to send another $20 billion in
weapons to Israel.

But our progressive leaders in Congress haven’t given up the fight for
peace, and neither can we. Justice Democrats members are leading the call
for an arms embargo, and for the first time in U.S. history, there will be
a vote in Congress to block weapons to Israel.

[ https://www.jewishvoiceforpeace.org/resource/tell-senators-no-more-weapons-to-israel?source=em20241016-36073 ]Senators Bernie Sanders, Peter Welch, and Jeff Merkley have introduced
Joint Resolutions of Disapproval to stop a $20 billion weapons shipment
approved by the Biden Administration. Will you call your Senators
immediately and tell them to block these weapons, and to support a full
arms embargo?

[ https://www.jewishvoiceforpeace.org/resource/tell-senators-no-more-weapons-to-israel?source=em20241016-36073 ]Call Your Senator

The only reason the United States hasn’t secured a ceasefire in the last
year is because we continue to arm the Israeli military’s genocide. There
are millions of people counting on us to take action and stop our
government from funding this continued destruction. The immense loss of
life is already devastating, but we can still save countless lives and end
Israel’s forced humanitarian crisis against the people of Gaza if Congress
and the Biden Administration act now.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

And that battle is just beginning.** **That’s why I helped create Educated. body:

Peter, last night on the debate stage, I told Ted Cruz directly
to his face that he was a threat to democracy for inciting the mob that
overtook our Capitol on January 6.

And what was his response? He laughed!!

There's nothing funny about this,
Peter.

I was on the House floor on January 6 when rioters breached the Capitol.

Peter, I heard the glass break. Then, as they pounded on the
doors, I texted my wife Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second
son: "Whatever happens, I love you."

I took off my jacket and got ready to fight anyone who came through the
door. Thankfully, it never came to that.

But while I was barricaded on the House floor with my colleagues with our
gas masks in hand, Ted Cruz – who had cheered on the mob earlier that day
– hid in a supply closet.

In just 20 days, we have the chance to replace Ted Cruz and give Texans
the Senator we deserve.

But after last night's debate, a fresh wave of GOP spending is pouring
into Texas to crush our momentum in this final push. And the latest
polling still shows this race locked neck and neck.

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
OCTOBER 16, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**Former Imperial Beach Mayor Brian Bilbray Endorses Kevin Faulconer for County Supervisor**
SAN DIEGO, CA — Former Imperial Beach Mayor and Congressman Brian Bilbray today announced his endorsement of Kevin Faulconer for San Diego County Supervisor. Bilbray, who was at the forefront of addressing Tijuana River Valley pollution during his time as mayor, stressed that Faulconer’s proven ability to deliver federal resources makes him the right leader to take on the issue once again.
---
[](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=487cb86601&e=784f78234b)
| The Tijuana River Valley pollution crisis has plagued San Diego’s South Bay communities for decades. Bilbray was an early champion in addressing the problem, working to protect local beaches and secure resources to mitigate cross-border pollution. Faulconer continued that legacy during his time as mayor, securing federal funding in a bipartisan manner to help prevent sewage spills from reaching San Diego’s coastline.
**“Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer is only now talking about the Tijuana River issue —four years into her term—because she has nothing else to show for it,” said Faulconer. “This problem has been ignored long enough, and I’ve proven I can secure real results. As supervisor, I’ll do it again, and I won’t need to virtue signal. San Diego needs leaders who have the experience and relationships to get things done, not politicians who wait until election time to care. This isn’t about empty promises—it’s about action.”**
Faulconer pledged to build on his previous work by holding state and federal agencies accountable and securing the resources necessary to protect public health and the environment in San Diego’s border communities.
For more information about Kevin Faulconer’s campaign for Supervisor and proactive approach to the homeless crisis we’re facing, please visit www.kevinfaulconer.com

subject: Is there ANYTHING we can say before tonight’s midnight deadline?
body:
Please let us try to explain...
---
Derek, is there ANYTHING we can say to convince you to donate to the Democratic National Committee before our final FEC deadline at midnight? Please give us a chance to explain why this request is so important: What if we told you that this is our final FEC fundraising deadline ahead of the election and that all eyes will be on the number we put out? "**One day from execution, Texas rejects Robert Roberson's clemency bid in 'shaken baby' case** ," Austin American-Statesman's **John C. Moritz** -- "The Texas Board of Pardons and Paroles unanimously rejected a clemency application Wednesday for a condemned inmate whose conviction more than 20 years ago rested solely on scientific evidence that many legal and medical experts say has since been discredited.

The rejection comes just one day before death row inmate **Robert Roberson** is scheduled to be executed for the 2002 death of his 2-year-old daughter, **Nikki** , whom he had rushed to the hospital in their hometown town of Palestine in East Texas and told authorities she had fallen out of bed.

Medical staff at the time believed the child was a victim of "shaken baby syndrome." Members of the Texas House Criminal Jurisprudence Committee, however, now say the scientific understanding of shaken baby syndrome has been discredited and they appealed for court intervention.

The Pardons and Paroles Board's decision came just after the Texas Court of Criminal Appeals earlier Wednesday rejected in a 5-4 decision the House committee's plea that Roberson's pending execution be postponed to give the Legislature more time to overhaul a law meant to revisit convictions that were based on flawed science.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER; $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/c21cac75-06ec-4991-9786-817384eac73d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Committee members told the appeals court that Roberson's death sentence handed down in 2003 rested solely on the shaken baby syndrome theory, and they included in their legal brief a statement from Dr. **Norman Guthkelch** , a physician known for establishing the syndrome's hypothesis, saying it should not be relied on to obtain convictions.

"I am frankly quite disturbed that what I intended as a friendly suggestion for avoiding injury to children has become an excuse for imprisoning innocent parents," Guthkelch's statement said.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/c21cac75-06ec-4991-9786-817384eac73d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The appeals court, however, said the committee had failed to show that the law it had invoked in the effort to postpone Roberson's execution was not applicable in the case. The court said it rejected "the application as an abuse of the writ without reviewing the merits of the claims raised."

Roberson is scheduled to be executed after 6 p.m. Thursday.

The Board and Pardons and Paroles [rejected both Roberson's bid for clemency and a bid for an 180-day reprieve.](https://substack.com/redirect/1c5597ad-d7cf-4c09-a7b4-7cc0f6c66c20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Aside from any eleventh-hour appeal in the courts, Roberson's fate now rests with Republican Gov. **Greg Abbott** , who under the law has the option of issuing a one-time 30-day reprieve to allow the condemned man's legal team to pursue other possible avenues to stop the execution."
