($5/mo or $50/yr or $199 lifetime) TOP NEWS "One day from execution, Texas rejects Robert Roberson's clemency bid in 'shaken baby' case ," Austin American-Statesman's John C. Moritz -- "The Texas Board of Pardons and Paroles unanimously rejected a clemency application Wednesday for a condemned inmate whose conviction more than 20 years ago rested solely on scientific evidence that many legal and medical experts say has since been discredited. The rejection comes just one day before death row inmate Robert Roberson is scheduled to be executed for the 2002 death of his 2-year-old daughter, Nikki , whom he had rushed to the hospital in their hometown town of Palestine in East Texas and told authorities she had fallen out of bed. Medical staff at the time believed the child was a victim of "shaken baby syndrome." Members of the Texas House Criminal Jurisprudence Committee, however, now say the scientific understanding of shaken baby syndrome has been discredited and they appealed for court intervention. The Pardons and Paroles Board's decision came just after the Texas Court of Criminal Appeals earlier Wednesday rejected in a 5-4 decision the House committee's plea that Roberson's pending execution be postponed to give the Legislature more time to overhaul a law meant to revisit convictions that were based on flawed science. Committee members told the appeals court that Roberson's death sentence handed down in 2003 rested solely on the shaken baby syndrome theory, and they included in their legal brief a statement from Dr. Norman Guthkelch , a physician known for establishing the syndrome's hypothesis, saying it should not be relied on to obtain convictions. "I am frankly quite disturbed that what I intended as a friendly suggestion for avoiding injury to children has become an excuse for imprisoning innocent parents," Guthkelch's statement said. The appeals court, however, said the committee had failed to show that the law it had invoked in the effort to postpone Roberson's execution was not applicable in the case. The court said it rejected "the application as an abuse of the writ without reviewing the merits of the claims raised." Roberson is scheduled to be executed after 6 p.m. Thursday. The Board and Pardons and Paroles Aside from any eleventh-hour appeal in the courts, Roberson's fate now rests with Republican Gov. Greg Abbott , who under the law has the option of issuing a one-time 30-day reprieve to allow the condemned man's legal team to pursue other possible avenues to stop the execution." ---
_My mom and my sisters, watching me speak at the DNC this year._
Peter -
When I think about the toughest times in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a support system to help me through.
Growing up the way I did, my mom raising my sisters and me on a single income, barely making ends meet — that wasn’t easy.
Working every job I could to support the family while I went to school and tried to get into college wasn’t easy.
Going out on patrol in al Anbar, at the height of the Iraq War sure wasn’t easy.
And now, running for Senate, having Donald Trump and Kari Lake relentlessly attack me, personally — that hasn’t been easy either.
But growing up, I had my family.
Getting into school, I had a strong community and great teachers.
In Iraq, I had my brothers.
And in this campaign, I have you.
I couldn’t do this without you, Peter. You probably didn’t wake up this morning thinking you were going to make a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to defeat Trump and Kari Lake and defend Arizona.

Not to mention, _**the polling they’ve shared shows this race is within the margin of error.**_ They’re fighting tooth and nail to flip this seat and, with it, to push an extreme agenda that threatens reproductive rights, healthcare access, and so much more.

So, team, with just a few hours left until our midnight deadline, I’m asking for your support. If national Republicans are aiming for $100,000 this week, _I’m aiming for $150,000_. So as the actor and activist who played that former president on TV, I ask the same question of you now, friend: _**What's next when it comes to your support of one of the most important Senate races in the country?**_

subject: We’re creating climate refugees right here in America.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=helene_update&n=1)
---
Peter,

In 2017, Hurricane Maria slammed into Puerto Rico and sawed through the island. Millions were trapped by floods and mudslides. Medical facilities were destroyed. Power was down across the island and it would be _11 months_ before it was fully restored.

**When the initial death toll was reported to be 64, we knew that was a lie.

** It took a year of sustained pressure from elected representatives, media, academics and even lawsuits before the official death toll was finally corrected to over 3,000.

**We are living through that outrage again, right now, in the wake of Hurricane Helene.

** The official death toll for Helene stands at just over 230 – not a small number for natural disasters, but suspiciously small for this one.

Helene dumped vast quantities of rain and shocked Appalachia with what was widely described as “Biblical” flooding and destruction. There were multiple dam failures and whole towns wiped away. Early warning systems broke down and failed to notify people to evacuate.

It’s been 20 days, and we are just now getting citizen reports across social media about severely undercounted deaths. We’re seeing accounts of people’s homes being swept away by the floods as they clung, terrified, to their roof. We’re hearing of slow-moving recovery efforts and people being told they won’t have power restored for months.

Multibillion dollar corporations like Walmart reportedly chose to let their food rot instead of handing out their inventory to hungry people who just lost everything. Police were called out to guard their stores from “looting” – not to render assistance.

We don’t know yet what the real death toll will be from Helene. What we do know is that Helene is just one of many such devastating super-storms to come.

And we know why.

**Experts estimate that at least 3 million Americans have already been internally, permanently displaced because of the climate emergency. Forced to leave their homes and communities behind and start over from scratch – without their support network and certainly without adequate assistance from our government.

** Those numbers will continue to climb, as storms and wildfires increase in intensity and frequency.

Republicans are gleefully blaming Joe Biden for the destruction caused by Helene and Milton (and trust me, I’ve got plenty to say about Joe) – but these same Republicans deliberately blocked emergency FEMA funding the day before Helene made landfall.

It’s a sick and twisted game where the corporate uni-party has so thoroughly politicized the climate emergency that it’s becoming impossible to respond to – let alone prepare for – these super storms.

And yet, when it comes time to ship billions of dollars and bombs to Israel to continue slaughtering Palestinians, Lebanese, and whomever else, both parties _rush_ to write the checks.

**We need a fundamental reordering of our priorities and our society.** We need to urgently end fossil fuel extraction and begin aggressively developing our infrastructure to better withstand the storms still to come.

We need to take decisions about emergency humanitarian aid out of the hands of partisan ghouls. **We need human-centered policies from government agencies that are fully resourced and operate with trust and transparency.

[That’s the kind of government we will build in my administration. And with only 20 days left in this election I still need your help to reach a critical mass of voters who haven’t yet decided who to vote for.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=helene_update&n=2)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=helene_update&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=helene_update&n=3)
---
The stories being reported by residents in Appalachia who are still trying to dig their way out from this disaster are heartbreaking – and much like the voices of Gaza, they are being ignored by our mainstream media.

Cable news anchors would rather give airtime to DNC smears against our campaign and fawn over the latest poll numbers than do the hard work of investigating these reports and demanding transparency.

I don’t know when we will have the full picture of the death and destruction wrought by Helene. But I know we don’t have any more time to waste on Republicans AND Democrats working together to accelerate the climate emergency.

A Stein Ware administration will be committed to addressing the root cause and will guarantee the necessary resources for people forced to migrate or rebuild in the wake of these extreme weather events. In the process, we will restore trust in our federal agencies with truth and transparency.

**[If you share this vision of a government centered on human rights and serving the greatest need – one dedicated to people, planet, and peace – then donate now to power our grassroots campaign through these final weeks.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=helene_update&n=4)**

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

These values got me through my 25-year career as a U.S. Navy Officer, but sadly, they’ve been forgotten by too many leaders on Capitol Hill.

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95177778/505849589/664783965?ms=101624_careagenda&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTk4YmE3Ny0xNDhjLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WiQ7AQQJQDhar3IH5aDG4q6vAs2WIr7PawWKIjX3zpI=&emci=764ddf60-c88b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&emdi=6598ba77-148c-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&ceid=864787)
Dear Peter,
Election Day is right around the corner. We’re running out of time to get out the vote for Care Champions.
In this election, your vote can make the difference between an **expansive overhaul on long-term care policy and benefits for caregivers,** and more policy that**leaves care out of the picture.**
Long story short, care is on the ballot this election. [**_Will you volunteer with us to get out the vote in these critical final weeks?_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95177780/505849590/-461611900?ms=101624_careagenda&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTk4YmE3Ny0xNDhjLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WiQ7AQQJQDhar3IH5aDG4q6vAs2WIr7PawWKIjX3zpI=&emci=764ddf60-c88b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&emdi=6598ba77-148c-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&ceid=864787)
_******__[VOLUNTEER](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95177782/505849593/-461611900?ms=101624_careagenda&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTk4YmE3Ny0xNDhjLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WiQ7AQQJQDhar3IH5aDG4q6vAs2WIr7PawWKIjX3zpI=&emci=764ddf60-c88b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&emdi=6598ba77-148c-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&ceid=864787)__******_
The Washington Post recently reported that** **“more than one-third of mothers who are registered to vote said they worry ‘a lot’ about affording child care.”**1******
**********> >Where the 2024 candidates stand on childcare<<**********
********Kamala Harris and Tim Walz******** | ********Donald Trump and JD Vance********
---|---
* Vow to permanently increase the child tax credit.
* Propose a one-time $6,000 credit for newborns.
* Would cap child-care costs at 7 percent of a working family’s income.

|
* Trump said he would consider expanding the child tax credit, though he has not offered further details.
* Trump said “Childcare isn’t that expensive.”
* JD Vance said children would benefit from a stay-at-home parent, saying families should rely more on “grandma and grandpa” to save on child care.

************> >Where the 2024 candidates stand on aging care<<************
**********Kamala Harris and Tim Walz********** | **********Donald Trump and JD Vance**********
---|---
* Passed a bill to cap the cost of insulin for seniors at $35/month.
* Proposed legislation to expand Medicare coverage to include at-home long‐term care.

|
* During his presidency, Donald Trump actively resisted the advice of medical professionals on guidelines during the coronavirus pandemic, putting older adults and people with disabilities at risk.
* Donald Trump has said that he intends to repeal the Affordable Care Act, which President Obama passed into legislation to lower the cost of healthcare for all Americans.

**************In the National News**************
* Last week, Vice President Kamala Harris announced a proposal to strengthen Medicare to cover long-term home care. This proposal would benefit the thousands of Americans in the “sandwich generation” who care for both their children and aging parents, as well as Americans who need support in caring for family members with disabilities. Making at-home care an option through Medicare would improve the quality of life for millions of Americans who need care and caregivers.
* Care in Action PAC announced a multimillion-dollar additional investment across battleground states to elect Care Champions like Kamala Harris.
****

************Childcare************
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95177784/505849595/1346310570?ms=101624_careagenda&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTk4YmE3Ny0xNDhjLWVmMTEtODQ3My0wMDIyNDgzMDI5ZmEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WiQ7AQQJQDhar3IH5aDG4q6vAs2WIr7PawWKIjX3zpI=&emci=764ddf60-c88b-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&emdi=6598ba77-148c-ef11-8473-0022483029fa&ceid=864787)
* **Spotlight:** In Reno, NV, **families spend up to 20% of their monthly income on childcare,** higher than almost anywhere in the country.strong>1
* Childcare is an issue that emphasizes gender parity. The Department of Labor found that**“When a family has child care issues, mothers miss work or reduce work hours more often than fathers.”**3****

************The Economic Perspective************
* **About 56% of US workers** —roughly 90 million people—have care responsibilities outside of their full‐time jobs.
* By 2030, the US is expected to **lose $290 billion in GDP** a year as a result of the care crisis — this is because of:
1. a growing surplus of care jobs and;
2. reduced labor force participation from Americans who have to quit their jobs or scale back hours to care for their children and aging relatives.
__

_******__Why is there a surplus of care jobs? Why does a care crisis lower workforce participation?__******_
* There is a serious lack of support for care workers and domestic workers, who deserve dignity in the workplace and all of the rights afforded to other workers in America.
* Workplace standards like a minimum wage, overtime pay, or protections against sexual harassment in the workplace are rarely extended to domestic workers, if at all.

************Now that we know some of the facts, what does this have to do with the 2024 Election?************
As Vice President, Kamala Harris worked alongside President Joe Biden to solve the care crisis. She personally understands what it means to take care of an aging parent — when her mother was diagnosed with cancer, she took on the role of caregiver.
Vice President Kamala Harris knows how integral care workers are to every aspect of life. She has a plan to make big pharmaceutical companies help shoulder the burden of the cost of care, and speaks plainly about the need to bring dignity and support to the thousands of people who need care, and provide it.
**We know who our biggest Care Champion is for 2024 — it’s Vice President Kamala Harris.**

clean_body: Election Day is right around the corner. Dear Peter, Election Day is right around the corner. We’re running out of time to get out the vote for Care Champions. In this election, your vote can make the difference between an expansive overhaul on long-term care policy and benefits for caregivers, and more policy thatleaves care out of the picture. Long story short, care is on the ballot this election. ****** The Washington Post recently reported that “more than one-third of mothers who are registered to vote said they worry ‘a lot’ about affording child care.”1**** ******> >Where the 2024 candidates stand on childcare<<****** ****Kamala Harris and Tim Walz**** | ****Donald Trump and JD Vance**** ---|--- Vow to permanently increase the child tax credit. Propose a one-time $6,000 credit for newborns. Would cap child-care costs at 7 percent of a working family’s income. | Trump said he would consider expanding the child tax credit, though he has not offered further details. Trump said “Childcare isn’t that expensive.” JD Vance said children would benefit from a stay-at-home parent, saying families should rely more on “grandma and grandpa” to save on child care. ********> >Where the 2024 candidates stand on aging care<<******** ******Kamala Harris and Tim Walz****** | ******Donald Trump and JD Vance****** ---|--- Passed a bill to cap the cost of insulin for seniors at $35/month. Proposed legislation to expand Medicare coverage to include at-home long‐term care. | During his presidency, Donald Trump actively resisted the advice of medical professionals on guidelines during the coronavirus pandemic, putting older adults and people with disabilities at risk. Donald Trump has said that he intends to repeal the Affordable Care Act, which President Obama passed into legislation to lower the cost of healthcare for all Americans. **********In the National News********** Last week, Vice President Kamala Harris announced a proposal to strengthen Medicare to cover long-term home care. This proposal would benefit the thousands of Americans in the “sandwich generation” who care for both their children and aging parents, as well as Americans who need support in caring for family members with disabilities. Making at-home care an option through Medicare would improve the quality of life for millions of Americans who need care and caregivers. Care in Action PAC announced a multimillion-dollar additional investment across battleground states to elect Care Champions like Kamala Harris. ********Childcare******** Spotlight: In Reno, NV, families spend up to 20% of their monthly income on childcare, higher than almost anywhere in the country.strong>1 Childcare is an issue that emphasizes gender parity. The Department of Labor found that“When a family has child care issues, mothers miss work or reduce work hours more often than fathers.”3 ********The Economic Perspective******** About 56% of US workers —roughly 90 million people—have care responsibilities outside of their full‐time jobs. By 2030, the US is expected to lose $290 billion in GDP a year as a result of the care crisis — this is because of: 1. a growing surplus of care jobs and; 2. reduced labor force participation from Americans who have to quit their jobs or scale back hours to care for their children and aging relatives. **Why is there a surplus of care jobs? Why does a care crisis lower workforce participation?** There is a serious lack of support for care workers and domestic workers, who deserve dignity in the workplace and all of the rights afforded to other workers in America. Workplace standards like a minimum wage, overtime pay, or protections against sexual harassment in the workplace are rarely extended to domestic workers, if at all. ********Now that we know some of the facts, what does this have to do with the 2024 Election?******** As Vice President, Kamala Harris worked alongside President Joe Biden to solve the care crisis. She personally understands what it means to take care of an aging parent — when her mother was diagnosed with cancer, she took on the role of caregiver. Vice President Kamala Harris knows how integral care workers are to every aspect of life. She has a plan to make big pharmaceutical companies help shoulder the burden of the cost of care, and speaks plainly about the need to bring dignity and support to the thousands of people who need care, and provide it. We know who our biggest Care Champion is for 2024 — it’s Vice President Kamala Harris. **** **** Help us ensure Kamala Harris gets elected this November. Make sure you are registered to vote, and vote with care in mind. In solidarity, Care in Action 1, 2. Washington Post 3\. Department of Labor

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Tonight is our campaign’s FINAL pre-Election Day FEC fundraising deadline. This is the last fundraising report we will submit for this campaign, The results will either indicate that we have the resources to conduct a winning campaign down the home stretch or that the writing is on the wall for us. From the beginning, we’ve defied the pundits and so-called “experts” who said a Republican couldn’t be competitive in a “safe-blue” state like New Mexico. We’re now within striking distance of flipping this seat and restoring common-sense leadership to this seat. But it’s going to take every one of us to get it done. Things in our state and country won’t get better if everyone reading doesn’t commit to fighting it out for the next 20 days. For New Mexico, Nella Domenici Republican for Senate | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. We’re fighting for a better future together.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20241016-1&t=1&akid=1322%2E587540%2Ei496hb)
Let me tell you what I think, Peter.
Young people are smart. We pay attention to the issues. We’re showing up to vote.
But to me, this is only the first step for our generation. The second step? _Running._
**We need young people on the ballot. We need young people in elected office.**
That’s why I teamed up with Kevin Lata, the campaign manager who helped elect the first ever Gen-Z member of Congress in 2022, to launch Leaders We Deserve.
**[Peter, if you agree that we need more young, courageous leaders running for office, will you pitch in $5 to help Leaders We Deserve make it happen?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241016-1?refcode=em20241016-1322&amount=5&refcode2=1322_587540_i496hb&akid=1322%2E587540%2Ei496hb)**

As a generation, we grew up hearing that to survive a school shooting, we had to run, hide, and fight. I think our generation needs to reinterpret what that means.
* **We need to run—for office.** Representation won’t happen on its own.

Fellow Conservative,

It's Ted Cruz.

You know me.

You know I'm a freedom fighter, a defender of liberty, and an advocate for a smaller, more effective federal government.

You probably don't know this man, former U.S. Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy; you should familiarize yourself with his name and mission to be Montana's next United States Senator.

******************************************************[Chip in any amount ->](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/S8FfIIkTjI2LJynSqwNJLA~~/AAVLBgA~/RgRo858EP0T1aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9ucnNjL3NoZWVoeS1mYW1pbGlhcml6ZS15b3Vyc2VsZi10cy1hZWRnZS8_dXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWFlZGdlX25yc2NfTU1NJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI0MDkyM19uYV9zaGVlaHlmYW1pbGlhcml6ZXlvdXJzZWxmLXRjLXYxX01NTV90Y3J1el9ucnNjJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PWZ1bmRyYWlzaW5nJmFtdHBvc2l0aW9uPTQmYW10ND0xMDAmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWVXA3NwY0IKZw7xTRBnw9ddq1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)******************************************************

subject: Come one, come all! The Tulsa County Republican Party is hosting its annual gala. You are all “welcome to the big tent!”
body:
| [ ](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaIOiUFGhm1XQHaiZ59fvCoY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_come_one_come_all_the_tulsa&n=1)
---
Peter -- Come one, come all! The Tulsa County Republican Party is hosting its annual gala. You are all “welcome to the big tent!” **TCGOP ANNUAL GALA** \- Saturday, October 19 - Osage Casino Skyline Event Center - We are excited to welcome Virginia's Lt. Governor Winsome Earle-Sears, who has announced her candidacy for Governor next year. Sears serves as the 42nd Lt. Governor of Virginia, making history as their first female and being a woman of color. We are honored to have Oklahoma Lt. Governor Matt Pinnell as co-host for this exciting event with the Tulsa County Republican Party. As we are closing in on our elections we wanted to have a theme that represents the Republican Party, and you know how much we loved Ronald Reagan, so we pulled our theme from him, "Welcome to the Big Tent" **Excerpt from April 1, 1967 Address of Governor Ronald Reagan to the California Assembly** _"The Republican Party, both in this state and nationally, is a broad party. There is room in our tent for many views; indeed, the divergence of views is one of our strengths. Let no one, however, interpret this to mean compromise of basic philosophy or that we will be all things to all people for political expediency._ _In our tent will be found those who believe that government was created by We, the People; that government exists for the convenience of the people and we can give to government no power we do not possess as individuals; that the citizen does not earn to support the government, but supports a government so that he may be free to earn; that, because there can be no freedom without law and order, every act of government must be approved if it makes freedom more secure and disapproved if it offers security instead of freedom._ _Within our tent, there will be many arguments and divisions over approach and method and even those we choose to implement our philosophy. Seldom, if ever, will we raise a cheer signifying unanimous approval of the decisions reached. But if our philosophy is to prevail, we must at least pledge unified support of the ultimate decision. Unity does not require unanimity of thought."_ This is a fundraiser for the Tulsa Republican Party. Please invite your friends and family for an evening of great fun and fellowship. Monies raised will go toward our efforts to Keep Tulsa County RED! You can purchase individual tickets, tables or secure sponsorships at [https://www.eventbrite.com/e/republican-party-of-tulsa-county-annual-gala-tickets-1001719940307?utm_experiment=test_share_listing&aff=ebdsshios](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=GKyjM4hwXyUM0Wy0lmqFYEEVsVQaDFyb1ksoDQJ_QLivY6DtsXMQUNSWsnLWHZb0xFdfVcfx4JY0No7s0ydEdnTvYCXcalBaYd6NM4CdQ98LcYnXQ32ian3kMClGnGqFhk2QnjKZ19aXWK0kOXe8QyOdr62TEB4q1xQR2hdxsHVgUYcj1zB70d0dctX2kFzY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_come_one_come_all_the_tulsa&n=2) [](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=GKyjM4hwXyUM0Wy0lmqFYEEVsVQaDFyb1ksoDQJ_QLivY6DtsXMQUNSWsnLWHZb0xFdfVcfx4JY0No7s0ydEdnTvYCXcalBaYd6NM4CdQ98LcYnXQ32ian3kMClGnGqFhk2QnjKZ19aXWK0kOXe8QyOdr62TEB4q1xQR2hdxsHVgUYcj1zB70d0dctX2kFzY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_come_one_come_all_the_tulsa&n=3)
